examples.why: Two typos that produce wrong words: מענקי (grants) lost its mem and became ענקי ('giants of seeds'), and קריוגניים was misspelled קרמוגניים — a non-word in the middle of a workforce-roles list.

examples.source: search yields active solicitations like DOE's quantum R&D calls
examples.suggested: החיפוש מניב קולות קוראים פעילים, כמו קריאות ה-R&D הקוונטי של DOE
examples.translation: החיפוש מניב הגשות פעילות כמו קריאות R&D קוונטי של DOE
examples.why: A 'solicitation' is a call issued by the agency (קול קורא); הגשות means submissions made by applicants — the direction of the transaction is reversed. The following clause ('like DOE's calls') keeps the reader from being fully misled, which is why this stays MINOR.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no inverted conditions, no dropped caveats; core terms are correct and consistent (ansatz, optimizer, barren plateau, minimum lokal, fungsi biaya, lanskap biaya, uniter for "unitary", state kept in English consistently for "initial/reference state"). What a native technical editor would change: (1) "circuit" is left as English "Circuit" capitalized mid-sentence ("Circuit yang berisi delapan parameter variasional", "Circuit kuantum terparameter", "Sebuah Circuit kuantum kini dengan uniter") — reads as a glossary keep-English artifact where Indonesian would write "sirkuit"; (2) several English calques survive — "Secara tingkat tinggi" for "At a high level" (natural: "Secara garis besar"), "dengan kerangka ini dalam pikiran" for "with this framework in mind", and repeated relative "di mana" ("situasi di mana", "ruang parameter di mana"); (3) "gradient-based" is "berbasis-gradien" in the body but "bergradien" in the workflow image alt text; (4) inanimate "Mereka juga cenderung lebih andal" / "wilayah tempat mereka mengevaluasi" uses the human pronoun for optimizers, which Indonesian technical prose avoids. None of this would mislead a learner.

examples.source: We will start with a circuit containing eight variational parameters
examples.suggested: Kita akan mulai dengan sirkuit yang berisi delapan parameter variasional
examples.translation: Kita akan mulai dengan Circuit yang berisi delapan parameter variasional
examples.why: "circuit" is left in English AND capitalized mid-sentence, three times (also "Circuit kuantum terparameter", "Sebuah Circuit kuantum kini dengan uniter"). Indonesian quantum writing uses "sirkuit" (or "rangkaian"); the capitalized English word reads as an untranslated glossary token, not an authorial choice.

examples.source: At a high level, optimizers are central to exploring our search space.
examples.suggested: Secara garis besar, optimizer adalah inti dari eksplorasi ruang pencarian kita.
examples.translation: Secara tingkat tinggi, optimizer adalah pusat dari eksplorasi ruang pencarian kita.
examples.why: "Secara tingkat tinggi" is a word-for-word calque of "at a high level" that means nothing idiomatic in Indonesian; "Secara garis besar" is what a native technical writer writes.

examples.source: Next, we'll explore specific variational algorithms with this framework in mind.
examples.suggested: Selanjutnya, kita akan mengeksplorasi algoritma variasional tertentu dengan kerangka kerja ini sebagai acuan.
examples.translation: Selanjutnya, kita akan mengeksplorasi algoritma variasional spesifik dengan kerangka ini dalam pikiran.
examples.why: "dengan kerangka ini dalam pikiran" is a literal transfer of the English idiom; Indonesian does not say "dalam pikiran" here.

examples.source: gradient vs gradient-free optimizers
examples.suggested: optimizer berbasis-gradien vs bebas-gradien
examples.translation: optimizer bergradien vs bebas-gradien
examples.why: The body consistently uses "berbasis-gradien" for gradient-based (headings and prose); only the workflow image alt text says "bergradien". Same concept, two renderings within the file.

examples.source: They also tend to be more robust in finding global optima ... beyond the region where they are evaluating
examples.suggested: Metode ini juga cenderung lebih andal ... melampaui wilayah yang sedang dievaluasi
examples.translation: Mereka juga cenderung lebih andal dalam menemukan optima global ... melampaui wilayah tempat mereka mengevaluasi
examples.why: "mereka" is the human plural pronoun; Indonesian technical prose repeats the noun or uses a passive for inanimate subjects like optimizers. Grammatical but reads as machine-carried English pronoun structure.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inversions, dropped conditions, or swapped quantities; the appendix's advantage criteria (geometric separation "kira-kira dalam orde √N", quantum model complexity "jauh lebih kecil dari N") and the ZNE/error-mitigation notes all track the English exactly, and the informal "kamu" register holds. What a native editor would fix is terminological inconsistency: "quantum" is left untranslated in some places and rendered "kuantum" in others, sometimes in the same paragraph ("ruang fitur quantum"/"state quantum"/"komputer quantum"/"sistem quantum" vs "perangkat keras kuantum"/"feature map kuantum"/"korelasi kuantum"); "classical" alternates between the odd "klasikal" (Background, Step 1 heading) and the standard "klasik" (everywhere after); "training" alternates with "pelatihan" for the same dataset. "Circuit" appears capitalized mid-sentence ("menggunakan Circuit quantum", "Kita cetak ukuran Circuit dan kedalaman gate dua-qubit"), which reads as a glossary-substitution artifact rather than an authored choice — Indonesian would use "sirkuit kuantum" or lowercase "circuit". Two smaller items: the reassurance "safely" is dropped from "this step will safely overwrite them", and "If you found this work interesting" is calqued as "Jika kamu menemukan pekerjaan ini menarik", where "pekerjaan" means a job/chore, not a piece of scholarly work.

examples.source: PQK is a method used in quantum machine learning (QML) to encode classical data into a quantum feature space … PQKs use local observables … for near-term quantum hardware.
examples.suggested: Pick one convention and hold it: "kuantum" throughout ("ruang fitur kuantum", "state kuantum", "komputer kuantum"), and "klasik" instead of "klasikal".
examples.translation: …mengenkode data klasikal ke dalam ruang fitur quantum … PQK menggunakan observable lokal … untuk perangkat keras kuantum jangka pendek.
examples.why: Within-file split: "quantum" is untranslated in five places and rendered "kuantum" in six others, sometimes in adjacent sentences; likewise "klasikal" vs "klasik". The concept stays identifiable, so this is MINOR, but a native technical editor would unify it.

examples.source: encoding classical data into quantum states using a quantum circuit … We print out the circuit size and the two-qubit gate depth.
examples.suggested: …menggunakan sirkuit kuantum … Kita cetak ukuran sirkuit dan kedalaman gate dua-qubit.
examples.translation: pengkodean data klasikal ke dalam state quantum menggunakan Circuit quantum … Kita cetak ukuran Circuit dan kedalaman gate dua-qubit.
examples.why: Capitalized "Circuit" mid-sentence is not something an Indonesian technical writer would produce; it reads as a mechanical glossary substitution, and "Circuit quantum" mixes an English capitalized noun with an untranslated adjective.

examples.source: If you already have these files locally, this step will safely overwrite them to ensure version consistency.
examples.suggested: …langkah ini akan menimpanya dengan aman untuk memastikan konsistensi versi.
examples.translation: Jika kamu sudah memiliki file-file ini secara lokal, langkah ini akan menimpanya untuk memastikan konsistensi versi.
examples.why: The reassuring qualifier "safely" is dropped, so the Indonesian reads as a bare warning that local files will be overwritten. Not misleading about behavior, but the intended reassurance is lost.

examples.source: If you found this work interesting, you might be interested in the following material:
examples.suggested: Kalau topik ini menarik buatmu, kamu mungkin tertarik dengan materi berikut:
examples.translation: Jika kamu menemukan pekerjaan ini menarik, kamu mungkin tertarik dengan materi berikut:
examples.why: "pekerjaan" means a job or chore in Indonesian, not "work" in the sense of a piece of research; combined with the word-for-word "menemukan … menarik" this is a visible calque of the English clause.

examples.source: How projected quantum kernels (PQK) work and when they offer a potential quantum advantage.
examples.suggested: Cara kerja projected quantum kernels (PQK) dan kapan PQK menawarkan potensi keunggulan kuantum.
examples.translation: Cara kerja projected quantum kernels (PQK) dan kapan mereka menawarkan potensi keunggulan kuantum.
examples.why: "mereka" as a pronoun for an inanimate plural is a well-known English-syntax carry-over; native Indonesian technical prose either repeats the noun or drops the pronoun entirely.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inversions, no swapped quantities, no dropped caveats — and core terminology is correct and consistent (qubit, gate, spin, Hamiltoniano, stato fondamentale, sovrapposizione, entanglement, primitive, campo trasversale, algoritmi variazionali); informal "tu" holds everywhere ("puoi aprire", "consulta", "Torna all'inizio"). The one real defect is a glossary leak: "circuit" is rendered as the untranslated capitalized English "Circuit" three times ("il tuo primo Circuit quantistico", "rendere il tuo Circuit pronto per l'esecuzione", "dove misurare nel Circuit") while the rest of the file correctly says "circuito"/"circuito quantistico" — the same concept split two ways within one file. Secondary: the transverse-field definition becomes circular ("punta nella direzione trasversale ... è chiamato campo trasversale"), losing the English's explanatory move ("points across the usual up-down direction") and dropping "usual"; and the Execute sentence in Experiment 2 misplaces the goal phrase, producing "gli osservabili che vogliamo stimare al computer quantistico", which garden-paths the reader. A couple of calqued constructions ("finiamo sempre misurando i qubit", "l'effetto di capovolgimento degli spin del campo magnetico") round out the list. None of this would teach a learner anything false.

examples.source: you've run your first quantum circuit / make your circuit ready for execution / where to measure in the circuit
examples.suggested: il tuo primo circuito quantistico / rendere il tuo circuito pronto per l'esecuzione / dove misurare nel circuito
examples.translation: hai già eseguito il tuo primo Circuit quantistico / rendere il tuo Circuit pronto per l'esecuzione / dove misurare nel Circuit
examples.why: Untranslated capitalized English 'Circuit' leaks into Italian prose in three places, while the rest of the file (lines 56, 60, 80, 115, 121, 287) correctly uses 'circuito'. Same concept rendered two ways within one file; 'circuito' is the settled Italian term and there is no reason to keep this one in English.

examples.source: Because this field points across the usual up-down direction of the spins, it is called a transverse field.
examples.suggested: Poiché questo campo è diretto trasversalmente rispetto alla consueta direzione su-giù degli spin, viene chiamato campo trasversale.
examples.translation: Poiché questo campo punta nella direzione trasversale rispetto alla direzione su-giù degli spin, è chiamato campo trasversale.
examples.why: The rendering uses 'trasversale' to define 'campo trasversale', making the sentence circular and flattening the English's explanatory step; 'usual' (consueta) is also dropped, losing the contrast with the spins' default axis.

examples.source: we'll load `Estimator`, then send the circuit plus the list of observables that we want it to estimate to the quantum computer
examples.suggested: caricheremo `Estimator`, poi invieremo al computer quantistico il circuito insieme all'elenco degli osservabili di cui vogliamo la stima
examples.translation: caricheremo `Estimator`, poi invieremo il circuito insieme all'elenco degli osservabili che vogliamo stimare al computer quantistico
examples.why: Placing 'al computer quantistico' at the end attaches it to 'stimare' rather than to 'invieremo', so the sentence reads as 'observables we want to estimate to the quantum computer'. Fronting the indirect object removes the garden path.

examples.source: When we run a quantum circuit, we always end by measuring the qubits.
examples.suggested: Quando eseguiamo un circuito quantistico, terminiamo sempre con la misurazione dei qubit.
examples.translation: Quando eseguiamo un circuito quantistico, finiamo sempre misurando i qubit.
examples.why: 'finiamo … misurando' is a direct calque of the English gerund construction; an Italian technical writer would use 'terminiamo con la misurazione' or 'si conclude sempre con la misura dei qubit'.

examples.source: $X_0$ and $X_1$ represent the spin-flipping effect of the magnetic field
examples.suggested: $X_0$ e $X_1$ rappresentano l'effetto del campo magnetico, che capovolge gli spin
examples.translation: $X_0$ e $X_1$ rappresentano l'effetto di capovolgimento degli spin del campo magnetico
examples.why: Two stacked 'di/del' genitives leave it momentarily unclear whether the field belongs to the spins; splitting the modifier into a relative clause is how the same idea is normally written in Italian.

editor_note: Faithful, natural and fully complete: domain terms are kept in the conventional Italian usage and stay consistent (stretch/delay/barrier/gate/qubit untranslated, "regione di barrier", "insiemi mutuamente esclusivi", "costanti in virgola mobile o intere", "il solver attuale non deduce i vincoli di non negatività"), the remainder rule ("qualsiasi resto risultante dalla risoluzione di uno stretch viene aggiunto al primo delay che usa lo stretch") and the billing caveat ("questo NON è il tempo utilizzato per la fatturazione (QPU time)") survive intact, and the register stays informal-tu ("puoi visualizzare", "consulta l'argomento").

No semantic drift found — every claim, threshold (忠実度 > 0.5, ショット数40,000), depth comparison and pass/fail verdict matches the English, and the tricky "驚くことに、ツリーの深さが5から6に増加したにもかかわらず、2量子ビット深さは9から8へと減少しました" sentence is faithfully carried over. The file is, however, visibly a two-pass merge: the first half renders terms in Japanese and the second half switches to bare capitalized English mid-sentence, so nearly every core term is split within the file — qubit = 量子ビット (l.285, 938, 1056) vs Qubit (l.410–618: 「Qubitのバランス木」「16-Qubit GHZ状態」「不良Qubit」); circuit = 回路 (l.142, 1052) vs Circuit (l.412, 511, 698); gate = ゲート (l.285) vs Gate (l.412「H Gate」, 511「Gateエラー」); fidelity = 忠実度 (l.4, 176, 351) vs フィデリティ (l.1056, 1059); tree = 木/木構造 (l.509, 641) vs ツリー (l.821, 893); root node = 根ノード (l.576, 591) vs ルートノード (l.760, 866); coupling map = カップリングマップ (l.393) vs 結合マップ (l.543, 618) vs 結合グラフ (l.511). Separately, the untranslated 「Backend」/「Circuit」 dropped raw into Japanese sentences (「まず Backend を指定します」) reads as machine-merge residue rather than something a Japanese quantum engineer would write, and the closing two paragraphs slip into keigo the house style forbids (「一部としていただき」l.1302, 「ご回答いただき」l.1306).

examples.source: ### 2.1 Build a GHZ circuit on the best qubit chain / We choose a qubit in the middle of the chain to first apply the H gate to.
examples.suggested: ### 2.1 最良の量子ビットチェーン上にGHZ回路を構築する / チェーンの中央にある量子ビットを選び、まずそこにHゲートを適用します。
examples.translation: ### 2.1 最良のQubitチェーン上にGHZ Circuit を構築する / チェーンの中央にあるQubitを選び、まずそこにH Gateを適用します。
examples.why: qubit/circuit/gate are rendered as 量子ビット・回路・ゲート earlier in the same file (l.142, 285) but switch to bare English Qubit/Circuit/Gate from section 2.1 onward. Recognizable, so not misleading, but a native technical editor would unify on the Japanese forms already established.

examples.source: The fidelity of your GHZ state > 0.5 … calculate the fidelity using the check_ghz_fidelity_from_jobs function.
examples.suggested: GHZ状態の忠実度が0.5より大きいこと。… `check_ghz_fidelity_from_jobs` 関数を使用して忠実度を計算する必要があります。
examples.translation: GHZ状態のフィデリティが0.5より大きいこと。… `check_ghz_fidelity_from_jobs` 関数を使用してフィデリティを計算する必要があります。
examples.why: This is the recap of the identical goal stated at l.176/179, where 'fidelity' was rendered 忠実度. Using フィデリティ only in the recap makes the learner briefly wonder whether a different quantity is meant.

examples.source: We first specify a backend. Because we will be working extensively with the properties of a specific backend, it is a good idea to specify one backend, as opposed to using the least_busy option.
examples.suggested: まずバックエンドを指定します。特定のバックエンドのプロパティを詳しく扱うため、```least_busy```オプションを使うのではなく、バックエンドを1つ固定して指定することをお勧めします。
examples.translation: まず Backend を指定します。特定の Backend のプロパティを詳しく扱うため、```least_busy```オプションを使うのではなく、特定の Backend を指定することをお勧めします。
examples.why: Bare capitalized 'Backend' with Latin-script spacing dropped into a Japanese sentence reads as untranslated residue, not as an intentional keep-English convention (the same file already writes デバイス, ノード, カップリングマップ in katakana).

examples.source: Thank you for making IBM Quantum® part of your personal quantum journey. / Please take a moment to help us improve our course by filling out the following quick survey.
examples.suggested: IBM Quantum® をあなたの個人的な量子の旅の一部にしてくれてありがとうございます。/ 以下の[簡単なアンケート](...)に回答して、コースの改善に協力してください。
examples.translation: IBM Quantum® をあなたの個人的な量子の旅の一部としていただき、ありがとうございます。/ 以下の[簡単なアンケート](...)にご回答いただき、コースの改善にご協力ください。
examples.why: The house convention is plain desu/masu without keigo; 「〜していただき」「ご回答いただき」 are humble/honorific forms. A formal-register slip confined to the two closing paragraphs — MINOR, not a FAIL.

examples.source: We call the betweenness_centrality function to find a qubit for the root node. … Here we select the root node manually.
examples.suggested: Pick one — either 根ノード throughout or ルートノード throughout (ルートノード is the more common rendering in Japanese Qiskit material).
examples.translation: `betweenness_centrality` 関数を呼び出して、根ノードとなるQubitを見つけます。… ここでは、ルートノードを手動で選択します。
examples.why: Same concept, two renderings within a few paragraphs (根ノード at l.576/591, ルートノード at l.760/866); the same split affects tree (木構造 l.509/641 vs ツリー l.821/893).

editor_note: Terminology is correct and consistent throughout (量子ビット/超伝導量子ビット/トランスモン量子ビット, 量子中心スーパーコンピューティング, 動的回路（Dynamic Circuits）, プリミティブ, ゲートエラー率, フィードフォワード操作) and nothing teaches a false concept, so this does not mislead — but a native editor would fix several things. Two sentences are outright ungrammatical: 「多数の変数が複雑に絡み合う問題には苦手としています」(should be 「…問題を解くのは苦手です」) and 「力任せの手法が限界を超えた領域においても」(should be 「力任せの手法の限界を超えた領域でも」— as written the *method* exceeds a limit). The opening section breaks the no-keigo convention with 「身につけていただけます」「ご用意しています」「ご紹介します」. Small qualifier losses accumulate: the accordion answer drops "soon" from "could soon outperform" and turns "in a meaningful task" into 「意味のある形で」; the key-takeaway renders "understand our world differently" as 「より深く理解し」(deeper, not differently); and the 1994 row strengthens "might take a regular computer the lifetime of the universe to unravel" into 「宇宙の寿命をかけても解けない計算」.

examples.source: they struggle to solve problems with many variables interacting in complicated ways
examples.suggested: 多数の変数が複雑に絡み合う問題を解くのは苦手です
examples.translation: 多数の変数が複雑に絡み合う問題には苦手としています
examples.why: Ungrammatical particle/verb pairing — 「〜には苦手としています」is not Japanese; either 「〜は苦手です」or 「〜を解くのは苦手です」. The preceding clause 「解くのには優れている一方で」is likewise clumsy (「解くのに優れている」).

examples.source: This training will introduce you to quantum computing... IBM Quantum offers many resources for you to start learning
examples.suggested: …を紹介します。…必要な知識が身につきます。…豊富なリソースを提供しています。
examples.translation: …をご紹介します。…必要な知識を身につけていただけます。…豊富なリソースをご用意しています。
examples.why: Humble keigo (いただく) plus bikago (ご紹介/ご用意) in the opening paragraph, against the file's otherwise plain desu/masu convention; the rest of the document stays plain, so this reads as an inconsistent opening.

examples.source: Quantum plus classical computers could soon outperform the use of classical computers alone in a meaningful task.
examples.suggested: …近い将来、意味のあるタスクにおいて、古典的コンピューターだけを使う場合を凌駕できる可能性があります。
examples.translation: 量子コンピューターと古典的コンピューターを組み合わせることで、古典的コンピューターだけを使う場合を意味のある形で凌駕できる可能性があります。
examples.why: Drops the time qualifier "soon", and converts "in a meaningful task" (a task, i.e. scope of the claim) into "in a meaningful way" (manner) — the claim loses both its horizon and its scope.

examples.source: It will enable us to understand our world differently and solve some previously intractable problems.
examples.suggested: …世界をこれまでとは違った形で理解し、…
examples.translation: 量子コンピューティングは、私たちが世界をより深く理解し、これまで解決不可能だった問題のいくつかを解決することを可能にします。
examples.why: "Differently" (a new way of seeing) is flattened into "more deeply" (more of the same) — this is a key takeaway bullet, so the paradigm-shift emphasis the course is building is lost.

examples.source: Eagle answers more accurate than the classical approximation methods, even in the regime beyond the capabilities of the brute force methods.
examples.suggested: Eagleは、力任せの手法の限界を超えた領域においても、古典的な近似手法より正確な結果を示しました。
examples.translation: Eagleは、力任せの手法が限界を超えた領域においても、古典的な近似手法より正確な結果を示しました。
examples.why: Particle error (が vs の) makes the sentence say the brute-force method itself exceeded a limit rather than describing a regime beyond its reach; also 「総当たり手法」is the more standard rendering of "brute force" than 「力任せの手法」in this context.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift: the two quantum-advantage criteria (엄격한 검증 / 고전 계산 단독 대비 우월한 효율·비용·정확성), the 2026년 말 timeline, "가까운 시일 내에 실현 가능할 것으로 예상되지 않습니다" for full FTQC, and "수백만 개의 Gate와 수천 개의 논리적 Qubit" all match the English, and 오류 완화 / 오류 정정 부호 / 내결함성 / 부분공간 are the right domain terms. The defects are terminological consistency and polish: "circuit" is rendered as bare English **Circuit** four times (양자 Circuit, 동적 Circuit, Circuit 라이브러리) while the image alt-text on the same page uses 회로 ("회로 복잡도"), and "qubit" splits between lowercase **qubit** (논리적 qubit, 비국소 qubit 연결성) and capitalized **Qubit** in the very next sentence ("수천 개의 논리적 Qubit로", which also takes the wrong particle — 로 instead of 으로). Separately, a couple of sentences read as English syntax in Korean rather than as native technical prose: the by-passive chain "커뮤니티에 의해 면밀히 검토되고, 재현되고, 도전받아" and the calque "가장 강력한 전진 경로" for "the most powerful path forward". Register is 합니다체 rather than the 해요체 target, but that is the convention across the whole ko corpus (0 해요체 endings in all seven files of this course), so I treat it as a locale-wide convention, not a file defect.

examples.source: quantum circuits ... utility-scale dynamic circuits (2025) ... new circuit libraries (2029)
examples.suggested: 양자 회로 / 동적 회로 / 회로 라이브러리 (align the body with the 회로 already used in the image alt-text)
examples.translation: 양자 Circuit ... 동적 Circuit(2025) ... Circuit 라이브러리(2029)  [vs. alt-text: "회로 복잡도"]
examples.why: 'circuit' is rendered as bare English 'Circuit' in the prose but as 회로 in the image description on the same page — the same concept appears under two labels within one file. 회로 is the settled Korean domain term; leaving 'Circuit' untranslated is a glossary leak, not a convention.

examples.source: logical qubits ... non-local qubit connectivity ... thousands of logical qubits
examples.suggested: 논리적 큐비트 / 비국소 큐비트 연결성 / 수천 개의 논리적 큐비트로
examples.translation: 논리적 qubit ... 비국소 qubit 연결성 ... 수천 개의 논리적 Qubit로
examples.why: Casing splits within two sentences (qubit vs Qubit), and 'Qubit로' is ungrammatical — a consonant-final reading requires 으로. 큐비트 is the standard Korean rendering and fixes both at once.

examples.source: a sequence of increasingly robust demonstrations that will be scrutinized, reproduced, and challenged by the community until a scientific consensus is reached
examples.suggested: 과학적 합의에 이를 때까지 커뮤니티가 면밀히 검토하고, 재현하고, 반박을 시도하는, 점점 더 견고해지는 일련의 실증입니다
examples.translation: 커뮤니티에 의해 면밀히 검토되고, 재현되고, 도전받아 과학적 합의에 도달할 때까지 점점 더 견고해지는 일련의 실증입니다
examples.why: '…에 의해' + a three-verb passive chain is an English by-passive calque; Korean technical prose prefers the community as the active subject. '도전받아' also reads as a literal 'challenged' rather than the scientific sense of being contested/rebutted (반박·검증).

examples.source: …is the most powerful path forward
examples.suggested: 앞으로 나아갈 가장 강력한 길임을 / 가장 유망한 발전 경로임을
examples.translation: 가장 강력한 전진 경로임을 입증하는 것입니다
examples.why: '전진 경로' is a word-for-word calque of 'path forward' that a Korean technical writer would not produce; the meaning survives but the phrase reads as translated English.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no inverted conditions, no dropped caveats; the quantitative claims (두 번의 swap … 두 번 더 swap, 깊이가 절반 이상 감소, $9^3$ 샘플링 오버헤드) and the Step-2/Step-4 relevance statement all match the English, and core terms are correct and consistent (expectation value→기댓값, quasi-probability→준확률, subexperiments→하위 실험, transpile→트랜스파일, observable→관측량, Sampler 프리미티브). What a native technical editor would still change: (1) "qubit" is written three different ways in prose — capitalized "Qubit 3과 0" / "swap이 필요한 Qubit" (L71, L85) but lowercase "비로컬 qubit 0과 3" / "단일 qubit 연산" (L98); mid-sentence capitalized English nouns in Korean prose read as untouched source text, and Korean Qiskit docs normally use 큐비트. The same applies to "Backend에서 실행할" / "하나 이상의 Backend에서" (L116, L118), where 백엔드 is the conventional rendering. (2) L51 "Qiskit 패턴의 네 단계(…)를 사용하여 구현할 것입니다" drops the object of 구현하다 — the English implements *the Qiskit pattern* using the four steps, whereas the Korean leaves "구현할" dangling, and the future 구현할 것입니다 clashes with the plain 합니다 used everywhere else. (3) "coupling map" → "결합 맵" (L85) is understandable but not the field's usual 커플링 맵/연결 맵. None of these would mislead a learner; the file is otherwise fluent, and the 합니다체 + 하세요 imperative mix is the standard, defensible register for Korean technical tutorials.

examples.source: We choose an initial layout that requires two swaps to execute the gates between qubits 3 and 0 … / single-qubit operations
examples.suggested: 큐비트 3과 0 사이의 게이트를 … / swap이 필요한 큐비트를 보여주는 커플링 맵 / 비로컬 큐비트 0과 3 … 단일 큐비트 연산
examples.translation: Qubit 3과 0 사이의 게이트를 실행하기 위해 … / swap이 필요한 Qubit을 보여주는 결합 맵 / 비로컬 qubit 0과 3 … 단일 qubit 연산
examples.why: Same term appears as capitalized "Qubit" and lowercase "qubit" within one file; mid-sentence capitalized English nouns read as untranslated source. Korean Qiskit material conventionally uses 큐비트. Recognizable, so not misleading — but an editor would unify it.

examples.source: We will implement our Qiskit pattern using the four steps outlined in the docs.
examples.suggested: [문서](/guides/intro-to-patterns)에 설명된 네 단계에 따라 Qiskit 패턴을 구현합니다.
examples.translation: Qiskit 패턴의 네 단계([문서](/guides/intro-to-patterns) 참조)를 사용하여 구현할 것입니다.
examples.why: The object of 구현하다 is elided, so the sentence never says *what* is being implemented; the tense (구현할 것입니다) also breaks from the plain 합니다 used in every other sentence. Calqued word order rather than a genuine drift.

examples.source: Generate the subexperiments to run on the backend / executed on one or more backends
examples.suggested: 백엔드에서 실행할 하위 실험 생성 / 하나 이상의 백엔드에서 실행됩니다
examples.translation: Backend에서 실행할 하위 실험 생성 / 하나 이상의 Backend에서 실행됩니다
examples.why: "Backend" is left in English and capitalized mid-sentence in Korean prose; 백엔드 is the established rendering and matches how 프리미티브 and 트랜스파일 are already handled elsewhere in the same file.

editor_note: No semantic drift: every number, claim and caveat matches the English (127 qubits, 2^N, 12 logical qubits / ~1M cycles / 288 qubits, 10x efficiency, 100M gates on 200 logical qubits by 2029, the NYC tourist analogy's "more time but same space = no benefit" logic, and the "we can't prove the answer was correct" hedge all survive intact), and core domain terms are correct and consistent (qubit, litar, kadar ralat, kesetiaan lapisan, nilai jangkaan for expectation value, boleh cerap for observables, tika for instances, Quantum Volume/CLOPS/EPLG kept in English throughout). What a native technical editor would fix is a layer of calques and untranslated leftovers: "orchestration" is rendered as the noun "orkestra" (an orchestra ensemble) rather than "orkestrasi" in both "mengendalikan orkestra kerja" and "set alat orkestra berbilang awan"; "treating quantum as one piece" becomes "merawat kuantum" (to treat medically); "to realize its full potential" becomes "untuk menyedari potensi penuhnya" (to become aware of); and "Key takeaways" is calqued as "Pengambilan utama" (the act of taking/recruitment) instead of "Intisari/Rumusan utama". Several English words are left raw where Malay equivalents exist and are used elsewhere in the same file — "Fleet komputer kuantum IBM" (should be Armada) in the opening sentence, "facet teras", "lattice", and "hybrid cloud" alongside the translated "berbilang awan" — plus "suhu mutlak sifar" (word order inverted from the standard "sifar mutlak"), Indonesianisms ("mengantarkan era", mid-sentence capitalised "Anda"), and a kami/kita mix inside one sentence where English has a single "we". None of these would give a learner a false belief.

examples.source: handles the job orchestration and data transfer … a multi-cloud orchestration toolkit
examples.suggested: mengendalikan orkestrasi kerja … set alat orkestrasi berbilang awan
examples.translation: mengendalikan orkestra kerja dan pemindahan data … set alat orkestra berbilang awan
examples.why: "Orkestra" in Malay is the musical ensemble; the process noun is "orkestrasi". Reads as "the job orchestra", though a reader can still infer the intent, and it is at least consistent across both occurrences.

examples.source: Quantum-centric supercomputing means treating quantum as one piece of a broader HPC paradigm
examples.suggested: …bermaksud menganggap kuantum sebagai satu bahagian daripada paradigma HPC yang lebih luas
examples.translation: Superkomputer berpusatkan kuantum bermaksud merawat kuantum sebagai satu bahagian daripada paradigma HPC yang lebih luas
examples.why: "Merawat" is to treat medically / nurse. The abstract sense of "treat X as Y" is "menganggap" or "melayan" — a textbook false-friend calque in a key-takeaway bullet.

examples.source: we see quantum computing evolving to realize its full potential
examples.suggested: …berkembang untuk merealisasikan potensi penuhnya
examples.translation: kita melihat pengkomputeran kuantum berkembang untuk menyedari potensi penuhnya
examples.why: "Menyedari" means to become aware of, not to bring about. The English is about achieving the potential, not perceiving it.

examples.source: Key takeaways / You can keep these key takeaways in mind
examples.suggested: Intisari utama / Rumusan utama
examples.translation: Pengambilan utama / Anda boleh mengingati pengambilan utama ini
examples.why: "Pengambilan" is the act of taking or of recruitment; it is a literal calque of "takeaway" that no Malay technical writer would use as a section heading.

examples.source: The fleet of IBM quantum computers … a core facet of many algorithms … a lattice of interacting quantum two-choice systems … hybrid cloud middleware
examples.suggested: Armada komputer kuantum IBM … aspek teras … sebagai kekisi … perisian tengah awan hibrid
examples.translation: Fleet komputer kuantum IBM … adalah facet teras banyak algoritma … sebagai lattice sistem dua pilihan kuantum … perisian tengah hybrid cloud
examples.why: Four untranslated English words where standard Malay terms exist and are used elsewhere in the same file (the file already renders "multi-cloud" as "berbilang awan" and "middleware" as "perisian tengah", so "hybrid cloud" is an internal inconsistency).

examples.source: We purposely use the word "space" here because once we mention space, it is straightforward to think of a volume.
examples.suggested: Kami sengaja menggunakan perkataan "ruang" di sini kerana setelah kami menyebut ruang, …
examples.translation: Kami sengaja menggunakan perkataan "ruang" di sini kerana setelah kita menyebut ruang, mudah untuk memikirkan isipadu.
examples.why: Exclusive "kami" and inclusive "kita" alternate inside one sentence where the English has a single "we"; the same mix recurs between paragraphs ("Kami sengaja" vs "Kita mendefinisikannya"). Also note "Anda" is capitalised mid-sentence throughout, an Indonesian orthographic habit rather than Malay.

editor_note: Two structural drifts against the current EN source: the paragraph at EN line 196 that DEFINES the subobservable ("we obtain the subcircuits, as well as the subobservable, which is the portion of the original observable associated with each subcircuit") is missing entirely — the Arabic jumps straight from the `new_obs` output to the `partition_problem` code — while an extra paragraph that exists nowhere in the EN source has been inserted at AR line 187 ("غير أن عدد الكيوبتات في الدائرة قد ازداد بعد إدراج عمليات `Move` الافتراضية ذات الكيوبتين عقب القطع… عبر إدراج هويات"), which both duplicates the preceding paragraph and adds a "two-qubit Move operations / insert identities" claim the English never makes. On terminology, "observable" is rendered throughout (lines 170, 172, 187, 220) as الرصيد — a false friend meaning "bank balance / credit", not the conventional المؤثر المرصود / الكمية المرصودة — so the section heading reads "Construct and expand the balance"; and "Circuit-knitting" at line 29 is rendered قطع الدائرة ("circuit cutting"), collapsing the umbrella term into the specific method it is supposed to encompass. Smaller defects: upstream/downstream → الدائرة الأعلية (a non-word; العلوية was meant) / الدائرة الأدنى, the garbled clause يُدرج الإعداد `use_cut=True` في الدالة التعليم (line 147), نُظاهر for "we demonstrate" (should be نُظهر, line 323), and transpile → نقل ("move/transfer", line 239). Informal register (تأكد، لاحظ، اهتمامك) holds correctly throughout.

examples.source: Now the circuit can be partitioned along the `Move` gate and we obtain the subcircuits, as well as the subobservable, which is the portion of the original observable associated with each subcircuit.
examples.suggested: يمكن الآن تقسيم الدائرة عند بوابة `Move`، فنحصل على الدوائر الفرعية وكذلك على المؤثر المرصود الفرعي، وهو الجزء من المؤثر المرصود الأصلي المرتبط بكل دائرة فرعية. (وحذف الفقرة المُقحمة في السطر 187)
examples.translation: (missing) — instead AR 187 reads: غير أن عدد الكيوبتات في الدائرة قد ازداد بعد إدراج عمليات `Move` الافتراضية ذات الكيوبتين عقب القطع. لذا، يجب توسيع الرصيد أيضًا عبر إدراج هويات لمطابقة الدائرة الحالية.
examples.why: The EN paragraph that defines 'subobservable' is dropped, yet `subobservables` is used in the very next code cell and again in reconstruction — the learner meets an undefined object. In its place sits a paragraph absent from the current EN source that asserts two-qubit Move operations and identity insertion, content the English does not state. Content present in the source is gone and content not in the source is present.

examples.source: Construct and expand the observable / The observable, as defined before, will be the average of $Z$ on each qubit.
examples.suggested: بناء المؤثر المرصود وتوسيعه / المؤثر المرصود، كما عُرِّف سابقًا، هو متوسط $Z$ على كل كيوبت.
examples.translation: بناء الرصيد وتوسيعه / الرصيد، كما هو محدد سابقًا، سيكون متوسط $Z$ على كل كيوبت.
examples.why: رصيد is a false friend: it shares the root ر-ص-د with 'observe' but in modern usage means a bank balance / stock of credit. Rendered this way in every one of its ~8 occurrences, the heading reads 'Construct and expand the balance'. The conventional Arabic rendering of a quantum observable is المؤثر المرصود / الكمية المرصودة.

examples.source: Circuit-knitting is an umbrella term that encapsulates various methods of partitioning a circuit in multiple smaller subcircuits
examples.suggested: حياكة الدوائر (Circuit knitting) مصطلح شامل يضم أساليب متعددة لتقسيم الدائرة…
examples.translation: قطع الدائرة (Circuit-knitting) مصطلح شامل يضم أساليب متعددة لتقسيم الدائرة إلى دوائر فرعية أصغر
examples.why: 'Circuit knitting' is translated with the same words the file uses for 'circuit cutting' (قطع الدائرة / قطع الدوائر, e.g. إضافة Qiskit لقطع الدوائر in the same paragraph). The whole point of the sentence is that knitting is the umbrella and cutting is one method under it; the Arabic makes the umbrella term identical to its own subset.

examples.source: for each cut the upstream circuit must be measured in a Pauli basis, and the downstream circuit must be prepared in the eigenstate of the basis
examples.suggested: يجب عند كل قطع قياس الدائرة السابقة (المنبع) في أساس باولي، وتحضير الدائرة اللاحقة (المصب) في الحالة الذاتية لذلك الأساس
examples.translation: يجب قياس الدائرة الأعلية عند كل قطعة في أساس باولي، وتُحضَّر الدائرة الأدنى في الحالة الذاتية للأساس
examples.why: الأعلية is not an Arabic word (العلوية was presumably intended), and الأدنى does not agree with the feminine الدائرة (الدنيا). Even corrected, 'upper/lower circuit' is a spatial calque; upstream/downstream along a wire is normally السابقة/اللاحقة or المنبع/المصب. A native technical writer would not leave a coined non-word on a core procedural sentence.

examples.source: The MBL circuit is designed so that setting `use_cut=True` in the function inserts the annotation properly after $\frac{n}{2}$ qubits
examples.suggested: صُمِّمت دائرة MBL بحيث يؤدي ضبط `use_cut=True` في الدالة إلى إدراج التعليم في الموضع الصحيح بعد $\frac{n}{2}$ كيوبت
examples.translation: تم تصميم دائرة MBL بحيث يُدرج الإعداد `use_cut=True` في الدالة التعليم بشكل صحيح بعد $\frac{n}{2}$ كيوبت
examples.why: The object التعليم ('the annotation') is stranded after في الدالة with no case marking or particle, so the clause parses as 'the setting use_cut=True inserts in the function the annotation' — a word-order garble typical of MT that an Arabic editor would rewrite with يؤدي … إلى إدراج.

editor_note: Meaning is broadly faithful and the informal register (هيِّئ، ألحِق، إذا كنت تريد، برنامجك) holds throughout, but a native technical editor would rework several renderings. "circuit" is split three ways within the file — bare Latin `Circuit` ("يُخزِّن عادةً Circuit"، "Circuit نموذجية" with an Arabic feminine adjective glued to a Latin noun), Arabic "دائرة" always written with a detached article and space ("الـ دائرة"، "للـ دائرة الأصلية"), and plural "الـ Circuits المدخلة" (line 200). "job" in the shots admonition (line 77) is rendered "مهمة" — the exact word the page uses for the *tasks inside* a program ("المهمة الأولى"، "المهمة الثانية"), so "QuantumProgram منفصل، وهو سيكون مهمة منفصلة" flattens the job-vs-task distinction the caveat exists to make. Smaller items: "arguments" is "وسيطات" at line 55 but the non-technical "حجج" at line 139; "shots" is "تشغيلات", which collides with "تشغيل المهمة" (running the task) in the very same sentences at lines 206/222; and line 135 opens "تُنفَّذ عناصر الـ دائرة" / "عناصر الـ samplex", which reads as "the circuit's elements" rather than `CircuitItem`/`SamplexItem` objects, while "وزوجًا من samplex" reads as "a pair of samplexes" instead of the (template circuit, samplex) pair that `build()` returns.

examples.source: a circuit and its parameter values / A template circuit / the target circuit / the input circuits
examples.suggested: استقرّ على "دائرة/الدائرة/الدوائر" في كل الملف (بدون فصل أداة التعريف: "الدائرة" لا "الـ دائرة")
examples.translation: يُخزِّن عادةً Circuit وقيم معاملاتها / Circuit نموذجية / الـ دائرة المستهدفة / الـ Circuits المدخلة
examples.why: The same core term appears as Latin `Circuit`, Latin plural `Circuits`, and Arabic دائرة within one page, and the Arabic form is consistently written with a broken detached article ("الـ دائرة"), which no Arabic technical writer would produce.

examples.source: If you want a different shot value, you need a separate `QuantumProgram`, which would be a separate job.
examples.suggested: ... فأنت بحاجة إلى `QuantumProgram` منفصل، وهو ما يعني إرسال job (وظيفة تنفيذ) منفصلة.
examples.translation: إذا كنت تريد قيمة تشغيلات مختلفة، فأنت بحاجة إلى `QuantumProgram` منفصل، وهو سيكون مهمة منفصلة.
examples.why: "مهمة" is the word this page already assigns to the tasks *inside* a program (المهمة الأولى/الثانية), so the sentence now says a separate program is a separate task — contradicting the page's own hierarchy and losing the point that varying shots costs a whole new job submission.

examples.source: Circuit items are executed without any sort of randomization. On the contrary, samplex items let you specify how to randomize their content.
examples.suggested: تُنفَّذ عناصر `CircuitItem` دون أي تعشية. أما عناصر `SamplexItem` فتتيح لك تحديد كيفية تعشية محتواها.
examples.translation: تُنفَّذ عناصر الـ دائرة دون أي عشوائية. على العكس من ذلك، تتيح لك عناصر الـ samplex تحديد كيفية عشوائية محتواها.
examples.why: "عناصر الـ دائرة" reads as "the elements of the circuit" (i.e. its gates), not as the `CircuitItem` object type the section is about; the same genitive reading breaks "عناصر الـ samplex".

examples.source: full details about `samplex` and its arguments
examples.suggested: التفاصيل الكاملة حول `samplex` ووسيطاته
examples.translation: التفاصيل الكاملة حول `samplex` وحججه (line 139) vs. وسيطات للـ samplex (line 55)
examples.why: "حجج" is the debate sense of "arguments", not the programming sense, and it contradicts the correct "وسيطات" used earlier in the same file.

examples.source: append the target circuit, which was transpiled according to the backend's instruction set architecture (ISA)
examples.suggested: ألحِق الدائرة المستهدفة بعد ترجمتها (transpile) لتوافق معمارية مجموعة تعليمات الـ backend (ISA)
examples.translation: ألحِق الـ دائرة المستهدفة التي جرى Transpile لها وفق مجموعة تعليمات معمارية الـ Backend (ISA)
examples.why: "جرى Transpile لها" welds an untranslated English verb into an Arabic passive, and "مجموعة تعليمات معمارية الـ Backend" inverts the ISA compound; both are stiff calques a native technical writer would not produce.

examples.source: 1024 shots for every configuration / (parameter sets, shots, register bits) / only one shot is required
examples.suggested: 1024 لقطة (shot) لكل تهيئة / (مجموعات المعاملات، اللقطات، بتات السجل) / لأن لقطة واحدة فقط مطلوبة
examples.translation: 1024 تشغيلاً لكل تهيئة / (مجموعات المعاملات، التشغيلات، بتات السجل) / لأن تشغيلاً واحدًا فقط مطلوب
examples.why: Rendering "shots" as "تشغيلات" makes it identical to the word used for running a task in the same sentences ("نتائج تشغيل المهمة الأولى"), blurring two distinct concepts the shape tuple depends on.

editor_note: No semantic drift: the physics, the CNOT control/target convention, the little-endian statements, the four-outcome table and the ~95%/~5% noise discussion all match the English, and the informal "ty" register holds throughout (Prozkoumej, Všimni si, Měj na paměti, odkomentuj). What a native editor would fix: (a) the protagonist's name is split — "Alice/Alici/Alice a Bob" in the theory sections but "Alenčin stav", "Alence a Bobovi", "Alenčiny qubity" in Experiments 1–2 (and ungrammatical "mezi Alice a Bobem" instead of "mezi Alicí a Bobem" in the last discussion question); (b) "Qiskit" is declined two ways — correctly as "Qiskitu"/"v celém Qiskitu" early on, but as the non-existent stem "Qisku" three times later ("pomocí Qisku", "hradla Qisku", "V Qisku"), the last two also carrying agreement errors ("všechny logické hradla" → "všechna logická hradla"); (c) "multi-qubit gates" becomes the coined "vícekvantových hradel" ("multi-quantum") in the final Step-4 paragraph while the parallel Critical-concepts bullet correctly says "dvouqubitových hradel"; (d) scattered calques and slips — "for more background" → "pro více zázemí" (zázemí = facilities, not background knowledge), "Alice and Bob separate" → "Alice a Bob se rozloučí" (say goodbye, not part ways), the anglicism glosses "(entanglujeme)"/"(entanglované)" alongside the otherwise consistent "provázat", "job" as "úkol" in Steps 3 vs "úlohy" in the intro, and "Kvantová teleportace lze použít" (should be "Kvantovou teleportaci lze použít") in T/F question 1. None of these would mislead a learner about the protocol.

examples.source: the more gates you have, especially multi-qubit gates like swap gates, the more noise and errors you will encounter
examples.suggested: čím více hradel, zejména vícequbitových hradel jako jsou swap hradla, tím více šumu a chyb se projeví
examples.translation: čím více hradel, zejména vícekvantových hradel jako jsou swap hradla, tím více šumu a chyb se projeví
examples.why: "vícekvantový" (multi-quantum) is a coinage that does not exist in Czech quantum-computing usage; the standard term is "vícequbitový". The same file already writes "dvouqubitových hradel" correctly in the Critical-concepts bullet, so it is also internally inconsistent. The swap-gate example keeps the concept recognizable, hence minor.

examples.source: building our quantum circuit using Qiskit! / all logical gates in Qiskit / In Qiskit, qubits are ordered…
examples.suggested: pomocí Qiskitu / všechna logická hradla Qiskitu / V Qiskitu
examples.translation: sestavíme kvantový obvod pomocí Qisku! / všechny logické hradla Qisku / V Qisku jsou qubity…
examples.why: The product name is declined off a non-existent stem "Qisk-"; lines 23 and 77 of the same file already use the correct "Qiskitu". "všechny logické hradla" additionally breaks neuter-plural agreement ("všechna logická hradla").

examples.source: Alice's state / the qubits corresponding to Alice and Bob / Alice's qubits / the initial entangled state between Alice and Bob
examples.suggested: Alicin stav / qubity odpovídající Alici a Bobovi / Aliciny qubity / mezi Alicí a Bobem
examples.translation: Alenčin stav / qubity odpovídající Alence a Bobovi / Alenčiny qubity / mezi Alice a Bobem
examples.why: The character is "Alice" in the theory half but silently becomes the Czech diminutive "Alenka" (Alenčin, Alence) in the experiment half — two names for one protagonist in a teaching text. The last instance is also left undeclined ("mezi Alice a Bobem" instead of instrumental "mezi Alicí").

examples.source: for more background on quantum information, and more explanation about teleportation, we recommend John Watrous's course
examples.suggested: pro hlubší úvod do kvantové informace a podrobnější vysvětlení teleportace doporučujeme kurz Johna Watrouse
examples.translation: pro více zázemí o kvantové informaci a podrobnější vysvětlení teleportace doporučujeme kurz Johna Watrouse
examples.why: "zázemí" means facilities/backing, never "background knowledge" — a word-for-word calque of "background" that a Czech technical writer would never produce.

examples.source: __Alice and Bob separate:__ The two friends move their qubits to new locations
examples.suggested: __Alice a Bob se rozejdou:__ Oba přátelé přesunou své qubity na nová místa
examples.translation: __Alice a Bob se rozloučí:__ Oba přátelé přesunou své qubity na nová místa
examples.why: "rozloučit se" = say goodbye; the protocol step is physical separation ("rozejít se"). The same paragraph also drops the English qualifier "when we move quantum information around a lot", flattening the caveat to a generic "při přesouvání kvantové informace".

editor_note: The translation is faithful in substance (variational principle, the "horní odhad" for upper bound, SPSA's two function calls per iteration and the barren-plateau caveat all survive intact, informal "ty" holds throughout), but a native technical editor would change several things. Terminology: "single-qubit rotations" becomes "vrstvy jednobitových rotací" (single-BIT), even though the same file uses "qubitů" correctly elsewhere; and "circuit" is split within the file between an untranslated, capitalized, Czech-declined "Circuit" ("Abstraktní Circuit", "Cílový Circuit", "parametrů Circuitu", "optimalizovaného Circuitu") and the correct "obvod" ("našeho obvodu", "transpilovaného obvodu", "knihovny obvodů"). Wording/grammar slips a native writer would not produce: "intractable" rendered as "nesouditelným" (a non-word in this sense; expected "výpočetně neřešitelným"), the unvocalized preposition "v fyzice" twice (correct: "ve fyzice"), "To z něj činí přirozený kandidát" (should be accusative "přirozeného kandidáta"), "tyto omezení" (should be "tato omezení"), the imperative typo "Lad hyperparametry" (should be "Laď"), and "plánu učební rychlosti" for learning-rate schedule (Czech ML uses "rychlost učení"). Mild drift: the heading/first line "Large-scale hardware example" becomes "Příklad na velkém hardwaru" (an example on *large hardware*), which loses the scale contrast with the earlier "Příklad v malém měřítku"; the frontmatter description also adds "pomocí optimalizátoru SPSA", which the English does not say.

examples.source: which constructs layers of single-qubit rotations and entangling gates
examples.suggested: který konstruuje vrstvy jednoqubitových rotací a entanglujících hradel
examples.translation: který konstruuje vrstvy jednobitových rotací a entanglujících hradel
examples.why: "jednobitových" says single-BIT, conflating qubit with classical bit — the one distinction this material must keep crisp; the file itself uses "qubitů" correctly elsewhere (lines 37, 290).

examples.source: Input: Abstract circuit, observable / Output: Target circuit and observable / by optimizing the circuit parameters
examples.suggested: Vstup: Abstraktní obvod, observabilní veličina / Výstup: Cílový obvod a observabilní veličina / optimalizací parametrů obvodu
examples.translation: Vstup: Abstraktní Circuit, observabilní veličina / Výstup: Cílový Circuit a observabilní veličina / optimalizací parametrů Circuitu
examples.why: "circuit" is left untranslated and capitalized (and Czech-declined: "Circuitu") in Step 2/3, while the surrounding prose correctly says "obvod" ("pro náš obvod", "transpilovaného obvodu", "knihovny obvodů") — a within-file split of a core term that reads as an untranslated leak.

examples.source: Classically, computing the exact ground-state energy becomes intractable as the number of spins grows … This makes it a natural candidate for quantum simulation.
examples.suggested: Klasicky se výpočet přesné energie základního stavu stává s rostoucím počtem spinů výpočetně neřešitelným … Díky tomu je přirozeným kandidátem na kvantovou simulaci.
examples.translation: Klasicky se výpočet přesné energie základního stavu stává nesouditelným s rostoucím počtem spinů … To z něj činí přirozený kandidát pro kvantovou simulaci.
examples.why: "nesouditelný" ("un-judgeable") is not the Czech word for computationally intractable, and "činí přirozený kandidát" uses the wrong case (needs accusative "přirozeného kandidáta") — no Czech technical writer would produce either.

examples.source: one of the most widely studied models in condensed matter physics … is of fundamental importance in physics
examples.suggested: jedním z nejčastěji studovaných modelů ve fyzice kondenzované hmoty … má ve fyzice zásadní význam
examples.translation: jedním z nejrozšířeněji studovaných modelů v fyzice kondenzované hmoty … má v fyzice zásadní význam
examples.why: "v fyzice" is ungrammatical (Czech vocalizes the preposition: "ve fyzice"), twice; "nejrozšířeněji studovaných" is a stiff calque of "most widely studied".

examples.source: ## Large-scale hardware example — A large-scale hardware example is not included in this tutorial.
examples.suggested: ## Příklad ve velkém měřítku na hardwaru — Příklad ve velkém měřítku na hardwaru není v tomto tutoriálu zahrnut.
examples.translation: ## Příklad na velkém hardwaru — Příklad na velkém hardwaru není v tomto tutoriálu zahrnut.
examples.why: The Czech says "example on large hardware" — the scale attaches to the machine rather than to the example, and it loses the deliberate contrast with the earlier "Příklad v malém měřítku".

examples.source: **Tune SPSA hyperparameters:** Adjust the learning rate schedule parameters
examples.suggested: **Laď hyperparametry SPSA:** Uprav parametry plánu rychlosti učení
examples.translation: **Lad hyperparametry SPSA:** Uprav parametry plánu učební rychlosti
examples.why: "Lad" is missing the háček on the imperative ("Laď"), and "učební rychlost" inverts the standard Czech ML term "rychlost učení" for learning rate.

editor_note: Faithful and largely native overall — core terminology is correct and consistent (Hamiltonoperator, Schaltkreis, Variationsansatz, Impuls-/Ortsbasis, Grundzustandsenergie, transpilieren, Sampler Primitive), register is consistently informal "du", and no semantic inversion or hallucinated claim appears. But a native technical editor would change several things. The worst is "wobei $H_1$ aus Einköperpotentialen besteht … und $H_2$ aus Zweiköperpotentialen" for "one-body terms / two-body terms": "terms" is rendered as "Potentiale", which is factually the wrong object (in this SIAM, $H_1$ contains the hopping and hybridization terms, not potentials), and "Einköper-/Zweiköper-" is misspelled ("Köper" is a fabric weave; it must be "Einkörper-/Zweikörper-") — the very next sentence then correctly says "den Rest der Terme", so the file contradicts itself. Second, "one- and two-particle reduced density matrices" loses "reduced": "Ein- und Zweiteilchen-Dichtematrizen" should be "reduzierte Ein- und Zweiteilchen-Dichtematrizen" (RDMs are a distinct object from the density matrix). Smaller: "can be deep" is strengthened to "können sehr tief sein"; "circuit" is rendered as "Circuits" once (learning outcome 3) against "Schaltkreise" everywhere else; and a few calques/orthography slips ("die Schaltkreise zum Ziel-Backend zu transpilieren" instead of "für das Ziel-Backend", "folgendes verstehen" / "Als nächstes" should be capitalized).

examples.source: where $H_1$ consists of one-body terms, which are quadratic in the fermionic creation and annihilation operators, and $H_2$ consists of two-body terms, which are quartic.
examples.suggested: wobei $H_1$ aus Einkörpertermen besteht, die quadratisch in den fermionischen Erzeugungs- und Vernichtungsoperatoren sind, und $H_2$ aus Zweikörpertermen, die quartisch sind.
examples.translation: wobei $H_1$ aus Einköperpotentialen besteht, die quadratisch in den fermionischen Erzeugungs- und Vernichtungsoperatoren sind, und $H_2$ aus Zweiköperpotentialen, die quartisch sind.
examples.why: Two defects in one clause: "terms" is rendered as "Potentiale", which names the wrong object — $H_1$ here contains the hopping and hybridization terms, which are kinetic, not potentials — and "Einköper-/Zweiköper-" is a misspelling of "Einkörper-/Zweikörper-" ("Köper" = twill fabric). The file then contradicts itself two lines later with the correct "den Rest der Terme im Hamiltonoperator".

examples.source: You can compute the energy from the state vector using its one- and two-particle reduced density matrices
examples.suggested: Du kannst die Energie aus dem Zustandsvektor mithilfe seiner reduzierten Ein- und Zweiteilchen-Dichtematrizen berechnen
examples.translation: Du kannst die Energie aus dem Zustandsvektor mithilfe seiner Ein- und Zweiteilchen-Dichtematrizen berechnen
examples.why: The qualifier "reduced" is dropped. The reduced density matrix (RDM — cf. the code's rdm1/rdm2 and rdm(rank=…)) is a distinct object from the density matrix; without "reduziert" the learner is pointed at the wrong quantity.

examples.source: Such circuits can be deep, which makes this approach better for applications to lattice models.
examples.suggested: Solche Schaltkreise können tief sein, was diesen Ansatz besser für Anwendungen auf Gittermodelle macht.
examples.translation: Solche Schaltkreise können sehr tief sein, was diesen Ansatz besser für Anwendungen auf Gittermodelle macht.
examples.why: "sehr" is an added intensifier the English does not have; the original states a plain property ("can be deep"), not an emphatic one.

examples.source: How to combine samples from multiple circuits for post-processing with the sample-based Krylov diagonalization (SKQD) algorithm.
examples.suggested: Wie man Samples aus mehreren Schaltkreisen für die Nachverarbeitung mit dem sample-basierten Krylov-Diagonalisierungsalgorithmus (SKQD) kombiniert.
examples.translation: Wie man Samples aus mehreren Circuits für die Nachverarbeitung mit dem sample-basierten Krylov-Diagonalisierungsalgorithmus (SKQD) kombiniert.
examples.why: Within-file inconsistency: this is the only place "circuit" is left as "Circuits"; the rest of the file (including the neighbouring bullet "Zeitentwicklungsschaltkreise") uses "Schaltkreis(e)" throughout.

examples.source: Now, we use Qiskit to transpile the circuits to the target backend.
examples.suggested: Nun verwenden wir Qiskit, um die Schaltkreise für das Ziel-Backend zu transpilieren.
examples.translation: Nun verwenden wir Qiskit, um die Schaltkreise zum Ziel-Backend zu transpilieren.
examples.why: "zum … transpilieren" is a direct calque of English "transpile to"; German usage is "für ein Backend transpilieren". Same calque family as "Zeitentwicklung durch den Hamiltonoperator" (idiomatic German: "unter dem Hamiltonoperator"), which is at least used consistently.

editor_note: Nothing here would mislead a learner: the plan names, the "10 Minuten pro fortlaufendem 28-Tage-Fenster", the 400/10.000-Minuten thresholds, the us-east restriction and the "du"-register all hold, and product terms (Open Plan, Flex Plan, Quantum Circuits, QPUs, Kontingentgrenzen) are kept consistently. Three things a native technical editor would still change. (1) In the Flex-Plan paragraph the English hedge "consider the Pay-As-You-Go Plan instead" is flattened into a flat assertion — "ist der Pay-As-You-Go-Plan die Alternative" — which is jarring right after the parallel sentence that correctly renders "should consider" as "in Betracht ziehen"; the two sibling recommendations now sit at different strengths. (2) In the On-Prem section "classical quantum algorithms" becomes "klassisch-quantenmechanische Algorithmen", an over-translation into physics vocabulary that also splits from the file's own "Quantenalgorithmen" used two paragraphs earlier in the Premium section. (3) Smaller stiffness: "Wenn du Zugang zu mehreren Plänen benötigst" turns the English "want" into "need", and "im `QiskitRuntimeService`-Initialisierer" is a calqued noun German Qiskit users would write as "im Initializer" or "im Konstruktor".

examples.source: If you don't want to purchase 400 minutes, consider the Pay-As-You-Go Plan instead.
examples.suggested: Wenn du keine 400 Minuten kaufen möchtest, kommt stattdessen der Pay-As-You-Go-Plan in Betracht.
examples.translation: Wenn du keine 400 Minuten kaufen möchtest, ist der Pay-As-You-Go-Plan die Alternative.
examples.why: The hedged recommendation "consider" becomes a categorical statement ("is the alternative"), and it no longer parallels the immediately preceding sentence, which does render "should consider" as "in Betracht ziehen". Emphasis shift only — the steer is still toward Pay-As-You-Go — so MINOR, not misleading.

examples.source: This service is recommended for those who are exploring classical quantum algorithms and applications...
examples.suggested: ...die klassische und Quantenalgorithmen sowie -anwendungen erkunden...
examples.translation: Dieser Service wird für alle empfohlen, die klassisch-quantenmechanische Algorithmen und Anwendungen erkunden...
examples.why: "quantenmechanisch" is an over-translation into physics register for a term the field renders as "Quantenalgorithmen" — which this very file already uses in the Premium section ("Quantenalgorithmen sowie -anwendungen"). Within-file split of the same concept; still recognizable, so MINOR.

examples.source: If you want access to multiple plans... You can set preferred instances in the `QiskitRuntimeService` initializer...
examples.suggested: Wenn du Zugang zu mehreren Plänen möchtest... Du kannst bevorzugte Instanzen im `QiskitRuntimeService`-Initializer (bzw. Konstruktor)... festlegen.
examples.translation: Wenn du Zugang zu mehreren Plänen benötigst... Du kannst bevorzugte Instanzen im `QiskitRuntimeService`-Initialisierer... festlegen.
examples.why: "benötigst" upgrades "want" to "need"; "Initialisierer" is a literal calque of "initializer" that German Qiskit documentation would leave in English or call "Konstruktor". Both are stiffness/word-choice, not meaning loss.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no dropped caveats, informal "tú" holds ("Puedes proporcionar…", "consulta el material explicativo", "Reconstruye los valores esperados") — but English words leak into Spanish syntax in several places. The title and sidebar_label read "Gate Cutting para Reducir la Profundidad del Circuit" (English "Circuit" where the body correctly says "circuito"), and Step 1 says "Mapear el problema a circuits cuánticos" with an English plural inflected as Spanish. "Gate" is rendered inconsistently within the file: capitalized English "Gates" in lines 13, 90 and 132 ("cortando Gates distantes", "Reemplazar Gates distantes", "tres Gates CNOT") versus correct "puertas" in lines 67, 92 and 144 ("las puertas entre los qubits 3 y 0", "una por cada descomposición de puerta"). "Backend" is also mid-sentence capitalized throughout ("un Backend falso", "en uno o más Backends"), which a Spanish technical editor would lowercase. None of this misleads a learner; it is glossary-leak noise, not a semantic error.

examples.source: Gate Cutting to Reduce Circuit Depth
examples.suggested: Gate Cutting para reducir la profundidad del circuito
examples.translation: Gate Cutting para Reducir la Profundidad del Circuit
examples.why: English "Circuit" left untranslated inside an otherwise Spanish noun phrase, while the body text correctly uses "circuito" (e.g. line 13 "la profundidad de un circuito"). Reads as a glossary leak in the most visible string on the page.

examples.source: cutting distant gates / Replace distant gates / we cut three CNOT gates
examples.suggested: cortando puertas distantes / Reemplazar puertas distantes / cortamos tres puertas CNOT
examples.translation: cortando Gates distantes / Reemplazar Gates distantes / cortamos tres Gates CNOT
examples.why: Same term split within the file: capitalized English "Gates" in three places but correct Spanish "puertas" in three others ("las puertas entre los qubits 3 y 0", "una por cada descomposición de puerta", "después de cortar las puertas distantes"). The concept stays identifiable, so MINOR, but the split is jarring.

examples.source: Map problem to quantum circuits and operators
examples.suggested: Mapear el problema a circuitos cuánticos y operadores
examples.translation: Mapear el problema a circuits cuánticos y operadores
examples.why: English plural "circuits" carrying a Spanish adjective ("circuits cuánticos") is a hybrid no native technical writer would produce; the same list item then correctly writes "un circuito cuántico" one line below.

examples.source: either a fake backend or a hardware backend / one or more backends
examples.suggested: un backend simulado (fake) o un backend de hardware / uno o más backends
examples.translation: un Backend falso o un Backend de hardware / uno o más Backends
examples.why: Mid-sentence capitalization of "Backend" is an English-title-case habit; Spanish keeps borrowed common nouns lowercase. "Backend falso" is also a slightly literal rendering of the Qiskit term of art "fake backend".

editor_note: Nothing misleading: every figure, date and version checks out (68 ns frente a 138 ns; 250 µs a 4 ms; 20-500 → 20-2000 µs; 2,15e-3 con 57 de 176; "no será eliminada antes del 30 de septiembre de 2024" correctly renders "removed no sooner than"), and the domain terms are right and consistent (qubit, puertas de dos qubits, valores esperados, mitigación/supresión de errores, twirling de Pauli, primitivo used uniformly for Sampler/Estimator/Executor). What a native editor would still change: (1) "¡incluida tú!" (línea ~247) gratuitously genders the reader feminine where EN is just "including you"; (2) the recurring clumsy "recuperar datos de trabajos de trabajos pasados importantes" (líneas ~149, ~279, ~384); (3) "pipeline" is rendered three ways in the SDK/Functions sections — "cadena del compilador", "canales de transpilación", "canalización modular" — and "canales" is the weak one ("canal" = channel); (4) the calque "en o alrededor del 2 de junio de 2025" (~484) where every other instance in the file uses the natural "en torno al"; (5) the same English sentence about Qiskit Code Assistant is opened once with the dangling "Basándose en los comentarios..." (~98) and once with the correct "Según los comentarios..." (~672). All are polish items; none changes what a learner would take away.

examples.source: ...helps capture the needs and concerns of anyone who works with quantum software - including you!
examples.suggested: ...cualquier persona que trabaje con software cuántico, ¡tú incluido!
examples.translation: ...ayuda a capturar las necesidades e inquietudes de cualquier persona que trabaje con software cuántico, ¡incluida tú!
examples.why: 'incluida tú' forces a feminine reader where the English 'you' is neutral; a native writer would use '¡tú incluido!' or '¡incluyéndote a ti!'. Reads as a concordance slip, not a deliberate inclusive choice, since the rest of the file addresses the reader neutrally.

examples.source: If you would like to retrieve job data from important past jobs, please refer to the following documentation.
examples.suggested: Si deseas recuperar los datos de trabajos anteriores importantes, consulta la siguiente documentación.
examples.translation: Si deseas recuperar datos de trabajos de trabajos pasados importantes, consulta la siguiente documentación.
examples.why: 'datos de trabajos de trabajos pasados' stutters the word 'trabajos' twice in five words — a literal mapping of 'job data from past jobs' that no Spanish technical writer would leave in, and it repeats three times in the file.

examples.source: ...without rebuilding the entire compiler pipeline / build transpilation pipelines / a modular pipeline
examples.suggested: Use one rendering, e.g. 'canalización del compilador' / 'canalizaciones de transpilación' / 'canalización modular'
examples.translation: ...sin reconstruir toda la cadena del compilador / construir canales de transpilación para futuras QPUs / una canalización modular
examples.why: 'pipeline' is rendered three different ways within the file, and 'canales de transpilación' is the weakest: 'canal' means channel, which collides with the unrelated 'nuevo canal para la plataforma' (new channel) used elsewhere in the same page.

examples.source: the following capabilities are now deprecated and will be no longer supported on or around 2 June 2025
examples.suggested: ...ya no serán compatibles en torno al 2 de junio de 2025
examples.translation: las siguientes capacidades quedan obsoletas y ya no serán compatibles en o alrededor del 2 de junio de 2025
examples.why: 'en o alrededor del' is a word-for-word calque of 'on or around'; every other occurrence of that same English phrase in this file is correctly rendered 'en torno al' (lines ~117, ~147, ~255, ~277, ~379), so this one is both stiff and inconsistent.

examples.source: Based on feedback and usage patterns, more users are running Qiskit Code Assistant models locally...
examples.suggested: Use 'Según los comentarios y los patrones de uso...' in both places.
examples.translation: Basándose en los comentarios y los patrones de uso, más usuarios ejecutan los modelos... (~98) / Según los comentarios y los patrones de uso, más usuarios ejecutan los modelos... (~672)
examples.why: The identical English sentence appears twice and is translated two ways; the first uses a dangling gerund ('Basándose') whose implied subject is 'más usuarios', which is not what the English means. The second version at line ~672 is the correct one.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift found: the broadcasting rules, the shot-count caveat ("Les shots ne sont **pas** répartis entre les configurations… 10 240 shots exécutés au total"), the `shape`-vs-implicit-shape direction ("diffusable *à partir de* tes formes extrinsèques d'entrée") and every table row all match the English, and the informal "tu" register holds everywhere. Two editorial defects: "gate" is rendered inconsistently within the file — "le twirling de portes" in the Randomisation intro, but "applique des gates aléatoires" in the following Admonition, where the English loanword is both unidiomatic and contradicts the choice made three lines earlier. Second, "demonstrates" is calqued twice as "démontre" ("Cet exemple démontre l'idée de base", "L'exemple suivant démontre le comportement par défaut") where a native technical writer writes "illustre"; likewise the Next-steps bullet "Comprends les entrées et sorties Executor" is a word-for-word imperative that reads oddly in French. None of this misleads a learner.

examples.source: applies random gates … (for example, gate twirling)
examples.suggested: applique des portes aléatoires
examples.translation: applique des gates aléatoires … (par exemple, le twirling de portes)
examples.why: Within-file inconsistency: 'gate' is 'portes' at line 165 but the English 'gates' at line 174. 'portes' is the standard French term and is already the file's own choice.

examples.source: This example demonstrates the core idea. / The following example demonstrates the default behavior:
examples.suggested: Cet exemple illustre l'idée de base. / L'exemple suivant illustre le comportement par défaut :
examples.translation: Cet exemple démontre l'idée de base. / L'exemple suivant démontre le comportement par défaut :
examples.why: 'démontrer' in French means to prove/establish; for an example that shows something, native technical writing uses 'illustrer' or 'montrer'. Classic English calque.

examples.source: Understand [Executor inputs and outputs].
examples.suggested: Familiarise-toi avec les [entrées et sorties de l'Executor].
examples.translation: Comprends les [entrées et sorties Executor].
examples.why: Literal imperative 'Comprends' is not idiomatic French for a documentation call-to-action; it reads as machine-rendered. The missing 'de l'' before 'Executor' also makes the noun phrase stiff.

examples.source: **Intrinsic axes** (rightmost) … **Extrinsic axes** (leftmost)
examples.suggested: **Axes intrinsèques** (les plus à droite) … **Axes extrinsèques** (les plus à gauche)
examples.translation: **Axes intrinsèques** (à droite) … **Axes extrinsèques** (à gauche)
examples.why: The superlative in 'rightmost/leftmost' is what pins the axes to the ends of the shape tuple; 'à droite'/'à gauche' merely says 'on the right/left'. Context still makes it clear, so this is a nuance loss, not an error.

editor_note: The translation is faithful and readable, and the informal "tu" convention holds throughout with no "vous/votre/veuillez" slips; the delicate precedence list (PUB > `run` keyword > twirling product > `default_shots` > `default_precision`), the twirling failure caveat, and the counter-intuitive "plus la précision est faible, plus le temps QPU est long" are all rendered correctly. Core terminology is kept in English consistently where the field does so (shots, job, PUB, twirling, backend, Estimator), and "mitigation/suppression d'erreurs", "portes", "qubits", "découplage dynamique" are consistent. What a native technical editor would still change: (1) the `<Admonition title="Notes about specifying options in the Estimator primitives">` prop is left entirely in English while its bullet list is translated — a visible untranslated string; (2) `environment.job_tags` "List of tags" becomes "Liste de balises", and "balise" is the markup-tag sense in French, not a job label ("étiquettes"/"tags" is the right word); (3) `simulator.basis_gates` "List of basis gate names to unroll to" becomes "Liste des noms de portes de base à déplier", which drops the "to" and reads as the gates *being* unrolled rather than the target basis they unroll *into*; (4) a handful of calques — "les exigences suivantes" for package requirements, "Spécifiquement," opening a sentence, "répartir les shots parmi les num_randomizations", "les entangleurs non-Clifford", plus an inconsistent capitalized "un Backend" in the `simulator` entry against lowercase backend elsewhere.

examples.source: <Admonition type="note" title="Notes about specifying options in the Estimator primitives">
examples.suggested: title="Remarques sur la spécification des options dans les primitives Estimator"
examples.translation: <Admonition type="note" title="Notes about specifying options in the Estimator primitives">
examples.why: The admonition's visible title is left in English while every bullet inside it is translated — an obvious untranslated leftover on a rendered heading, not an intentional keep-English technical term.

examples.source: List of tags.
examples.suggested: Liste d'étiquettes (tags).
examples.translation: Liste de balises.
examples.why: This documents `environment.job_tags`. In French, "balise" means a markup/HTML tag or a beacon, never a user-applied label on a job; "étiquettes" or the borrowed "tags" is the conventional rendering and is what the rest of the ecosystem uses.

examples.source: **Choices**: List of basis gate names to unroll to
examples.suggested: Liste des noms de portes de base vers lesquelles déplier (base cible)
examples.translation: **Choix** : Liste des noms de portes de base à déplier
examples.why: The English "to unroll to" names the TARGET basis; "portes de base à déplier" reads as the gates that are themselves to be unrolled, i.e. the input rather than the destination. The directionality of the option is lost.

examples.source: The code on this page was developed using the following requirements.
examples.suggested: Le code de cette page a été développé avec les dépendances (versions) suivantes.
examples.translation: Le code de cette page a été développé avec les exigences suivantes.
examples.why: "Requirements" here means pinned package dependencies (a requirements file), not demands. "Exigences" is a straight calque that a French technical writer would never use for a `qiskit[all]~=2.4.0` version list.

examples.source: Specifically, for any Estimator PUB: … unable to allocate the shots among the specified num_randomizations. … Does not work with non-Clifford entanglers.
examples.suggested: Plus précisément, pour tout PUB d'Estimator : … de répartir les shots entre les `num_randomizations` spécifiés. … avec les portes d'intrication non-Clifford.
examples.translation: Spécifiquement, pour tout PUB d'Estimator : … incapable de répartir les shots parmi les `num_randomizations` spécifiés. … Ne fonctionne pas avec les entangleurs non-Clifford.
examples.why: Three small calques in a row: sentence-initial "Spécifiquement" for "Specifically", "répartir parmi" for "allocate among" (French takes "répartir entre"), and the coined "entangleurs", which is not established French quantum vocabulary.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inverted negations, no swapped quantities, the "does not increase exponentially" caveat, the ~16 mH / 1.6 mH figures, the "samples were pure noise" caveat and the 36-qubit / 127-qubit numbers all survive intact — so nothing here misleads a learner about the physics or the workflow. What a native technical editor would change is terminology and idiom: "diagonalization" is consistently rendered as אלכסון ("a diagonal", the geometric noun) where Hebrew math uses לִכְסוּן ("אלכסון ההמילטוניאן המוטל", "הטלה ואלכסון"); "eigenstate" appears as the half-transliterated מצב הייגן instead of the standard מצב עצמי; "keyword arguments" becomes ארגומנטים מילוליים, which reads as "literal arguments" — a different programming concept — and "PySCF's implementation of selected CI" is re-parsed as מימוש של PySCF לבחירת CI ("implementation for selecting CI"), turning a method name into an action. Idiom slips: "we have commented out the code" → הגבנו בהערה את הקוד (הגיב = "responded"), heavy-hex → the hybrid hex-כבד, "every 4th orbital" → בין כל אורביטל 4, plus calqued חומרה מטרה / לדוגמה זו, the literary מולקולתנו, and a gender error in Backend מדומה בת 127 qubit. All recoverable from context; none teaches a false concept.

examples.source: The example below also shows how to pass keyword arguments to that function via the included solver.
examples.suggested: הדוגמה למטה מראה גם כיצד להעביר ארגומנטים של מילות מפתח (keyword arguments) לפונקציה זו דרך הפותר הכלול.
examples.translation: הדוגמה למטה מראה גם כיצד להעביר ארגומנטים מילוליים לפונקציה זו דרך הפותר הכלול.
examples.why: מילולי in Hebrew CS means "literal" — a distinct concept from keyword arguments. The reader gets the right idea only from the surrounding code (max_cycle=...), not from the term.

examples.source: The solver included in the SQD addon uses PySCF's implementation of selected CI
examples.suggested: ...משתמש במימוש של PySCF ל-selected CI (אינטראקציית קונפיגורציות נבחרת)
examples.translation: הפותר הכלול ב-addon של SQD משתמש במימוש של PySCF לבחירת CI
examples.why: "selected CI" is the name of a method; לבחירת CI reads as "for selecting CI", i.e. choosing among CI variants. The linked pyscf.fci.selected_ci is what rescues it.

examples.source: sample-based quantum diagonalization / Project and diagonalize the molecular Hamiltonian / the diagonalization of the Hamiltonian projected into the subspace
examples.suggested: לִכְסוּן קוונטי מבוסס דגימות / הטלה ולכסון של ההמילטוניאן המולקולרי / לכסון ההמילטוניאן המוטל
examples.translation: גישת אלכסון קוונטי מבוסס דגימות / הטלה ואלכסון של ההמילטוניאן המולקולרי / אלכסון ההמילטוניאן המוטל על תת-המרחב
examples.why: אלכסון is the noun "diagonal"; the linear-algebra operation is לכסון. Consistently wrong, so recognizable to a physicist, but it is not the term a Hebrew technical writer would use.

examples.source: SQD is known to work well when the target eigenstate is sparse ... yields a good approximation to the target eigenstate.
examples.suggested: ...כאשר המצב העצמי המבוקש הוא דליל ... מניב קירוב טוב למצב העצמי המבוקש.
examples.translation: ידוע ש-SQD עובד היטב כאשר מצב הייגן המטרה הוא דליל ... מניב קירוב טוב למצב הייגן המטרה.
examples.why: מצב עצמי is the established Hebrew term; הייגן is an odd half-transliteration of "eigen", and המטרה postposed as an adjective is a calque of "target eigenstate".

examples.source: Note: We have commented out the code for running the circuit on a QPU and left it for the user's reference.
examples.suggested: הערה: סימנו כהערה את הקוד להרצת המעגל על QPU והשארנו אותו לעיון המשתמש.
examples.translation: הערה: הגבנו בהערה את הקוד להרצת המעגל על QPU והשארנו אותו כעזר למשתמש.
examples.why: הגיב means "responded/reacted"; הגבנו בהערה is a false-friend calque of "comment out" that no Hebrew developer would write (סימנו כהערה / הפכנו להערה).

examples.source: As our target IBM hardware has a heavy-hex topology ... due the heavy-hex connectivity of the target hardware ... connections between every 4th orbital (0, 4, 8, etc.)
examples.suggested: מכיוון שלחומרת היעד של IBM יש טופולוגיית heavy-hex ... בשל קישוריות ה-heavy-hex של חומרת היעד ... חיבורים בין כל אורביטל רביעי (0, 4, 8, וכו')
examples.translation: מכיוון שלחומרת IBM המטרה שלנו יש טופולוגיית hex-כבד ... בשל הקישוריות של hex-כבד של החומרה המטרה ... חיבורים בין כל אורביטל 4 (0, 4, 8, וכו')
