examples.suggested: … لأنه لا يتأثر بالإزاحات الكلية ولا بتغيير مقياس نطاق القيم القابلة للتحقيق.
examples.translation: يُستخدم هذا المقياس لأنه لا يتأثر بالإزاحات الكلية والقياس في نطاق القيم القابلة للتحقيق.
examples.why: القياس reads as 'measurement', so the sentence says the metric is unaffected by measurement rather than by rescaling of the range — the very property being defined. The next sentence (زيادة انتشارها = increasing the spread) restores the intuition, which keeps this below the misleading threshold.

examples.source: ## Sampler primitive / Use Fire Opal Performance Management's Sampler primitive
examples.suggested: ## بدائية Sampler / استخدم بدائية Sampler في Fire Opal Performance Management
examples.translation: ## Sampler primitive {#sampler-primitive} / استخدم Sampler primitive في Fire Opal Performance Management
examples.why: The parallel Estimator section is translated (## بدائية Estimator / استخدم بدائية Estimator) while the Sampler section leaves 'primitive' in English in both the heading and the body, and بدائيات is used for the term everywhere else in the page. Same-page split of one term.

examples.source: Published algorithmic benchmarking results … prior benchmarking runs on `ibm_fez`
examples.suggested: نتائج قياس الأداء المرجعي للخوارزميات المنشورة … عمليات قياس الأداء المرجعي السابقة
examples.translation: نتائج معيارية الخوارزميات المنشورة … عمليات المعيارية السابقة على `ibm_fez`
examples.why: معيارية is a coinage meaning 'normativity/standardness'; it does not carry 'benchmarking' for an Arabic technical reader, who expects قياس الأداء المرجعي or اختبارات الأداء. The section heading ## المعايير for 'Benchmarks' has the same weakness.

examples.source: so you can easily swap in the Q-CTRL Sampler and Estimator
examples.suggested: بحيث يمكنك بسهولة استخدام Sampler وEstimator من Q-CTRL بدلًا من بدائيات Qiskit Runtime
examples.translation: بحيث يمكنك استبدال Sampler وEstimator من Q-CTRL بسهولة
examples.why: استبدال X (with no بـ) is directionally ambiguous in Arabic and is most naturally read as 'replace the Q-CTRL Sampler and Estimator' — the opposite of 'swap in'. Context makes the intent recoverable, but a native writer would write بحيث يمكنك بسهولة استخدام Sampler وEstimator من Q-CTRL بدلًا منها.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no inverted conditions, the physics (viskózní/neviskózní Burgersova rovnice, rovnice zachování, rázové vlny, Navier-Stokesovy rovnice) is correct, and the informal "ty" register holds consistently (Vezmi na vědomí, ujisti se, Autentizuj se, Můžeš). What a Czech technical editor would fix: English glossary leaks left capitalized mid-sentence — "počáteční parametry Circuit", "12 parametrů Circuit", "Ekvivalentem našeho Circuit" (should be "obvodu"/"parametry obvodu"), plus "jak zadat Backend" and "optimizer založený na gradientech" (Czech: optimalizátor). "shots" is rendered as "vzorky (shots)" and then bare "počet vzorků", which collides with the literal `samples` key in the printed output — "počet měření" or plain "shots" would be safer. One real grammar slip: "ztrátu pod 0,0015 lze dosáhnout" needs genitive ("ztráty ... lze dosáhnout"), and "lze všudypřítomně popsat pomocí PDE" is a calque of "can be ubiquitously described" that no Czech author would write.

examples.source: which are initial circuit parameters for a given qubit number and depth
examples.suggested: což jsou počáteční parametry obvodu pro daný počet qubitů a hloubku
examples.translation: což jsou počáteční parametry Circuit pro daný počet qubitů a hloubku
examples.why: "circuit" is left as a capitalized English word inside Czech prose (a glossary leak) in three places; the established Czech term is "(kvantový) obvod". Recognizable, so not misleading, but visibly untranslated.

examples.source: The shots are also part of the parameters with a default value
examples.suggested: Počet měření (shots) je také součástí parametrů s výchozí hodnotou
examples.translation: Vzorky (shots) jsou také součástí parametrů s výchozí hodnotou
examples.why: "vzorky" literally means "samples" and clashes with the `samples` key actually printed in the job output on the same page; Czech Qiskit material normally keeps "shots" or uses "počet měření/opakování".

examples.source: That means a loss below 0.0015 can be reached after 28 iterations
examples.suggested: To znamená, že ztráty pod 0,0015 lze dosáhnout po 28 iteracích
examples.translation: To znamená, že ztrátu pod 0,0015 lze dosáhnout po 28 iteracích
examples.why: "dosáhnout" governs the genitive, not the accusative — "ztrátu ... lze dosáhnout" is a plain grammar error a native writer would not produce.

examples.source: can be ubiquitously described by Partial Differential Equations (PDEs)
examples.suggested: lze prakticky bez výjimky popsat pomocí parciálních diferenciálních rovnic (PDE)
examples.translation: lze všudypřítomně popsat pomocí parciálních diferenciálních rovnic (PDE)
examples.why: Word-for-word calque: an adverb meaning "everywhere-present" cannot modify "popsat" in Czech; the sentence reads as machine output even though its meaning survives.

examples.source: This tutorial covers the user experience from two perspectives
examples.suggested: Tento tutoriál se na práci uživatele dívá ze dvou úhlů
examples.translation: Tento tutoriál pokrývá uživatelský pohled ze dvou perspektiv
examples.why: "pohled ... z perspektiv" stacks two near-synonyms and "pokrývá" is a calque of "covers"; stiff but not inaccurate.

editor_note: No misleading drift — every step, option and caveat matches the English, and the informal "ty" register holds throughout ("musíš", "najdeš", "Definuj", "Procvič si"). The defects are glossary leaks and inconsistency: "circuit" is rendered three ways in the same file — "obvod" (l. 24, 43), untranslated capitalized "Circuit" in the H2 "Vytvoření QASM Circuit" and in "Definuj QASM kvantový Circuit" (l. 22, 26) — and "gates" leaks as an uninflected "Gate" in "přidání parametrizovaných Gate" (l. 231), where Czech needs the genitive plural "hradel"; "backend" appears as capitalized "Backendy" mid-sentence (l. 20, 206). There is also a real grammar error, "data broadcastovaná do tohoto obvod" (l. 46, must be "obvodu"), inside a half-translated "primitive unified bloků (PUB)". Smaller: "dynamické odpřahování" for dynamical decoupling is a literal-but-unidiomatic coinage ("odpřahování" = unhitching a trailer), l. 112 inserts "kvantových dat" that the English does not have and flattens "related to model training" to "při tréninku modelu", and "Upozorňujeme, že…" (l. 335) slips into the formal we-form.

examples.source: ## 2. Create a QASM circuit … Define a QASM quantum circuit:
examples.suggested: ## 2. Vytvoření QASM obvodu … Definuj kvantový obvod v QASM:
examples.translation: ## 2. Vytvoření QASM Circuit … Definuj QASM kvantový Circuit:
examples.why: English "Circuit" is left untranslated and capitalized here while the very next paragraphs use the correct Czech "obvod" (l. 24, 43) — a within-file split of the file's central term, and "QASM kvantový Circuit" is not word order a Czech technical writer would produce.

examples.source: ### 3. Create a quantum circuit and add parameterized gates
examples.suggested: ### 3. Vytvoření kvantového obvodu a přidání parametrizovaných hradel
examples.translation: ### 3. Vytvoření kvantového obvodu a přidání parametrizovaných Gate
examples.why: "gates" leaks as an uninflected English noun; Czech requires the genitive plural of the conventional domain term "hradlo" → "hradel", otherwise the phrase does not agree grammatically with "parametrizovaných".

examples.source: Each PUB is a tuple that contains one circuit and the data broadcasted to that circuit
examples.suggested: Každý PUB je n-tice obsahující jeden obvod a data, která se do tohoto obvodu rozesílají
examples.translation: Každý PUB je n-tice, která obsahuje jeden obvod a data broadcastovaná do tohoto obvod
examples.why: Outright declension error ("tohoto obvod" instead of "obvodu"), plus the calque "broadcastovaná" and the half-translated "primitive unified bloků (PUB)" in the preceding sentence — a native technical editor would rewrite the whole sentence.

examples.source: This typically results in quantum pre-processing overhead related to model training, and classical post-processing overhead …
examples.suggested: To obvykle vede k režii kvantového předzpracování souvisejícího s trénováním modelu a k režii klasického následného zpracování …
examples.translation: To obvykle vede k režii předběžného zpracování kvantových dat při tréninku modelu a režii klasického post-processingu …
examples.why: "quantum pre-processing" becomes "předběžné zpracování kvantových dat" — the adjective is reattached to invented "data" — and "related to model training" is weakened to "při tréninku modelu" ("during training"), which changes the stated relationship; the mixed "post-processing" left in English next to a translated "předběžné zpracování" is also inconsistent.

examples.source: Note that Open Plan users cannot submit session jobs.
examples.suggested: Pozor: uživatelé Open Planu nemohou odesílat úlohy v režimu Session.
examples.translation: Upozorňujeme, že uživatelé Open Planu nemohou odesílat úlohy Session.
examples.why: The file otherwise addresses the reader consistently with informal "ty"; "Upozorňujeme" switches to an institutional we-form typical of formal corporate notices.

editor_note: Faithful, natural German throughout with consistent domain terms (unitary operation→unitäre Operation, gate→Gatter/Zwei-Qubit-Gatter, circuit→Schaltkreis, transpile→Transpiler/Transpilierung, "Optimierungslevel"); the load-bearing math sentence "deren Adjungierte der Inversen entspricht" and the caveat about "tiefe Schaltkreise … auf verrauschten Quantencomputern" both preserve the English meaning exactly, and the informal "du" register holds ("Wenn du daher eine effiziente Zerlegung … kennst", "Sieh dir ein Beispiel … an").

Broadly faithful, natural and consistently informal ("dein Datensatz", "Du könntest dein neuronales Netz starten"), with solid domain terminology (Merkmalsraum, Entscheidungsgrenze, Hyperebene, positiv semidefinite Kernelmatrix, "Ausspuren von Qubits" for tracing out) — but a native technical editor would still change several things. "Setting" is calqued as "die klassische Machine-Learning-Einstellung" (line 32), a false friend meaning attitude/device-configuration; the same word is rendered correctly as "Im klassischen Kontext" at line 162, so the file is inconsistent with itself. "Feature map" is rendered "Merkmalsabbildung" everywhere (lines 66, 75, 88, 90, 102) except line 60, where it becomes "Gaußsche Merkmalskarten", and the section heading "Quantenkerne" (line 100, reads as quantum nuclei/cores in a physics text) clashes with "Quantenkernels" / "Quantenkernel-Schätzung" / "Kernelfunktion" in the body. One hedge is lost: EN "the kernel might still be very efficiently computable" becomes the flat assertion "der Kernel wäre dennoch sehr effizient berechenbar" (line 90). Plus minor clunkiness: "wir lassen vieles der Nuancen weg" (line 14) and "mit Methoden wie quadratischer Programmierungssoftware" (line 98). None of these teaches a false concept.

examples.source: This is precisely the classical machine learning setting.
examples.suggested: Das ist genau das klassische Machine-Learning-Szenario. (oder: der klassische Machine-Learning-Kontext)
examples.translation: Das ist genau die klassische Machine-Learning-Einstellung.
examples.why: "Einstellung" is a false friend for "setting": in German it means attitude or a device/parameter setting, never a scenario or context. The same English word is correctly rendered "Im klassischen Kontext" at line 162, so the file contradicts itself.

examples.source: classical Gaussian feature maps are already infinite-dimensional
examples.suggested: klassische Gaußsche Merkmalsabbildungen sind bereits unendlichdimensional
examples.translation: klassische Gaußsche Merkmalskarten bereits unendlichdimensional
examples.why: "Feature map" is rendered "Merkmalsabbildung" in every other occurrence (lines 66, 75, 88, 90, 102). "Karte" is a map as in a chart, not a mathematical mapping; the one-off split is both wrong and inconsistent.

examples.source: ### Quantum kernels
examples.suggested: ### Quantenkernel
examples.translation: ### Quantenkerne
examples.why: The body immediately below uses „Quantenkernels", "Quantenkernel-Schätzung", "Kernelfunktion", "Kernelmatrix". "Quantenkerne" reads in a physics context as quantum nuclei/cores, so the heading pulls a core term in a misleading direction relative to its own section.

examples.source: In fact, the feature mapped vectors could even be infinite dimensional, but the kernel might still be very efficiently computable.
examples.suggested: ... und der Kernel könnte dennoch sehr effizient berechenbar sein.
examples.translation: Die merkmalsabgebildeten Vektoren könnten sogar unendlichdimensional sein, und der Kernel wäre dennoch sehr effizient berechenbar.
examples.why: "might still be" is a possibility; "wäre dennoch" states it as a fact, and the contrastive "but" is flattened to "und". The hedged claim becomes a general guarantee that infinite-dimensional feature maps always yield efficiently computable kernels.

examples.source: This is only a cursory overview, and we will skip a great deal of nuance.
examples.suggested: Dies ist nur ein grober Überblick, und wir lassen viele Feinheiten aus.
examples.translation: Dies ist nur ein grober Überblick, und wir lassen vieles der Nuancen weg.
examples.why: "vieles der Nuancen" is not idiomatic German (partitive genitive misused with a plural count noun); a native technical writer would write "viele Feinheiten" or "viele Details".

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — the precedence list (1–5), the twirling failure caveat ("el trabajo falla si `twirling` está habilitado y el producto ... es menor que los shots necesarios"), and the inverse precision/QPU-time note all track the English exactly, and informal "tú" holds with no usted slips. Four things a native technical editor would still change. (1) The option-table label "**Choices**" is rendered "**Opciones**" in all ~40 accordion entries, colliding with the page's own subject word: every block reads "Opciones: Entero >= 0" where the field actually means allowed values — "**Valores**" / "**Valores admitidos**" is the standard rendering and avoids the ambiguity. (2) "job" is split within the file: "el trabajo falla" and "Limita cuánto tiempo puede ejecutarse un trabajo" vs. "en un solo job" and "en qué modo de ejecución ejecutar tu job". (3) "ground state" → "estado base" instead of the conventional "estado fundamental". (4) "non-Clifford entanglers" → "entangladores no-Clifford", an invented noun where "compuertas/puertas de entrelazamiento no Clifford" is the usual phrasing. None of these mislead a learner.

examples.source: **Choices**: Integer >= 0
examples.suggested: **Valores**: Entero >= 0  (o **Valores admitidos**)
examples.translation: **Opciones**: Entero >= 0
examples.why: The whole page is about *options*; reusing "Opciones" for the "Choices" field means each entry reads "option X — Opciones: ...", where the label actually introduces the admissible values, not further options. Pervasive (every accordion item), so it is a systematic label choice, not a one-off.

examples.source: the job fails / Limits how long a job can run / in a single job / what execution mode to run your job in
examples.suggested: Pick one and use it throughout — "job" (loanword, matching the file's other kept-English terms shots/twirling/gates) or "trabajo".
examples.translation: el trabajo falla / puede ejecutarse un trabajo ... vs ... en un solo job / ejecutar tu job
examples.why: Within-file split of a core runtime term: the same object is 'trabajo' in the precision caveat and max_execution_time entry but 'job' in the compatibility intro and Next steps. Recognizable either way, but a reader tracking the term sees two words for one concept.

examples.source: Whether to reset the qubits to the ground state for each shot.
examples.suggested: Si se deben restablecer los qubits al estado fundamental para cada shot.
examples.translation: Si se deben restablecer los qubits al estado base para cada shot.
examples.why: "Estado fundamental" is the established Spanish physics term for the ground state; "estado base" reads as a calque of the English and can be confused with a 'basis'-related notion in a page that also talks about "gates base" (basis gates) a few entries later.

examples.source: Does not work with non-Clifford entanglers.
examples.suggested: No funciona con compuertas de entrelazamiento no Clifford.
examples.translation: No funciona con entangladores no-Clifford.
examples.why: "Entanglador" is not established Spanish technical vocabulary — it is an ad-hoc Spanishization of the English noun. The meaning survives, but a native writer would name the object (compuertas/operaciones de entrelazamiento).

editor_note: No semantic drift: every claim, condition and caveat (the two `<Admonition type="warning">` blocks, the `builtin=True` behavior, the four required `CustomInstruction` fields, `strict=True`) matches the English, register is consistently informal tú ("Consulta", "Puedes usar", "usa la función"), and the ES even repairs two English typos ("less efficient that" → "menos eficiente que"; "exported by our importer" → "exportado por nuestro exportador"). The main editorial defect is an English leak: the domain term "gate" is left untranslated throughout the prose (~25 times: "los gates integrados", "gates estándar", "los 'gates base' de su hardware", "gates heredados"), against this project's own es glossary (translate: gate → preferred "puerta", variant "compuerta") and the es guides corpus, which uses "compuerta(s)" — it is internally consistent and understandable, so it does not mislead, but a native editor would render it "puertas/compuertas" (keeping only the literal OpenQASM keyword `gate` in code font). Secondary: "legacy" splits between "heredado" (exportador/versión/gates heredados) and "versiones antiguas" (line 134); two qualifiers are dropped ("you can simply use" → "puedes usar"; "several other quality-of-life improvements" → "y otras mejoras de calidad de uso"); and a few calqued constructions read stiffly, notably "pero no coincide tanto en el número de parámetros como en el número de qubits" and "gates que no están en la versión original de `qelib1.inc` sin declararlos", where the trailing "sin declararlos" attaches to the wrong clause in Spanish.

examples.source: Qiskit will use the built-in gates in the circuit library to represent the gates in "qelib1.inc". … certain other quantum platforms that treat the "basis gates" of their hardware as built-in instructions.
examples.suggested: Qiskit usará las compuertas integradas de la biblioteca de circuitos para representar las compuertas de `"qelib1.inc"`. … tratan las "compuertas base" de su hardware como instrucciones integradas.
examples.translation: Qiskit usará los gates integrados de la biblioteca de circuitos para representar los gates en `"qelib1.inc"`. … ciertas plataformas cuánticas que tratan los "gates base" de su hardware como instrucciones integradas.
examples.why: 'gate' is left in English ~25 times in the prose, while translation/glossary/es.json marks it translate → preferred 'puerta' (variant 'compuerta') and the es guides corpus uses 'compuerta(s)'. Consistent and understandable, so not misleading, but it is an untranslated domain term a native editor would fix (keeping only the literal OpenQASM `gate` keyword in code).

examples.source: programs produced by legacy versions of Qiskit's OpenQASM 2 exporting capabilities
examples.suggested: …producidos por versiones heredadas (legacy) de las capacidades de exportación…
examples.translation: programas OpenQASM 2 producidos por versiones antiguas de las capacidades de exportación de OpenQASM 2 de Qiskit
examples.why: 'legacy' is rendered 'heredado' everywhere else in the file ('exportador heredado', 'versión heredada', 'gates heredados') but 'antiguas' here; since the very next heading links LEGACY_CUSTOM_INSTRUCTIONS to 'exportador heredado', one term should be used throughout.

examples.source: This OpenQASM 2 program uses gates that are not in the original version of "qelib1.inc" without declaring them, but are standard gates in Qiskit's library.
examples.suggested: Este programa OpenQASM 2 usa, sin declararlas, compuertas que no están en la versión original de `"qelib1.inc"`, pero que sí son compuertas estándar de la biblioteca de Qiskit.
examples.translation: Este programa OpenQASM 2 utiliza gates que no están en la versión original de `"qelib1.inc"` sin declararlos, pero son gates estándar en la biblioteca de Qiskit.
examples.why: Word-for-word calque: trailing 'sin declararlos' reads as attaching to 'no están en la versión original' rather than to 'utiliza', which momentarily inverts the sense for a Spanish reader. Moving the adverbial next to the verb restores the English meaning.

examples.source: you can simply use qasm2.load and qasm2.loads with a single argument / This has four required pieces of information, in order / several other quality-of-life improvements
examples.suggested: basta con usar `qasm2.load` y `qasm2.loads` con un solo argumento / Requiere cuatro datos obligatorios, en este orden / y varias otras mejoras de comodidad
examples.translation: puedes usar `qasm2.load` y `qasm2.loads` con un solo argumento / Esta requiere cuatro datos en orden / y otras mejoras de calidad de uso
examples.why: Small qualifiers that carry the English's reassuring teaching tone ('simply', 'several') are dropped, and 'cuatro datos en orden' loses both 'required' and the deictic 'este orden', flattening a numbered spec into a terse list header.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — every bound, sign, negation and quantity survives intact (classical bound ±2, Tsirelson ±2√2, "63/64", the S1/S2 sign patterns, "les théories à variables cachées locales"), and core terminology is correct and consistent: qubit, backend, benchmark and PUB kept in English, "valeurs d'espérance", "témoins CHSH", "intrication", "balayage de paramètres", "diaphonie" for crosstalk, and the graph-theory "couplage" for *matching* against "carte de connectivité" for coupling map — a nicely judged pair. Four things a native technical editor would still change. (1) "circuit" is capitalized mid-sentence three times — "un Circuit CHSH à état de Bell paramétré" (l.21), "Nous écrivons le Circuit CHSH" (l.124), "un seul Circuit plus grand" (l.387) — while the same word is correctly lowercase elsewhere in the very same sentences ("évaluer un circuit paramétré", l.124); this reads as a glossary-replacement artifact. (2) "afin que le même gestionnaire de passes soit exercé de bout en bout" (l.171) is a calque of English "exercised"; French "exercer" does not carry the "put through its paces" sense. (3) English "chip" is left untranslated twice ("une grande fraction du chip", l.262; "l'ensemble du chip", l.387) where French uses "la puce". (4) The frontmatter description (l.4) uses the formal imperative "Exécutez une expérience…" while the whole body correctly uses "tu" ("tu vas exécuter", "Tu peux définir", "assure-toi", "Ton temps d'exécution"). None of these would mislead a learner.

examples.source: How to construct a parameterized Bell-state CHSH circuit … / We write the CHSH circuit with a single parameter … / not as one larger circuit
examples.suggested: un circuit CHSH à état de Bell paramétré / Nous écrivons le circuit CHSH / non pas comme un seul circuit plus grand
examples.translation: un Circuit CHSH à état de Bell paramétré / Nous écrivons le Circuit CHSH / non pas comme un seul Circuit plus grand
examples.why: "Circuit" is capitalized mid-sentence in three places, while the identical common noun is correctly lowercase a few words later on l.124 ("évaluer un circuit paramétré") and in l.171 ("des circuits et des observables"). A glossary-replacement artifact, not a French capitalization rule; inconsistent within the file.

examples.source: …and transpile against the simulator's target so the same pass manager is exercised end-to-end.
examples.suggested: …afin que le même gestionnaire de passes soit sollicité de bout en bout.
examples.translation: …et transpilons par rapport à la cible du simulateur afin que le même gestionnaire de passes soit exercé de bout en bout.
examples.why: Direct calque of English "exercised". French "exercer" does not mean "put a component through its paces"; "soit exercé" reads as machine translation to a native technical writer.

examples.source: …we test entanglement across a large fraction of the chip at once / sustains genuine entanglement across the whole chip
examples.suggested: …sur une grande fraction de la puce / sur l'ensemble de la puce
examples.translation: …nous testons l'intrication sur une grande fraction du chip à la fois / maintient une véritable intrication sur l'ensemble du chip
examples.why: "Chip" is left in English where French has the established, unambiguous "la puce" — unlike backend/benchmark/PUB, it is not a term the French-speaking field keeps in English. Note the file already translates the neighbouring "device" as "dispositif", so the untranslated "chip" stands out.

examples.source: description: "Run an experiment on a quantum computer to demonstrate the violation of the CHSH inequality with the Estimator primitive."
examples.suggested: description: "Exécute une expérience sur un ordinateur quantique pour démontrer la violation de l'inégalité CHSH avec la primitive Estimator."
examples.translation: description: "Exécutez une expérience sur un ordinateur quantique pour démontrer la violation de l'inégalité CHSH avec la primitive Estimator."
examples.why: Formal-register slip: the frontmatter description uses the vous imperative while the entire body holds the informal tu convention ("tu vas exécuter", l.32; "Tu peux définir", l.56; "assure-toi", l.72; "Si tu as trouvé", l.391).

editor_note: Nothing here misleads a learner: dates, quantities and hardware claims are all faithful (68 ns contre 138 ns, 2,15e-3, 20-500 → 20-2000 µs, 57 des 176 portes, "au plus tôt le 30 septembre 2024"), the tu-register holds throughout with zero vous/votre/veuillez slips, and core terms are correct and consistent (qubit, portes à deux qubits, shots, backend, transpileur/transpilation, mitigation d'erreurs, circuits dynamiques, mesures mid-circuit). What a native editor would still change: the guide title "Classical feedforward and control flow" is rendered "Retour classique et flux de contrôle" (i.e. classical *feedback*), while the rest of the fr corpus uses "Anticipation classique (feedforward)" — defensible only because IBM's own EN prose says "classical feedback logic" two paragraphs earlier, but it is off-convention. Several calques remain: "Ensemble avec Samplomatic" (Together with), "ces améliorations habilitent les développeurs" ("habiliter" is legal certification, not "empower"), "le module pulse est prévu pour suppression", and the pleonasm "Ceci ne concerne que … uniquement". Two small term slips: "quantum-centric supercomputing workflows" loses the supercomputing half ("workflows de calcul quantique-centrique"), and "Individuals can view" becomes "Les particuliers" (retail customers) where the parallel bullet correctly says "Les personnes".

examples.source: See [Classical feedforward and control flow](/guides/classical-feedforward-and-control-flow) and [Deferred timing resolution using stretch](/guides/stretch) for more information
examples.suggested: Consulte [Anticipation classique (feedforward) et flux de contrôle](/guides/classical-feedforward-and-control-flow)
examples.translation: Consulte  [Retour classique et flux de contrôle](/guides/classical-feedforward-and-control-flow) et [Résolution de timing différée avec stretch](/guides/stretch)
examples.why: 'Retour classique' reads as classical *feedback*, the opposite information flow from feedforward; elsewhere in the fr locale this same guide title is rendered 'Anticipation classique (feedforward) et flux de contrôle', so the file is also off-convention.

examples.source: Together with [Samplomatic], they make up the [directed execution model]
examples.suggested: Associés à [Samplomatic], ils constituent le [modèle d'exécution dirigé]
examples.translation: Ensemble avec [Samplomatic], ils constituent le [modèle d'exécution dirigé]
examples.why: 'Ensemble avec' is a word-for-word calque of 'together with'; no French technical writer opens a sentence that way ('Avec…', 'Associés à…', 'Conjointement avec…').

examples.source: discuss how these improvements empower developers and users alike
examples.suggested: expliquer en quoi ces améliorations donnent plus de moyens aux développeurs comme aux utilisateurs
examples.translation: discuter de la façon dont ces améliorations habilitent les développeurs et les utilisateurs
examples.why: 'Habiliter' in French means to legally authorize or certify someone, not to empower; the sentence also drops the 'alike' contrast ('… comme aux utilisateurs').

examples.source: a call for submissions to the new open-source Quantum Advantage Tracker, and Qiskit C++, a new project designed to help HPC developers build production-grade quantum-centric supercomputing workflows
examples.suggested: un appel à contributions pour … des workflows de supercalcul quantique-centrique de qualité production
examples.translation: un appel à candidatures pour le nouveau Quantum Advantage Tracker open source, et Qiskit C++, un nouveau projet conçu pour aider les développeurs HPC à créer des workflows de calcul quantique-centrique de qualité production
examples.why: 'Quantum-centric supercomputing' is a named IBM concept; dropping 'super' turns it into ordinary 'calcul'. 'Appel à candidatures' means a call for applicants, not a call for submissions/contributions.

examples.source: Instance limits: Individuals can view available time and usage … / Individuals who can view the analytics page can now filter the data
examples.suggested: Les utilisateurs individuels peuvent consulter … (same rendering in both bullets)
examples.translation: Limites d'instance : Les particuliers peuvent consulter le temps disponible et l'utilisation … / Les personnes pouvant consulter la page d'analyse peuvent maintenant filtrer les données
examples.why: 'Particuliers' means private/retail customers, not 'individual users' as opposed to administrators; and the same English word is rendered two different ways ('particuliers' vs 'personnes') a few bullets apart.

examples.source: Note that before submitting jobs, you should verify compatibility with each primitive's options in the documentation
examples.suggested: … il est conseillé de vérifier / tu devrais vérifier la compatibilité …
examples.translation: Note qu'avant de soumettre des jobs, tu dois vérifier la compatibilité avec les options de chaque primitive dans la documentation
examples.why: 'Should' becomes 'tu dois' (must), strengthening a recommendation into a requirement — small, but it changes the force of the caveat.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inverted conditions, no swapped quantities (37%/1e, once-a-day updates, chain lengths 10–127 all intact), the caution Admonition and the "not all runs will show improvement" caveat are preserved, and "qubit"/"backend"/"טרנספילציה"/"מפת צימוד" are consistent. What a native technical editor would change is vocabulary and phrasing: "shots" is rendered as "ירי" ("firing/shooting" — "נספרים מספר הירי", which also has a plural-verb/singular-noun agreement error) where the field keeps "shots" or uses "הרצות/דגימות"; "ground state" is the calque "מצב הקרקע" (four occurrences) rather than the standard Hebrew physics term "מצב היסוד"; and "dephasing" becomes "שינוי פאזה", which collides with "מעבר פאזה" (phase transition). Several sentences are visibly calqued: "כתוצאת התייחסות לביצועים" for "As a reference result of performance", "קחו את הסקר הקצר הזה" for "take this short survey" (also drops "Please"), "אזהרות מגיעות מניסויים אלה" missing the relative ש-, "ביצועי הביצוע", and "המאפיינים המדווחים ברירת המחדל" (broken construct chain). None of this would make a learner form a false belief, so it stays MINOR.

examples.source: the number of shots resulting in an error (that is, an output different from the ground state) are counted
examples.suggested: נספר מספר ה-shots (ההרצות) שהובילו לשגיאה (כלומר, פלט שונה ממצב היסוד)
examples.translation: נספרים מספר הירי שהובילו לשגיאה (כלומר, פלט שונה ממצב הקרקע)
examples.why: "shots" is rendered as "ירי" — the literal noun for firing/shooting a weapon. Hebrew quantum writing keeps "shots" in English or uses "הרצות"/"דגימות". The phrase also carries an agreement error (plural "נספרים" with singular "מספר").

examples.source: for an excited qubit to fall to the ground state ... an output different from the ground state
examples.suggested: ל-qubit מעורר ליפול למצב היסוד ... פלט שונה ממצב היסוד
examples.translation: ל-qubit מעורר ליפול למצב הקרקע ... פלט שונה ממצב הקרקע
examples.why: "מצב הקרקע" is a word-for-word calque of "ground state" (קרקע = soil/ground). The established Hebrew physics term is "מצב היסוד". Used consistently four times, so it is recognizable in context, but it is not what a Hebrew physicist writes.

examples.source: As a reference result of performance, we'll execute a quantum circuit on a QPU by using the default qubits
examples.suggested: כנקודת ייחוס לביצועים, נריץ מעגל קוונטי במעבד קוונטי תוך שימוש ב-qubit של ברירת המחדל
examples.translation: כתוצאת התייחסות לביצועים, נבצע מעגל קוונטי במעבד קוונטי על ידי שימוש ב-qubit ברירת המחדל
examples.why: "תוצאת התייחסות" is a calque; "התייחסות" means "relating to / regarding", not a baseline. A native writer says "נקודת ייחוס" or "תוצאת ייחוס". "נבצע מעגל" is also stiff — circuits are "מורצים" (run), not "בוצעים".

examples.source: Please take this short survey to provide feedback on this tutorial.
examples.suggested: אנא מלאו את הסקר הקצר הזה כדי לתת משוב על מדריך זה.
examples.translation: קחו את הסקר הקצר הזה כדי לספק משוב על מדריך זה.
examples.why: "לקחת סקר" is a direct calque of English "take a survey" and is not Hebrew — one fills in ("ממלא") or answers a survey. The polite "Please" is also dropped, making the sentence read as a bare command.

examples.source: Try to apply this method to your executions and determine how much of a benefit you get!
examples.suggested: נסו ליישם שיטה זו על ההרצות שלכם ובדקו כמה תועלת אתם מפיקים מכך!
examples.translation: נסו ליישם שיטה זו על הביצועים שלכם וקבעו כמה תועלת אתם מקבלים!
examples.why: "executions" becomes "הביצועים", the same word the file uses everywhere for "performance" (מדידת ביצועים, שיפור בביצועים), so the closing call-to-action reads as "apply this to your performance". "ההרצות שלכם" removes the collision; "וקבעו כמה תועלת" is also stiff for a friendly CTA.

editor_note: No semantic inversions or hallucinations — the physics, the grid ranges (t,x between 0 and 0.95, step 0.2375; x 0→1 step 0.04), the benchmark table and the stress/strain mapping (u→מתח, σ→עיוות, consistently) all track the English. The defects are lexical and stylistic: "power law" is rendered "חוק הכוח" (= *force* law) instead of the standard "חוק חזקה", which is the weakest spot given "$b$ הכוח ליחידת מסה" sits in the same sentence; "The material deformation use case requires…" becomes the garbled construct "שימוש הביצוע של עיוות חומרים" (elsewhere "use case" is "שימוש זה"/"שימושים", never a consistent "מקרה שימוש"); and "circuit" is Hebrew ("מעגל קוונטי") in the ansatz paragraph but bare English ("10 Circuit זהים") one paragraph later, with the coined "שכבוב" for "stacking". Add calques — "בעיות פיזיקה מרובות מורכבות" for "complex multi-physics problems", "המוט הנחשב" for "the considered bar", the non-standard verb "מדגמת" for "models" — and the temporal/temporary ambiguity of "תנאי גבול זמני". Register is correctly informal throughout (אתה יכול, נסה, שים לב).

examples.source: $n$ the exponent of a power law
examples.suggested: $n$ את המעריך של חוק חזקה
examples.translation: $n$ את המעריך של חוק הכוח
examples.why: "Power law" is a false friend here: "חוק הכוח" reads as "law of force", and the same sentence really does define $b$ as force per unit mass ("הכוח ליחידת מסה"), so the reader can plausibly attach $n$ to a force law. The standard Hebrew term is "חוק חזקה". The $(\cdot)^n$ in the displayed equation is what keeps this recognizable rather than outright misleading.

examples.source: The material deformation use case requires the physical parameters of your material and the applied force
examples.suggested: מקרה השימוש של עיוות חומרים דורש את הפרמטרים הפיזיקליים של החומר שלך ואת הכוח המופעל
examples.translation: שימוש הביצוע של עיוות חומרים דורש את הפרמטרים הפיזיקליים של החומר שלך ואת הכוח המופעל
examples.why: "שימוש הביצוע" is a broken construct (roughly "the execution use") that no native technical writer would produce; "use case" is rendered three different ways in the file (שימוש זה, שימושים, שימוש הביצוע) and never as the conventional מקרה שימוש.

examples.source: By stacking 10 identical circuits and evaluating the 10 identical observables on different qubits throughout one big circuit
examples.suggested: על ידי הערמת 10 מעגלים זהים והערכת 10 האובזרבלים הזהים על קיוביטים שונים לאורך מעגל גדול אחד
examples.translation: על ידי שכבוב 10 Circuit זהים והערכת 10 אובזרבלים זהים על qubit שונים לאורך Circuit גדול אחד
examples.why: Within-file inconsistency: "circuit" is Hebrew ("מעגל קוונטי") in the ansatz paragraph but bare English "Circuit" here; "qubit" alternates between "ה-Qubit" and lowercase "qubit". "שכבוב" is a coinage for "stacking" that suggests layering rather than replicating circuits side by side.

examples.source: This algorithm can solve complex multi-physics problems
examples.suggested: אלגוריתם זה יכול לפתור בעיות מולטי-פיזיקליות מורכבות
examples.translation: אלגוריתם זה יכול לפתור בעיות פיזיקה מרובות מורכבות
examples.why: Word-by-word calque: the Hebrew parses as "multiple complex physics problems", losing the term of art "multi-physics" (coupled physical domains) that the whole CFD+MD framing depends on.

examples.source: This use-case has a temporal boundary condition
examples.suggested: לשימוש זה יש תנאי גבול בזמן
examples.translation: לשימוש זה יש תנאי גבול זמני
examples.why: "זמני" is ambiguous in Hebrew between "temporal" and "temporary"; the default reading here is "temporary boundary condition", which is not what the English says. "תנאי גבול בזמן" (or "תנאי התחלה בזמן") removes the ambiguity.

examples.source: The inviscid Burgers' equation, models flowing non-viscous fluids as follows
examples.suggested: משוואת Burgers ללא צמיגות ממדלת זרימה של נוזלים לא צמיגים כדלקמן
examples.translation: משוואת Burgers ללא צמיגות מדגמת זרימת נוזלים ללא צמיגות כדלקמן
examples.why: "מדגמת" is not the standard verb for "models" (it collides with דגימה/sampling, which the very next paragraph uses for "sample points"); Hebrew technical writing uses ממדלת or מתארת.

examples.source: you can configure it further for problem-specific benefits
examples.suggested: אתה יכול להגדיר אותה עוד יותר כדי להפיק יתרונות ספציפיים לבעיה
examples.translation: אתה יכול להגדיר אותה עוד יותר לצרכים ספציפיים לבעיה
examples.why: "benefits" becomes "צרכים" (needs), turning an offered upside into an obligation to meet requirements. Small, but it flips the motivation the sentence gives the reader for touching the optimizer sequence at all.

examples.source: The considered bar is of unitary length.
examples.suggested: אורכו של המוט הנדון הוא יחידה אחת.
examples.translation: המוט הנחשב הוא באורך יחידה.
examples.why: "המוט הנחשב" is a literal rendering of "the considered bar" that reads as "the bar that is regarded/esteemed"; Hebrew uses הנדון/המדובר for this attributive sense.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout and the informal "kamu" register holds ("membantu kamu membangun alur kerja", "membantu kamu memilih kemampuan"), but a native editor would change several things. The worst is the false friend in the Shaded lightcones card: "menghapus istilah model noise" renders the mathematical "noise model terms" as "istilah" (= terminology/vocabulary items); the correct Indonesian is "suku-suku model noise". "Entangling gates" is rendered as the non-standard "Gate yang saling mengait" (literally "gates that hook onto each other") instead of the conventional "gerbang pembelit"/"gate entangling" — recognizable from context but it never signals keterbelitan/entanglement to the reader. Typographically, glossary terms are left capitalized mid-sentence in a way no Indonesian technical writer would produce ("operator dan Circuit kuantum", "menguraikan Gate", "pass Transpiler"), and casing is inconsistent within the file ("Qubit yang tidak berdekatan" vs "Circuit qubit"); likewise "noise" is kept in English throughout ("kelola noise", "model noise") while its adjective is localized as "bising" ("sampel yang bising", "bitstring yang bising").

examples.source: Reduce probabilistic error cancellation (PEC) sampling overhead by removing noise model terms that have low impact on the observable estimation.
examples.suggested: ... dengan menghapus suku-suku model noise yang berdampak kecil pada estimasi observable.
examples.translation: Kurangi overhead sampling probabilistic error cancellation (PEC) dengan menghapus istilah model noise yang berdampak kecil pada estimasi observable.
examples.why: "term" here is a mathematical term of the noise model, not a piece of terminology. "istilah" is the lexical sense only, so the sentence reads as "deleting the noise model's vocabulary". Standard rendering is "suku".

examples.source: Reduce the depth of transpiled circuits by decomposing entangling gates between non-adjacent qubits.
examples.suggested: ... dengan menguraikan gerbang pembelit (entangling gate) antara qubit yang tidak berdekatan.
examples.translation: Kurangi kedalaman Circuit yang sudah ditranspilasi dengan menguraikan Gate yang saling mengait antara Qubit yang tidak berdekatan.
examples.why: "saling mengait" is a literal "hook together" and shifts the relation onto the gates rather than the qubits; it never connects the reader to keterbelitan/entanglement, the concept the card is about.

examples.source: ...quantum operators and circuits... / ...decomposing entangling gates... / ...postselection transpiler passes.
examples.suggested: ...operator dan sirkuit kuantum... / ...gerbang ... antara qubit... / ...pass transpiler...
examples.translation: ...operator dan Circuit kuantum... / ...menguraikan Gate yang saling mengait antara Qubit... / ...pass Transpiler postseleksi...
examples.why: Keeping the English nouns is defensible, but capitalizing them mid-sentence is not Indonesian typography and reads as machine output; casing is also inconsistent ("Qubit" here vs "Circuit qubit" on line 28).

examples.source: ...can plug into a workflow to scale or design new quantum algorithms.
examples.suggested: ...untuk menskalakan atau merancang algoritma kuantum baru.
examples.translation: ...bisa dipasang ke dalam sebuah alur kerja untuk mengembangkan atau merancang algoritma kuantum baru.
examples.why: "scale" (scaling an existing algorithm to utility scale — the page's whole premise, cf. "skala utilitas" one sentence earlier) is flattened to "mengembangkan" (develop), and "baru" now attaches to both verbs, so the scaling-up sense is lost.

editor_note: No semantic drift: all quantities, inequalities, orthogonality claims and the VQD/SSVQE/QSR reasoning chains track the English exactly, and the informal "kamu/mu" register holds throughout ("Kami mendorongmu", "Kamu akan merekonstruksi", "perhitunganmu sendiri"). The file is, however, visibly a two-pass merge with split conventions: mathematical "term" is rendered correctly as "suku" in the SSVQE section ("suku dengan bobot terbesar") but as the calqued "istilah" throughout VQD ("istilah penalti", "setiap istilah overlap", "jumlah dari kedua istilah ini") — "istilah" means a vocabulary term, so "menjumlahkan kedua istilah" is not something an Indonesian physicist would write; likewise "eigenvalue" (SSVQE) vs "nilai eigen" (VQD), "subspace" vs "subruang", "optimizer" vs "pengoptimal", "optimisasi" vs "optimasi", and the title's "Instansi" vs the summary's "instance". Secondary polish: glossary artifacts leave "Backend" and "Circuit" capitalized mid-sentence and produce the half-English "Circuit quantum baru" where the rest of the file says "kuantum"; "the minimization routine successfully terminated" becomes "rutinitas minimisasi berhasil dihentikan" ("routineness … was halted") instead of "rutin minimisasi berakhir dengan sukses"; and the QSR paragraph carries raw calques ("komoditas rendah penawaran/tinggi permintaan", "kita menemukan trade-off ini menjadi mungkin dan nyaman", "$2S+1$ unknown" left untranslated). None of this would teach a false concept, but a native technical editor would change all of it.

examples.source: VQD introduces a penalty term, denoted as $\beta$ … the cost function should then return the sum of these two terms
examples.suggested: VQD memperkenalkan suku penalti, dilambangkan $\beta$ … Fungsi biaya kemudian mengembalikan jumlah kedua suku ini
examples.translation: VQD memperkenalkan istilah penalti, dilambangkan sebagai $\beta$ … Fungsi biaya kemudian harus mengembalikan jumlah dari kedua istilah ini
examples.why: "Istilah" is a vocabulary term, not a mathematical term; the file itself uses the correct "suku" in the SSVQE section ("suku dengan bobot terbesar", "sisa suku"), so the same concept is split two ways within one file.

examples.source: the first $k$ eigenvalues of an observable $\hat{H}$ with eigenvalues …
examples.suggested: Pick one convention for the whole file (e.g. "nilai eigen" everywhere, with "eigenstate" kept in English or as "keadaan eigen" consistently)
examples.translation: SSVQE: "$k$ eigenvalue pertama … dengan eigenvalue"  vs  VQD: "$k$ nilai eigen pertama … dengan nilai eigen"
examples.why: Core term rendered English in one half and Indonesian in the other; same split hits subspace/subruang (236 vs 290) and optimizer/pengoptimal (42, 253 vs 366, 528).

examples.source: We will select the least-busy backend … transpile the circuit … creates a new quantum circuit … the backend we select
examples.suggested: memilih backend yang paling tidak sibuk … men-transpile sirkuit … membuat sirkuit kuantum baru … backend yang kita pilih
examples.translation: memilih Backend yang paling tidak sibuk … men-transpile Circuit … membuat Circuit quantum baru … Backend yang kita pilih
examples.why: Glossary injection leaves "Backend"/"Circuit" capitalized mid-sentence like proper nouns, and "Circuit quantum" mixes an English head noun with an English adjective where the whole file otherwise says "kuantum".

examples.source: We can see that the minimization routine successfully terminated … the result was several percent off compared to the result obtained by the simulator above.
examples.suggested: Kita bisa melihat bahwa rutin minimisasi berakhir dengan sukses … karena hasilnya meleset beberapa persen dari hasil yang diperoleh simulator di atas.
examples.translation: Kita bisa melihat bahwa rutinitas minimisasi berhasil dihentikan … karena hasilnya beberapa persen lebih jauh dibandingkan hasil yang diperoleh simulator di atas.
examples.why: "Rutinitas" is routine-as-habit, not a code routine, and "berhasil dihentikan" reads as "was successfully halted" (aborted) rather than converged; "beberapa persen lebih jauh" is a literal rendering of "several percent off" that no native writer would use.

examples.source: Since access to quantum computers is still a low-offer/high-demand commodity, we find this trade-off to be both possible and convenient … since we have $2S+1$ unknowns … for $2S+1$ parameter values
examples.suggested: Karena akses ke komputer kuantum masih merupakan komoditas dengan penawaran rendah dan permintaan tinggi, kami menilai trade-off ini layak dan praktis … karena ada $2S+1$ variabel yang tidak diketahui … untuk $2S+1$ nilai parameter
examples.translation: Karena akses ke komputer kuantum masih merupakan komoditas rendah penawaran/tinggi permintaan, kita menemukan trade-off ini menjadi mungkin dan nyaman … karena kita memiliki $2S+1$ unknown … untuk nilai parameter $2S+1$
examples.why: Calqued compound and "find X to be Y" construction; "unknown" is left untranslated; and Indonesian numeral order makes "nilai parameter $2S+1$" read as "parameter value 2S+1" rather than "2S+1 parameter values" (the following set disambiguates, so it is stiff rather than misleading).

editor_note: No semantic drift: every load-bearing statement survives intact — the tensor/expand subsystem indexing ($B$ on sottosistema 0 / $A$ su 1, and the reverse for `expand`), the $B.A$ vs $A.B$ composition order, the "le combinazioni lineari non lo fanno" unitarity caveat, and the closing "solo se gli operatori di input sono unitari (o CP...)" restriction are all faithful, and the informal "tu" register holds throughout ("Tieni presente", "Puoi anche comporre", "consulta"). What a native technical editor would still change are three calqued constructions in the prose: "viene convertito implicitamente in uno dal metodo" (§Conversione implicita) is a word-for-word tracing of "is implicitly converted into one by the method" — Italian would say "il metodo lo converte implicitamente"; the trailing "senza essere esplicitamente convertite in un `Operator` prima" strands "prima" at the end where "senza doverle prima convertire" is idiomatic; and "una quantità di teoria dell'informazione" (§Fedeltà di processo) is a stiff rendering of "information-theoretic quantity" where "una grandezza di teoria dell'informazione" reads as written by a physicist. Terminology is correct and consistent (operatore, gate, qubit, sottosistema, prodotto tensoriale, fedeltà di processo, fase globale, unitarietà); nothing here would mislead a learner.

examples.source: Note that for all the following methods, if the second object is not already an `Operator` object, it is implicitly converted into one by the method.
examples.suggested: Tieni presente che per tutti i metodi seguenti, se il secondo oggetto non è già un oggetto `Operator`, il metodo lo converte implicitamente.
examples.translation: Tieni presente che per tutti i metodi seguenti, se il secondo oggetto non è già un oggetto `Operator`, viene convertito implicitamente in uno dal metodo.
examples.why: "convertito implicitamente in uno dal metodo" traces the English word order ('into one by the method'); the pronoun "in uno" plus the agentive "dal metodo" is a construction no Italian technical writer would produce. Meaning is intact, so this is stiffness, not drift.

examples.source: This means that matrices can be passed in directly without being explicitly converted to an `Operator` first.
examples.suggested: Ciò significa che le matrici possono essere passate direttamente, senza doverle prima convertire esplicitamente in un `Operator`.
examples.translation: Ciò significa che le matrici possono essere passate direttamente senza essere esplicitamente convertite in un `Operator` prima.
examples.why: The sentence-final "prima" is a positional calque of English "first"; in Italian the adverb belongs before the infinitive. Reads as fluent MT rather than native prose.

examples.source: This is an information-theoretic quantity for how close two quantum channels are to each other...
examples.suggested: Si tratta di una grandezza di teoria dell'informazione che misura quanto due canali quantistici siano vicini tra loro...
examples.translation: Si tratta di una quantità di teoria dell'informazione che misura quanto due canali quantistici sono vicini tra loro...
examples.why: "quantità" is the literal but weaker rendering of a physical/mathematical "quantity" — Italian physics prose uses "grandezza"; the indicative "sono vicini" after "quanto" would also be subjunctive "siano" in careful technical writing. Purely editorial: the concept is correctly conveyed.

editor_note: Faithful, natural and consistently informal ("Puoi accedere ai processori quantistici tramite le REST API", "Tieni presente che..."); domain/infra terms are correct and stable (QPU, bearer token and CRN kept in English, "chiave API", "variabile d'ambiente", "in chiaro" for plain text), and the security caveat at step 1 of the trusted-environment section is preserved in full.

Meaning is faithful throughout — the physics-bearing passages (p vs 1−p on the X gate, control=|0⟩→identity / control=|1⟩→X for CNOT, |a|² as the probability of "0" on both qubits, "円のサイズが各状態を測定する確率に比例", Sampler=ショットごとのカウント vs Estimator=期待値と標準誤差) are all correct, and the register is consistent desu/masu with no keigo. The defects are surface-level. (1) Core nouns are kept in English mid-sentence and then rendered inconsistently: circuit appears as 量子Circuit (line ~134), bare "Quantum Circuit" (line ~218) and 回路 (line ~20); Hadamard as アダマールGate (line ~206) vs Hadamard Gate (line ~314); operator as 演算子 (lines ~28, ~215) vs Operator (line ~415). (2) The multi-qubit constructions are written with interpuncts as マルチ・qubit・Gate and 2 qubit・Gate (lines ~300–312) — grammatical but a shape no Japanese technical writer would produce, and the qubit/Qubit casing flips within the same sentence. (3) Line ~174 contains a garbled fragment, "QubitはQは$|0\rangle$状態に初期化されます", and line ~211 writes the phase variable as bare Φ instead of the LaTeX $\phi$ used everywhere else. None of this would teach a learner a false concept, but a native editor would rewrite all of it.

examples.source: In Qiskit, the qubit is initialized in $|0\rangle$ state.
examples.suggested: Qiskitでは、量子ビットは$|0\rangle$状態に初期化されます。
examples.translation: Qiskitでは、QubitはQは$|0\rangle$状態に初期化されます。
examples.why: Garbled duplicated subject fragment 「QubitはQは」 — a visible text corruption left in the rendered prose.

examples.source: Quantum Quiz with Multi-Qubit Gates / … combining single-qubit gates and multi-qubit gates … the canonical two qubit gate
examples.suggested: 複数量子ビットゲートを使った量子クイズ / 1量子ビットゲートと複数量子ビットゲートを組み合わせて / 代表的な2量子ビットゲートである制御NOT
examples.translation: マルチ・qubit・Gateを使った量子クイズ / シングルQubit Gateとマルチ・qubit・Gateを組み合わせて / 代表的な2 qubit・Gateである制御NOT
examples.why: Interpunct-joined English fragments (マルチ・qubit・Gate, 2 qubit・Gate) are a shape no Japanese technical writer would produce; casing also flips between Qubit and qubit inside one sentence.

examples.source: **Map** problem to quantum circuits and operators
examples.suggested: **Map** 問題を量子回路と演算子にマッピングする
examples.translation: **Map** 問題を量子CircuitとOperatorにマッピングする

examples.source: You can verify your installation by running the cell below. If you installed correctly, it will return the qiskit version.
examples.suggested: 以下のセルを実行すると、インストールを確認できます。正しくインストールされていれば、qiskitのバージョンが返されます。
examples.translation: インストールが正しく行われた場合、以下のセルを実行することで確認できます。正しくインストールされていれば、qiskitのバージョンが返されます。
examples.why: The conditional 「インストールが正しく行われた場合」 is pulled into the first sentence, making it circular (you run the cell *to find out* whether the install succeeded) and duplicating the qualifier that the next sentence already carries.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — the Step 2 heading correctly keeps "サブ回路あたり最大4…ワイヤーカットを1か所と `CRZGate` のカットを1か所行うことで2つに分割できます", and the closing "[Qiskit パターン]のステップ3および4は、前のチュートリアルと同様の手順で実行できます。" matches the English exactly, so nothing here would mislead a learner. The defect is untranslated capitalized English nouns sitting inside Japanese sentences where the file itself already uses the native term: "Circuit とオブザーバブルを作成する" and "これらの Gate とワイヤー" and "Backend で実行する実験" against サブ回路/量子回路図 used elsewhere — a native technical writer would write 回路・ゲート・バックエンド. "qubit" is rendered three different ways in three lines: "最大4 Qubit" (capitalized), "補助ビット", and "補助 qubit" (lowercase) — the concept stays identifiable, but the conventional 量子ビット appears nowhere. Headings also mix plain form (作成する, 拡張する, 生成する) with polite form (検出します, 分割できます, 計算します) with no pattern.

examples.source: Create a circuit and observables / cutting these gates and wires / run on the backend
examples.suggested: 回路とオブザーバブルを作成する / これらのゲートとワイヤー / バックエンドで実行する実験を生成する
examples.translation: Circuit とオブザーバブルを作成する / これらの Gate とワイヤー / Backend で実行する実験を生成する
examples.why: Capitalized bare English nouns are dropped into Japanese sentences even though the file itself already uses the native forms サブ回路 and 量子回路図 (and サンプリング・オーバーヘッド in katakana). A Japanese quantum engineer writes 回路/ゲート/バックエンド; the capitalized English reads as untranslated residue, not as a deliberate keep-in-English convention.

examples.source: a maximum of 4 qubits per subcircuit / Add ancillas for wire cuts and expand the observables to account for ancilla qubits
examples.suggested: サブ回路あたり最大4量子ビットという条件のもと / ワイヤーカット用の補助量子ビットを追加し、補助量子ビットを考慮して
examples.translation: サブ回路あたり最大4 Qubitという条件のもと / ワイヤーカット用の補助ビットを追加し、補助 qubit を考慮して
examples.why: One concept, three renderings within two lines: "Qubit", "ビット" and "qubit". Worse, "補助ビット" drops 量子 and reads as a classical ancilla bit. Not misleading enough to fail, but the standard 量子ビット should be used consistently.

examples.source: (heading style across the page)
examples.suggested: Pick one form for all headings — e.g. plain 作成する・検出する・分割する・生成する
examples.translation: 作成する / 検出します…分割できます / 分割します…計算します / 生成する
examples.why: Headings alternate between plain form and polite です/ます form with no pattern, sometimes inside the same heading. Japanese technical docs keep heading style uniform; the mix reads as two translators merged.

editor_note: No semantic drift: every claim tracks the English (the `NoiseLearner`/EstimatorV2 vs `NoiseLearnerV3`/Executor split, "two of which contain InjectNoise annotations ... since they are not equivalent" → "그 중 두 개는 서로 다른 `ref` 속성을 가진 ... (동일하지 않기 때문입니다)", the Pauli-Lindblad generator/rate explanation), and 생성원/오류율/무작위화 횟수/트월링 전략/프리미티브/얽힘 레이어 are the right domain renderings. The main editorial defect is a glossary leak: "circuit" is left as English "Circuit" 16 times in Korean prose ("하나 이상의 Circuit에 대해", "Circuit 목록", "대상 Circuit", "Circuit에서 학습된 노이즈 모델"), while translation/glossary/ko.json marks "Circuit" as leaked_en with preferred 회로 — recognizable but not what a Korean engineer would write (qubit, by contrast, is correctly kept lowercase per the same glossary). Register is mixed: the body is 합니다체 throughout, with a single 해요체 slip "권장해요" sitting next to "개발되었습니다" in the same package-versions block. Two sentences are stiff, heavily center-embedded calques (the three-way "직접, ... 인스턴스화하기 전에, 그리고 ... 전달하여" parallel, and the triple-stacked relative clause on `to_pauli_lindblad_map()`), and the inline link label "지시형 실행 모델" does not match the target page's own Korean title "지향적 실행 모델".

examples.why: "circuit" is left untranslated as capitalized English "Circuit" 16 times in Korean prose. translation/glossary/ko.json lists "Circuit"/"Circuits" under leaked_en with preferred 회로, and 회로 is the universal Korean domain term; consistent, so recognizable, but no Korean technical writer would leave it in English here.

examples.source: We recommend using these versions or newer.
examples.suggested: 이 버전 이상을 사용하는 것을 권장합니다.
examples.translation: 이 버전 이상을 사용하는 것을 권장해요.
examples.why: Lone 해요체 form directly after "이 페이지의 코드는 다음 요구 사항을 사용하여 개발되었습니다." in the same block; the rest of the file (수행합니다, 반환합니다, 저장합니다, 지정합니다) is uniformly 합니다체, so this single sentence reads as an unedited register slip.

examples.source: The next three examples show how you can pass the noise model to the estimator.options attribute directly, by using a ResilienceOptionsV2 object before instantiating an Estimator primitive, and by passing in an appropriately formatted dictionary.
examples.suggested: 다음 세 가지 예시는 노이즈 모델을 전달하는 세 가지 방법, 즉 (1) `estimator.options` 속성에 직접 전달하는 방법, (2) Estimator 프리미티브를 인스턴스화하기 전에 `ResilienceOptionsV2` 객체로 지정하는 방법, (3) 적절한 형식의 딕셔너리로 전달하는 방법을 보여줍니다.
examples.translation: 다음 세 가지 예시는 `estimator.options` 속성에 직접, `ResilienceOptionsV2` 객체를 사용하여 Estimator 프리미티브를 인스턴스화하기 전에, 그리고 적절히 형식화된 딕셔너리를 전달하여 노이즈 모델을 전달하는 방법을 보여줍니다.
examples.why: The English three-way parallel is calqued onto Korean with the head verb (전달하는 방법을) postponed to the very end, so the three coordinated items dangle without predicates; grammatical but hard to parse. Same stacking problem in the `to_pauli_lindblad_map()` sentence (line ~305), where three relative clauses nest before the head noun 메서드.

examples.source: also part of the directed execution model
examples.suggested: [지향적 실행 모델](/guides/directed-execution-model)의 일부이기도 한
examples.translation: [지시형 실행 모델](/guides/directed-execution-model)의 일부이기도 한
examples.why: The link label does not match the destination page's own Korean title, which is "지향적 실행 모델 (베타)" in i18n/ko/.../guides/directed-execution-model.mdx; a reader following the link lands on a differently named concept.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — every quantitative claim (2^{n/2-1}-1 queries, "최소 1/2의 확률로 ... 풀지 못합니다", 1-2^{-r}, 99.9%, the y·s=0 / y·s=1 case split, one-to-one vs two-to-one) matches the English, and the pedagogy (bucket analogy, null-space argument, "충분한 쌍의 문자열이 없기 때문에" intuition) survives intact; nothing here would mislead a learner. What a native technical editor would change is terminology surface: core nouns are left in Latin script mid-sentence ("양자 Circuit 다이어그램", "$n$개의 Qubit", "Hadamard Gate 레이어") where Korean quantum writing uses 회로 / 큐비트 / 게이트, and the same file then writes "쿼리 게이트" in Hangul one clause after "Hadamard Gate" — an in-file split of the same term. Smaller blemishes: "서로 다른 다른 문자열" (duplicated 다른) at the string-replacement example, the calqued "$f$ 아래에서 $\{z\}$의 원상" for "the preimage under f" (Korean math says "f에 의한"), and "높은 확률로 발생하는 경우처럼" which turns the English non-restrictive "which happens with high probability" into a stiff "like the case that happens with high probability". Register is consistent -습니다 technical prose with no 하십시오체/드리 slips.

examples.source: Here's a quantum circuit diagram representing Simon's algorithm. / there are $n$ qubits on the top that are acted upon by Hadamard gates
examples.suggested: 다음은 사이먼 알고리즘을 나타내는 양자 회로 다이어그램입니다. / 위쪽에는 하다마드 게이트가 작용하는 $n$개의 큐비트가 있고
examples.translation: 다음은 사이먼 알고리즘을 나타내는 양자 Circuit 다이어그램입니다. / 위쪽에는 Hadamard Gate가 작용하는 $n$개의 Qubit이 있고
examples.why: circuit/qubit/gate are left in English capitalized inside Korean prose; Korean quantum documentation renders these as 회로 / 큐비트 / 게이트. Not misleading, but no Korean engineer would write '양자 Circuit 다이어그램'.

examples.source: $n$ qubits ... acted upon by Hadamard gates and $m$ qubits ... that go directly into the query gate
examples.suggested: 하다마드 게이트가 작용하는 ... 쿼리 게이트로 직접 들어가는 ...
examples.translation: Hadamard Gate가 작용하는 $n$개의 Qubit이 있고, 아래쪽에는 쿼리 게이트로 직접 들어가는 $m$개의 Qubit이 있습니다
examples.why: 'gate' is rendered two ways in a single sentence — English 'Gate' for Hadamard, Hangul '게이트' for the query gate. Within-file inconsistency of one core term.

examples.source: We could replace these four strings with different strings, so long as they're all distinct
examples.suggested: 서로 모두 다르기만 하다면 이 네 문자열을 다른 문자열로 교체해도
examples.translation: 이 네 문자열을 모두 서로 다른 다른 문자열로 교체해도
examples.why: '서로 다른 다른 문자열' repeats 다른 twice and reads as a slip; the 'so long as they're all distinct' condition should be a separate clause.

examples.source: So long as the vectors corresponding to $0^n$ and $s$ are alone in the null space of $M$, which happens with high probability, we can deduce $s$
examples.suggested: $0^n$과 $s$에 해당하는 벡터만이 $M$의 영공간에 있는 한 — 이는 높은 확률로 성립합니다 — 이 계산의 결과로부터 $s$를 추론할 수 있습니다.
examples.translation: 높은 확률로 발생하는 경우처럼 $0^n$과 $s$에 해당하는 벡터만이 $M$의 영공간에 있는 한, 이 계산의 결과로부터 $s$를 추론할 수 있습니다.
examples.why: The English non-restrictive clause becomes '~하는 경우처럼' ('like the case that ...'), which is not what a Korean writer would use for an aside; the parenthetical assurance reads as a comparison instead.

examples.source: The set $f^{-1}(\{z\})$ is known as the *preimage* of $\{z\}$ under $f$.
examples.suggested: 집합 $f^{-1}(\{z\})$는 $f$에 의한 $\{z\}$의 *원상(preimage)*이라고 합니다.
examples.translation: 집합 $f^{-1}(\{z\})$는 $f$ 아래에서 $\{z\}$의 *원상(preimage)*으로 알려져 있습니다.
examples.why: 'under f' is calqued literally as 'f 아래에서'; standard Korean mathematical usage is 'f에 의한' / 'f에 대한'. Same calque repeats in the next sentence.

editor_note: Two core physics terms in the `quantum_info` bullet are rendered so wrongly they teach false concepts. "input observables" becomes "boleh lihat masukan" — literally "input can-see/visible"; a Malay reader cannot recover the concept "observable" (kebolehcerapan / "observable") from it at all, and the sentence "Gunakan modul ini untuk menentukan boleh lihat masukan" is not parseable as technical prose. In the same sentence "sampling noise" becomes "bunyi pensampelan", where "bunyi" is acoustic sound; the correct Malay term "hingar" is in fact used later in the same file for Aer's "noise models", so the file teaches the wrong word for noise in the one place noise is conceptually load-bearing. Secondary (non-misleading) problems: "circuit" is split between the translated "litar" and an untranslated capitalised "Circuit" ("Alatan pembinaan Circuit", "Pustaka Circuit", "Circuit kuantum") within the same bullet list; "derive their own implementations" is softened to "mendapatkan pelaksanaan mereka sendiri" (obtain, not derive); "committed to delivering" is calqued as "komited untuk menghantar" (to ship/send physically); "benchmarked" switches from "penanda aras" to "diukur"; and "preconditioned iterative method" loses the "pre-" as "kaedah berulang terkondisi".

examples.source: Use this module to specify input observables and analyze fidelity of outputs from primitives queries.
examples.suggested: Gunakan modul ini untuk menentukan observable masukan dan menganalisis kesetiaan (fidelity) output daripada pertanyaan primitif.
examples.translation: Gunakan modul ini untuk menentukan boleh lihat masukan dan menganalisis ketepatan output daripada pertanyaan primitif.
examples.why: "observables" is rendered as "boleh lihat" ("can see / visible"), an over-literal word-by-word gloss. The learner reads "specify input visible" and forms no concept of an observable at all — the central object an Estimator measures. "fidelity" is also flattened to "ketepatan" (accuracy), which is a different metric.

examples.line_approx: ms line 28 vs ms line 56 (EN lines 26, 54)
examples.source: using exact calculations (no sampling noise) … quantum computing simulators with realistic noise models
examples.suggested: … (tanpa hingar pensampelan) … model hingar yang realistik
examples.translation: menggunakan pengiraan tepat (tanpa bunyi pensampelan) … simulator pengkomputeran kuantum dengan model hingar yang realistik
examples.why: "noise" is rendered twice in one file: "bunyi" (acoustic sound) in the quantum_info bullet and the correct "hingar" in the Aer bullet. "tanpa bunyi pensampelan" reads as "without sampling sound" and misleads exactly where the point is that exact calculation has no statistical noise.

examples.source: Circuit-building tools … Circuit library … transforming and adapting quantum circuits … run quantum circuits with or without noise
examples.suggested: Alatan pembinaan litar … Pustaka litar … litar kuantum (throughout)
examples.translation: Alatan pembinaan Circuit … Pustaka Circuit … mengubah dan menyesuaikan Circuit kuantum … menjalankan Circuit kuantum
examples.why: The file already uses the correct Malay "litar" ("litar kuantum yang diperluaskan", "daftar, litar, arahan", "pengkomputeran kuantum berasaskan litar") but then leaves an untranslated, capitalised "Circuit" in five places, including mid-sentence prose. Same concept, two renderings, in adjacent bullets.

examples.source: …reference implementations of the Sampler and Estimator primitives, from which different quantum hardware providers can derive their own implementations.
examples.suggested: …pelaksanaan rujukan primitif Sampler dan Estimator, yang daripadanya pembekal perkakasan kuantum yang berlainan boleh menerbitkan pelaksanaan mereka sendiri.
examples.translation: …pelaksanaan rujukan primitif Sampler dan Estimator, di mana pembekal perkakasan kuantum yang berlainan boleh mendapatkan pelaksanaan mereka sendiri.
examples.why: "derive from" becomes "mendapatkan" (obtain/get), losing the inheritance relationship that is the whole point of a reference implementation; "di mana" as a relative pronoun is a well-known English calque a native technical writer would avoid.

examples.source: IBM Quantum is committed to delivering the most performant SDK possible, and to that end, the Qiskit SDK is benchmarked using over 1,000 tests…
examples.suggested: IBM Quantum komited untuk menyediakan SDK yang paling berprestasi, dan sehubungan itu, Qiskit SDK ditanda aras menggunakan lebih 1,000 ujian…
examples.translation: IBM Quantum komited untuk menghantar SDK yang paling berprestasi, dan dengan itu, Qiskit SDK diukur menggunakan lebih 1,000 ujian…
examples.why: "deliver" is calqued as "menghantar" (to physically send/deliver a parcel), and "benchmarked" drops the term established two sentences earlier ("penanda aras") in favour of the generic "diukur".

editor_note: The file is fluent and the informal "ty" register holds throughout ("Możesz tworzyć…", "Zanim zaczniesz…"), but it breaks in half terminologically: the first sections translate consistently ("obwód", "backendu", "transpiler"), while from "## Transpilacja względem niestandardowych Backend'ów" onward the same concepts revert to untranslated, capitalized English — "Poniższy przykład buduje Circuit", "Transpilowany Circuit zawiera teraz…", "względem tego Backend'u", "przejść Transpiler'a" — so "circuit" appears as both obwód and Circuit, and "backend/transpiler" acquire an apostrophe declension ("Backend'ów", "Backend'u", "Transpiler'a") that is simply wrong Polish orthography (correct: backendów, backendu, transpilera). "qubit" is split three ways in one file: "Qubitów"/"Qubity" (capitalized mid-sentence), lowercase "qubit" (line 278), and "łączność kubitów" (line 283). Two content points also drift: "quite a few more gates than you started with" is softened to "Jest też nieco więcej bramek niż na początku" ("slightly more"), which understates the transpilation overhead the numbers directly above it demonstrate (49 CX → 146 CZ + 302 SX + 250 RZ); and "credential and/or authentication tasks" becomes "zadania uwierzytelniania i/lub autoryzacji", i.e. authentication and/or *authorization*, a term the English does not use.

examples.source: There are also quite a few more gates than you started with because of the need to insert SWAP instructions after choosing a layout.
examples.suggested: Jest też znacznie więcej bramek niż na początku, ponieważ po wyborze rozmieszczenia konieczne było wstawienie instrukcji SWAP.
examples.translation: Jest też nieco więcej bramek niż na początku, ponieważ po wyborze układu konieczne było wstawienie instrukcji SWAP.
examples.why: "nieco więcej" means "slightly more" and softens the English "quite a few more"; it contradicts the counts printed immediately above (49 CX in → 146 CZ + 6 ECR + 302 SX + 250 RZ out) and flattens the pedagogical point that routing/SWAP insertion carries substantial overhead.

examples.source: how a circuit is laid out across the qubits of a backend / builds a circuit that creates a large GHZ state / The transpiled circuit now contains…
examples.suggested: …w jaki obwód jest rozłożony na kubitach backendu / buduje obwód tworzący duży stan GHZ / Transpilowany obwód zawiera teraz…
examples.translation: sposobu, w jaki Circuit jest rozłożony na Qubitach backendu / buduje Circuit tworzący duży stan GHZ / Transpilowany Circuit zawiera teraz…
examples.why: "circuit" is correctly translated as "obwód" in the first half of the file (lines 44, 46, 54, 283) but left as untranslated, capitalized "Circuit" from the transpilation section onward — the same concept rendered two ways inside one page, and English-style capitalization of a common noun that no Polish technical writer would use.

examples.source: Transpile against custom backends / transpiler passes / Create unique backends
examples.suggested: Transpilacja względem niestandardowych backendów / przebiegów transpilera / Tworzenie unikalnych backendów
examples.translation: Transpilacja względem niestandardowych Backend'ów / przejść Transpiler'a / Tworzenie unikalnych Backend'ów
examples.why: Polish does not use an apostrophe to decline loanwords ending in a pronounced consonant: "Backend'ów", "Backend'u", "Transpiler'a" are orthographically wrong, and the earlier sections already get it right ("backendów", "backendu", "Transpilerowi"). Reads as machine output, not a Polish engineer's writing.

examples.source: qubit lattice / qubit arrangement / Each qubit is labeled / qubit connectivity
examples.suggested: pick one convention, e.g. "siatką kubitów", "rozmieszczenia kubitów", "Każdy kubit jest oznaczony", "łączność kubitów"
examples.translation: siatką Qubitów / rozmieszczenia Qubitów / Każdy qubit jest oznaczony / łączność kubitów
examples.why: Three renderings of the same core term in one file — capitalized "Qubitów/Qubity", lowercase "qubit", and the Polish "kubitów" — mixing both the q/k spelling and the capitalization. Recognizable, but an editor would unify it.

examples.source: This is where any required credential and/or authentication tasks are handled.
examples.suggested: To właśnie tutaj obsługiwane są wszelkie wymagane zadania związane z poświadczeniami i/lub uwierzytelnianiem.
examples.translation: To właśnie tutaj obsługiwane są wszelkie wymagane zadania uwierzytelniania i/lub autoryzacji.
examples.why: The pair is shifted by one: "credential" became "uwierzytelnianie" (authentication) and "authentication" became "autoryzacja" (authorization). Authorization is a distinct concept the English never mentions.

editor_note: Nothing here misleads — every claim, quantity and comparison matches the English (including the error-hierarchy sentence "błędy readout są zazwyczaj większe niż błędy operacji dwu-qubitowych, które z kolei są zazwyczaj większe niż…") and the informal "ty" register holds throughout ("Twój dostęp do QPU może się różnić", "Spróbuj", "Porównaj"). The recurring defect is inconsistent, half-translated terminology: "gate" appears as Polish "bramkę splątującą" in §2.2 but is left as capitalized English inside Polish syntax in §3.2 ("Błędy Gate i readout", "Przejdźmy teraz do błędów Gate", "mediany błędów dla Gate 'sx' i 'ecr'"), and the same happens with "wizualizatory Circuit" in the Appendix, where "wizualizatory obwodów" is the ordinary Polish term. "Qubit" is likewise split four ways — "Qubity" (capitalized mid-sentence), "qubitów", "dwukubitową" and the nonstandard hyphenation "dwu-qubitowych". "Heavy-hex lattice" is rendered as the odd literal "siatki ciężkiego heksa" (rescued only by the parenthesized English gloss); "sieć heavy-hex" or "ciężka sieć heksagonalna" is what a Polish hardware engineer would write. Finally a few calqued constructions survive: "zaktualizuj nazwę Backend odpowiednio" (English word order; natural Polish is "odpowiednio zaktualizuj nazwę backendu") and "w IBM Quantum Platform" instead of "na platformie IBM Quantum".

examples.source: gate errors / the median errors for the 'sx' and the 'ecr' gates
examples.suggested: Błędy bramek i odczytu / Przejdźmy teraz do błędów bramek / mediany błędów bramek 'sx' i 'ecr'
examples.translation: Błędy Gate i readout / Przejdźmy teraz do błędów Gate / mediany błędów dla Gate 'sx' i 'ecr' — while §2.2 uses "dwukubitową bramkę splątującą"

examples.source: The topology is called a "heavy-hex lattice".

examples.source: nodes are qubits which are numbered / 127 qubits / the 2-qubit operation … the 1-qubit operation

examples.source: on IBM Quantum® Platform … Your access to QPUs might differ; update the backend name accordingly.

examples.source: It includes circuit visualizers, state and distribution visualizers, and target visualizer. You already used the first two in the previous jupyter notebooks.
examples.suggested: Obejmuje ona wizualizatory obwodów, stanów i rozkładów oraz wizualizator obiektu Target. Pierwszych dwóch używałeś już w poprzednich notatnikach Jupyter.

examples.why: "wizualizatory Circuit" mixes an untranslated English noun into a Polish list whose other members ARE translated ("stanu i rozkładu"), and the passive "były już używane" drops the English's direct address to the learner ("You already used…"), flattening the teaching voice.

editor_note: The body prose is faithful, natural and consistently informal ("você"), with sound conventions kept throughout: "cargas de trabalho", "unidades de processamento quântico (QPUs)", "instâncias", "token de API / chave de API", and "job(s)" left in English exactly as IBM's pt-BR docs do ("enviar jobs", "seus jobs são executados", "dados do job"). The one thing a native technical editor would change is the frontmatter `description`: "…para enviar jobs do Qiskit SDK e do Qiskit Runtime para usuários com convites por e-mail" stacks two "para" clauses, so the sentence reads as if the jobs are sent *to* invited users, whereas the English "for users with email invitations" qualifies the instructions, not the job submission. Rewording the second clause to "destinadas a usuários com convites por e-mail" restores the English attachment. No semantic drift, no dropped caveats and no terminology splits were found in the body — the conditional in "Você pode acessar qualquer região usando a mesma chave de API, mas só pode ver e acessar as instâncias que foram criadas na região em que você está conectado" preserves the English restriction exactly.

examples.source: Setup instructions for IBM Quantum on IBM Cloud to submit Qiskit SDK and Qiskit Runtime jobs for users with email invitations
