examples.source: To keep the demo short and to make a clean comparison, we therefore run the same seven-qubit instance...
examples.suggested: Aby demonstracja pozostała krótka i pozwalała na czyste porównanie, uruchamiamy tę samą siedmioqubitową instancję...
examples.translation: Aby demo było krótkie i umożliwiało czystą porównanie, uruchamiamy tę samą siedmio-qubitową instancję...
examples.why: 'czystą porównanie' is an outright gender-agreement error (porównanie is neuter → 'czyste porównanie'). 'siedmio-qubitowej/siedmio-qubitową' should also be written solid ('siedmioqubitowej') in Polish.

examples.source: A statevector simulator is exact (up to shot noise) and shows us the method end-to-end without consuming QPU time.
examples.suggested: Symulator wektora stanu jest dokładny (z dokładnością do szumu statystycznego wynikającego ze skończonej liczby powtórzeń) ...
examples.translation: Symulator wektora stanu jest dokładny (z wyjątkiem szumu strzałów) i pokazuje nam metodę od początku do końca bez zużywania czasu QPU.
examples.why: 'szum strzałów' is a word-for-word calque of 'shot noise'; Polish uses 'szum śrutowy' generally and 'szum statystyczny / szum skończonej liczby powtórzeń' in the quantum-sampling sense. Recognizable, so not misleading, but not the conventional term.

examples.source: as in, when the inner product in the feature-mapped space can be written in terms of the original data vectors
examples.suggested: tzn. gdy iloczyn skalarny w przestrzeni cech można wyrazić za pomocą oryginalnych wektorów danych
examples.translation: tzn. gdy iloczyn skalarny w przestrzeni z odwzorowanymi cechami można wyrazić w kategoriach oryginalnych wektorów danych
examples.why: 'w kategoriach' is the classic Polish calque of English 'in terms of'; a native technical writer writes 'za pomocą' / 'przy użyciu' / 'poprzez'.

examples.source: Kernel methods are commonplace in machine learning applications. / The goal of Psi(x) is to make categories of data separated by a hyperplane.
examples.suggested: Metody jądrowe są powszechne w uczeniu maszynowym. / Celem Psi(x) jest sprawienie, by kategorie danych dały się rozdzielić hiperpłaszczyzną.
examples.translation: Metody jądrowe są powszechnie stosowane w zastosowaniach uczenia maszynowego. / Celem Psi(x) jest uczynienie kategorii danych rozdzielonymi przez hiperpłaszczyznę.
examples.why: 'stosowane w zastosowaniach' repeats the same stem in one clause, and 'uczynienie ... rozdzielonymi przez' is a stiff calque of the English passive; both read as fluent MT rather than native technical prose.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift found: the four PUB elements, the commuting-observables admonition, the stds/ensemble_standard_error distinction ("Quando você não habilita o twirling, `stds` e `ensemble_standard_error` são iguais"), and the ZNE paragraph all track the English exactly, and core terms are right and consistent (valor esperado, observáveis, medição, primitiva, desvio padrão, shots/twirling kept in English). Three editorial nits: (1) "circuit" is rendered two ways in prose — "o mesmo Circuit" and the placeholder "`<Circuit único>`" keep the English noun capitalized, while everywhere else it is "circuito" ("vincular o circuito", "objetos `Parameter` do circuito"); the bare capitalized "Backend IBM®" is the same tic. (2) "formato" is overloaded: it renders both "format" ("Cada PUB está neste formato") and "shape" ("cada elemento do formato broadcast", "dependendo do formato ou estrutura do PUB"), where a native technical writer would use "forma" or keep "shape" for the array sense. (3) In the intro, "as opções de runtime especificadas pela primitiva" attributes the option-setting to the primitive, whereas the English "specified from the primitive" means the user sets them on it — a mild agency shift, not misleading.

examples.source: Commuting observables in different PUBs, even if they have the same circuit, are not estimated by using the same measurement.
examples.suggested: ... mesmo que tenham o mesmo circuito, ...
examples.translation: Os observáveis que comutam em PUBs diferentes, mesmo que tenham o mesmo Circuit, não são estimados usando a mesma medição.
examples.why: "circuit" is left as the capitalized English noun "Circuit" here and in the PUB placeholder "`<Circuit único>`", while the rest of the file (lines 54, 58) correctly uses "circuito" — within-file inconsistency, not misleading.

examples.source: ...and one expectation value estimate is returned for each element of the broadcasted shape.
examples.suggested: ...para cada elemento da forma (shape) resultante do broadcast.
examples.translation: ...e uma estimativa de valor esperado é retornada para cada elemento do formato broadcast.
examples.why: "formato" is already used two lines above for "format" ("Cada PUB está neste formato"), so the same word now carries the array-shape sense; "forma" or keeping "shape" would keep the two concepts distinct for the learner.

examples.source: ...the results are returned in a format that is dependent on both the PUBs used as well as the runtime options specified from the primitive.
examples.suggested: ...quanto das opções de runtime especificadas na primitiva.
examples.translation: ...os resultados são retornados em um formato que depende tanto dos PUBs usados quanto das opções de runtime especificadas pela primitiva.
examples.why: "pela primitiva" makes the primitive the agent that specifies the options; the English means the user specifies them from/on the primitive. Mild agency shift, and the source phrasing is itself loose, so it does not mislead.

editor_note: The bulk of the file is fluent, faithful Romanian with correct math prose and consistent informal "tu" ("să parcurgi", "să verifici", "Dar ce zici de..."), and the four-case analysis and the geometric section track the English exactly. Two things a native technical editor must fix. (1) The English closing sentence about the 2022 Nobel Prize ("The 2022 Nobel Prize in Physics acknowledges the importance of this line of work: ... Alain Aspect, John Clauser (the C in CHSH) and Anton Zeilinger ... Bell tests on entangled photons.") is entirely absent — the Romanian Remarks section simply stops at "...de a *observa* entanglement-ul." (2) The circuit-diagram paragraph is glossary-leak wreckage: "controlled gate" appears as "Gate-uri obișnuite controlate", "poartă-uri controlate" (not a Romanian word), "un tip diferit de poartă controlat" and "un poartă controlat obișnuit" (masculine agreement on the feminine "poartă") within three consecutive sentences; "qubit" likewise oscillates between "qubit-ul ei", "qubitului său" and capitalized "Qubiți"/"Qubitului său". Smaller: "Iată un circuit diagrama" is ungrammatical and drops "cuantic"; "a razona" (twice) should be "a raționa"; "probabilitățile că $a=b$" should be "probabilitatea ca ... să"; "toți numerele reale" should be "toate numerele reale"; and "poate fi imposibil de calculat strategiile optime" hardens the English "impossibly difficult" into flat "impossible".

examples.source: The 2022 Nobel Prize in Physics acknowledges the importance of this line of work: the prize was awarded to Alain Aspect, John Clauser (the C in CHSH) and Anton Zeilinger for observing entanglement through Bell tests on entangled photons.
examples.suggested: Premiul Nobel pentru Fizică din 2022 recunoaște importanța acestei direcții de cercetare: premiul a fost acordat lui Alain Aspect, John Clauser (C-ul din CHSH) și Anton Zeilinger pentru observarea entanglementului prin teste Bell pe fotoni întricați.
examples.translation: (missing — the Romanian file ends at "...ne oferă o modalitate concretă și testabilă de a *observa* entanglement-ul.")
examples.why: An entire substantive closing sentence of the lesson is dropped. The Romanian reader never learns that this line of work won the 2022 Nobel Prize, and the paragraph loses its rhetorical payoff after "grad ridicat de încredere că entanglement-ul este real".

examples.source: we see two ordinary controlled gates ... two gates that look like controlled gates ... a different type of controlled gate where the gate is performed if the control is set to 0 (rather than 1 like an ordinary controlled gate).
examples.suggested: vedem două porți controlate obișnuite ... două porți care arată ca niște porți controlate ... un tip diferit de poartă controlată, în care poarta este aplicată dacă controlul este setat pe $0$ (în loc de $1$, ca la o poartă controlată obișnuită).
examples.translation: vedem două Gate-uri obișnuite controlate ... două Gate-uri care arată ca niște poartă-uri controlate ... un tip diferit de poartă controlat, unde Gate-ul este efectuat dacă controlul este setat la $0$ (în loc de $1$ ca un poartă controlat obișnuit).
examples.why: "poartă-uri" is not a Romanian word (the plural is "porți"), and "un poartă controlat" / "de poartă controlat" put masculine agreement on the feminine noun "poartă". Three renderings of one term — "Gate-uri", "poartă-uri", "poartă" — collide inside a single paragraph; it reads as raw glossary substitution.

examples.source: together the two qubits (A,B) ... she applies U_0 to her qubit A ... Alice performs U_0 on her qubit
examples.suggested: Use one form throughout, lowercase and inflected natively: "cei doi qubiți", "aplică $U_0$ qubitului ei $\mathsf{A}$", "Alice aplică $U_0$ pe qubitul ei".
examples.translation: împreună cei doi Qubiți $(\mathsf{A},\mathsf{B})$ ... aplică $U_{0}$ Qubitului său $\mathsf{A}$ ... Alice aplică $U_{0}$ pe qubit-ul ei
examples.why: "qubit" appears as capitalized "Qubiți"/"Qubitului" in the strategy description but lowercase "qubit-ul ei"/"qubitului ei" in the case analysis and geometric section, plus a stray hyphen in "qubit-ul". Also "Qubitului său" for Alice should be "qubitului ei".

examples.source: Here is a quantum circuit diagram that describes this strategy:
examples.suggested: Iată o diagramă de circuit cuantic care descrie această strategie:
examples.translation: Iată un circuit diagrama care descrie această strategie:
examples.why: "un circuit diagrama" is ungrammatical — an English noun-noun compound left in English order with mismatched gender/article — and "quantum" is dropped. No Romanian technical writer would produce this.

examples.source: for some games it can be impossibly difficult to compute best or near-best strategies for Alice and Bob
examples.suggested: pentru unele jocuri poate fi extrem de dificil să se calculeze strategiile optime sau aproape optime pentru Alice și Bob
examples.translation: pentru unele jocuri poate fi imposibil de calculat strategiile optime sau aproape optime pentru Alice și Bob
examples.why: "impossibly difficult" is a hyperbolic intensifier meaning "extremely hard"; "imposibil de calculat" states flatly that the strategies cannot be computed, strengthening the claim. The construction "poate fi imposibil de calculat strategiile" is also ungrammatical (needs "să se calculeze strategiile").

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout the technical core (SQD/SKQD steps, noise robustness, provable convergence, the four-stage Slurm workflow) and the heavy keep-English convention (qubit, gate, circuit, ansatz, Hamiltonian, subspace, bitstring, shot, Sampler) is consistent and correct, with informal register held (no ครับ/ค่ะ). What a native editor would change: a recurring English-calqued adverb order "มัน/ที่ได้ จากนั้น + verb" for "It then…" (lines 54, 239, 342, 380) that a Thai writer would render "จากนั้นมันจะ…"; the opening drops "one of" so "one of the most important challenges in science" becomes the absolute "ปัญหาที่สำคัญที่สุดในวิทยาศาสตร์"; "keep the explanation at a high level" is rendered "คงการอธิบายในระดับสูง", which a Thai reader can read as "at an advanced level" — the opposite of the intended overview sense (better: "ในระดับภาพรวม"); "leading candidate" becomes the person-noun "ผู้สมัครชั้นนำ" (a job applicant) instead of "ตัวเลือกชั้นนำ". Smaller slips: "seven bath sites" left half-untranslated as "พร้อม seven bath site"; one lone transliteration "บิตสตริง" against "bitstring" everywhere else, in a clause "ถูกสุ่มตัวอย่างเลย" that reads broken for "sampled at all"; and "polynomially large" flipped to "polynomial ขนาดใหญ่" ("a large polynomial"). None of these teaches a false concept, so this is MINOR, not FAIL.

examples.source: …to solve one of the most important challenges in science: accurately estimating the energy of molecules and materials.
examples.suggested: …เพื่อแก้หนึ่งในปัญหาที่สำคัญที่สุดในวิทยาศาสตร์: …
examples.translation: …เพื่อแก้ปัญหาที่สำคัญที่สุดในวิทยาศาสตร์: การประมาณพลังงานของโมเลกุลและวัสดุอย่างแม่นยำ
examples.why: The qualifier "one of" is dropped, turning a hedged framing into the absolute claim that this is THE most important challenge in science.

examples.source: For our purposes in this course, we will keep the explanation at a high level.
examples.suggested: สำหรับคอร์สนี้ เราจะอธิบายในระดับภาพรวมเท่านั้น
examples.translation: สำหรับวัตถุประสงค์ในคอร์สนี้ เราจะคงการอธิบายในระดับสูง
examples.why: "ในระดับสูง" in Thai normally means "at an advanced level", the opposite of English "high-level" (= general/not detailed); it undercuts the contrast with the deep-dive course just referenced.

examples.source: It then generates the quantum circuits… / It then calls sampler.run()… / It then passes the measured bitstrings…
examples.suggested: จากนั้นมันจะสร้าง quantum circuit… / จากนั้นจึงเรียก `sampler.run()`… / จากนั้นจะส่ง bitstring ที่วัดได้…
examples.translation: มันจากนั้นสร้าง quantum circuit… / มันจากนั้นเรียก `sampler.run()`… / มันจากนั้นส่ง bitstring ที่วัดได้…
examples.why: Word-for-word calque of English "It then …" — Thai puts จากนั้น before the subject/verb; the pattern repeats across the whole programming-practice section and reads as machine output.

examples.source: …make it a leading candidate for demonstrating quantum advantage
examples.suggested: …ทำให้เป็นตัวเลือกชั้นนำสำหรับการสาธิตความได้เปรียบเชิงควอนตัม
examples.translation: …ทำให้เป็นผู้สมัครชั้นนำสำหรับการสาธิตความได้เปรียบเชิงควอนตัม
examples.why: "ผู้สมัคร" is a human applicant; applied to an algorithm it is a literal-but-wrong rendering of "candidate".

examples.source: If these are sampled at all… / an Anderson impurity model with seven bath sites
examples.suggested: ขอเพียงถูกสุ่มได้แม้เพียงครั้งเดียว… / Anderson impurity model ที่มี bath site เจ็ดตัว
examples.translation: ถ้าบิตสตริงเหล่านั้นถูกสุ่มตัวอย่างเลย… / Anderson impurity model พร้อม seven bath site
examples.why: Lone transliteration "บิตสตริง" breaks the file's otherwise uniform Latin "bitstring", the affirmative "…เลย" is ungrammatical for "at all", and the numeral "seven" is left untranslated inside Thai prose.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inverted conditions, dropped caveats or swapped quantities; the 50-qubit ceiling, the 15 May 2024 retirement, the "local testing mode has no built-in error suppression/mitigation, you must specify it explicitly" note and the Open Plan sessions caution all land correctly, and the keep-English convention for qubit / circuit / noise model / transpiler / backend / snapshot is consistent and appropriate. What a native technical editor would still fix: (1) "การคอมพิวติ้งเชิงควอนตัม" (opening paragraph and again in the third hardware bullet) is an awkward transliteration hybrid — Thai technical prose says "การคำนวณเชิงควอนตัม"; (2) an outright broken phrase in the AerSimulator note, "หากงานของมุ่งเป้าไปที่ QPU เฉพาะ", where the possessive "ของ" is left dangling with no "คุณ"; (3) the file splits "simulate/simulation" between native "จำลอง" (การจำลองคอมพิวเตอร์ควอนตัม, จำลองพฤติกรรม, QPU ที่จำลอง) and English-inline "การ simulate / การ simulation" within the same sections; (4) "และส่งไปยัง Aer Aer จะสร้าง noise model" reads as a stutter because the sentence break falls between two occurrences of "Aer"; (5) small qualifier losses ("Mimics specific IBM QPUs" → plain "จำลองพฤติกรรม IBM QPUs"; "higher-performance" → flat "ประสิทธิภาพสูง"). Informal register holds — no ครับ/ค่ะ anywhere.

examples.source: In quantum computing, the choice between using simulators and quantum hardware is crucial...
examples.suggested: ในการคำนวณเชิงควอนตัม การเลือกว่าจะใช้ simulator หรือฮาร์ดแวร์ควอนตัมจริงนั้นสำคัญมาก...
examples.translation: ในการคอมพิวติ้งเชิงควอนตัม การเลือกว่าจะใช้ simulator หรือฮาร์ดแวร์ควอนตัมจริงนั้นสำคัญมาก...
examples.why: "คอมพิวติ้ง" is a raw transliteration bolted onto a Thai classifier phrase; standard Thai technical writing uses การคำนวณเชิงควอนตัม (or leaves the whole term as "quantum computing"). The hybrid reads as MT, not as something a Thai quantum engineer wrote. Same phrasing recurs in the third hardware-skills bullet.

examples.source: However, if your work targets a specific QPU, a fake backend might be a better choice.
examples.suggested: อย่างไรก็ตาม หากงานของคุณมุ่งเป้าไปที่ QPU ใดเป็นการเฉพาะ fake backend อาจเป็นตัวเลือกที่ดีกว่า
examples.translation: อย่างไรก็ตาม หากงานของมุ่งเป้าไปที่ QPU เฉพาะ fake backend อาจเป็นตัวเลือกที่ดีกว่า
examples.why: "งานของ" leaves the possessive particle ของ with no possessor — ungrammatical Thai, clearly a dropped pronoun rather than the deliberate pronoun-less style used elsewhere in the file.

examples.source: simulate / simulation (throughout)
examples.suggested: pick one convention per context and hold it — e.g. keep การจำลอง for the act of simulating and reserve the English word for the product names (AerSimulator, Clifford simulation)
examples.translation: mixed: การจำลองคอมพิวเตอร์ควอนตัม, จำลองพฤติกรรม, QPU ที่จำลอง vs. สามารถ simulate ได้, การ simulation อเนกประสงค์, การ simulate QPU แบบมี noise
examples.why: The same verb is rendered natively in some sentences and left in English in adjacent ones, sometimes within one table row ("การ simulation ที่มีประสิทธิภาพสำหรับ Clifford circuits" next to "QPU ที่จำลอง"). Not confusing, but a native editor would unify it.

examples.source: ...specify a QPU (quantum hardware) and submit it to Aer.  Aer builds a noise model based on the calibration data from that QPU...
examples.suggested: ให้ระบุ QPU (ฮาร์ดแวร์ควอนตัม) แล้วส่งไปให้ Aer จากนั้น Aer จะสร้าง noise model จากข้อมูล calibration ของ QPU นั้น...
examples.translation: ให้ระบุ QPU (ฮาร์ดแวร์ควอนตัม) และส่งไปยัง Aer Aer จะสร้าง noise model จากข้อมูล calibration ของ QPU นั้น...
examples.why: Thai has no sentence-final period, so the English sentence break produces the stutter "Aer Aer"; a Thai writer would bridge with จากนั้น/ซึ่ง instead of repeating the bare name.

examples.source: Mimics specific IBM QPUs by using snapshots / ...provides higher-performance simulation that can handle larger circuits
examples.suggested: จำลองพฤติกรรมของ IBM QPU ตัวใดตัวหนึ่งโดยเฉพาะ โดยใช้ snapshots / ซึ่งให้การจำลองที่ประสิทธิภาพสูงกว่า รองรับ circuits ที่ใหญ่กว่าได้
examples.translation: จำลองพฤติกรรม IBM QPUs โดยใช้ snapshots / ซึ่งให้การ simulation ประสิทธิภาพสูงที่รองรับ circuits ขนาดใหญ่
examples.why: Two comparatives/qualifiers flatten: "specific" is dropped (the whole point of a fake backend is that it mirrors one named QPU) and "higher-performance"/"larger" become absolute rather than comparative-to-fake-backends. It does not mislead, but the table's contrast is slightly blunted.

editor_note: Nothing here misleads a learner — every claim, quantity and caveat matches the English — but a native editor would rework several term choices. "Optimization" is rendered three ways in one file: การปรับแต่ง ("tuning/adjusting", title, description, §Background) vs. bare English "optimization" (lines 543/544/639) vs. การหาค่าต่ำสุด for the minimization problem; การปรับแต่ง is the weak one, since Thai technical writing uses การหาค่าเหมาะที่สุด, and the same word is reused a line later in its literal "adapted" sense (line 77, "ได้รับการปรับแต่งให้เหมาะกับ topology แบบ heavy-hex"), blurring term and ordinary prose. "Objective function" is likewise split: ฟังก์ชันเป้าหมาย (lines 25, 31, 77, 79) vs. ฟังก์ชัน objective (line 498); "ground state energy" appears as ค่าพลังงานสภาวะพื้นฐาน (line 25, where the standard physics term is พลังงานสถานะพื้น) but as bare English "ground state" at line 639. Residual translationese: the §Background heading is พื้นหลัง (the picture-backdrop sense), line 27 repeats "hardware" twice in one clause, and "random-bond" is calqued with English word order as แบบสุ่ม-พันธะ. Register convention holds — no ครับ/ค่ะ anywhere.

examples.source: Higher-order binary optimization … The Optimization Solver can be used for general optimization problems
examples.suggested: การหาค่าเหมาะที่สุดแบบไบนารีอันดับสูง … ปัญหาการหาค่าเหมาะที่สุด (pick one rendering and keep it, or keep "optimization" in English throughout)
examples.translation: การปรับแต่งไบนารีอันดับสูง … ปัญหาการปรับแต่งทั่วไป … (later) ปัญหา optimization / optimization algorithm
examples.why: การปรับแต่ง means "tuning/adjusting", not "optimization", and the file abandons it for bare English "optimization" in the later sections. Line 77 then uses the same word in its literal sense (the problem "ได้รับการปรับแต่งให้เหมาะกับ topology แบบ heavy-hex"), so the reader cannot separate the domain term from ordinary prose. Recognizable in context, hence MINOR.

examples.source: The Solver accepts a string representation of the objective function.
examples.suggested: Solver รับฟังก์ชันเป้าหมายในรูปแบบ string
examples.translation: Solver รับการแสดงแทนแบบ string ของฟังก์ชัน objective
examples.why: The tutorial's central term is ฟังก์ชันเป้าหมาย in four earlier places and "ฟังก์ชัน objective" here — within-file inconsistency. การแสดงแทนแบบ string is also a stiff calque of "string representation".

examples.source: find the ground-state energy of a random-bond 156-qubit Ising model … find the minimum ground state of the Ising model
examples.suggested: หาพลังงานสถานะพื้นของโมเดล Ising แบบพันธะสุ่ม 156 คิวบิต … การหาสถานะพื้นที่ต่ำที่สุดของโมเดล Ising
examples.translation: หาค่าพลังงานสภาวะพื้นฐานของโมเดล Ising แบบสุ่ม-พันธะ 156-Qubit … การหา ground state ต่ำสุดของ Ising model
examples.why: สภาวะพื้นฐาน is not the conventional Thai physics term for the ground state (สถานะพื้น), and the same concept is left in English at line 639. แบบสุ่ม-พันธะ copies English word order with a hyphen; Thai puts the modifier last (พันธะสุ่ม).

examples.source: The Optimization fully automates the hardware-aware implementation steps of solving optimization problems on quantum hardware
examples.suggested: Optimization Solver จัดการขั้นตอนการรันบนฮาร์ดแวร์ที่ต้องคำนึงถึงคุณสมบัติของเครื่องให้เป็นอัตโนมัติทั้งหมด
examples.translation: Optimization Solver ทำให้ขั้นตอนการนำไปใช้งานบน hardware ที่ต้องรับรู้สภาพ hardware เป็นอัตโนมัติทั้งหมด
examples.why: "hardware" appears twice in a single clause and the ทำให้…เป็นอัตโนมัติ frame is stretched across a long modifier; reads as machine output rather than something a Thai engineer would write.

examples.source: ## Background
examples.suggested: ## ความเป็นมา (or ภูมิหลัง)
examples.translation: ## พื้นหลัง
examples.why: พื้นหลัง is the visual-backdrop sense (image or screen background); a document section header takes ความเป็นมา / ภูมิหลัง. Dictionary-first-sense calque.

examples.source: If the algorithm consistently finds lower costs, it suggests the quantum algorithm is effectively solving the optimization problem.
examples.suggested: … ก็บ่งชี้ว่า quantum algorithm กำลังแก้ปัญหาได้อย่างมีประสิทธิภาพ
examples.translation: หาก algorithm หาค่าต้นทุนที่ต่ำกว่าได้อย่างสม่ำเสมอ แสดงว่า quantum algorithm กำลังแก้ปัญหา optimization ได้อย่างมีประสิทธิภาพ
examples.why: "suggests" is a hedge, but แสดงว่า reads as "shows/means that", firming a tentative inference into a demonstrated fact. Mild — the file uses บ่งชี้ว่า correctly for "indicate" at line 639, so the softer wording was available.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout and nothing here would teach a learner a false concept — the spectral-theorem statement, the |λ|=1 derivation, and all three closing remarks (including the θ≈0.999 wrap-around example) track the English exactly, and the informal register holds with no ครับ/ค่ะ. What a native technical editor would change is vocabulary and phrasing. Basic Thai math words that every Thai textbook has are left in Latin script: "matrix" and "square matrix" instead of เมทริกซ์/เมทริกซ์จัตุรัส, and "theorem" instead of ทฤษฎีบท even in the heading "การระบุ Theorem" and in "Theorem บอกว่า"; "orthonormal basis" is also rendered with inverted word order as "basis orthonormal" (lines 112, 167). Two word choices are wrong-but-recoverable: "for a unique real number θ" becomes "จำนวนจริงเอกลักษณ์" (เอกลักษณ์ reads as *identity/distinctive*, not *exactly one*), and "*any* orthonormal basis" becomes "*ทุก* basis orthonormal" (every, not any-you-like) — the claim stays true, so it does not mislead, but neither is idiomatic. Add persistent MT calques — "ตอบสนองสมการ" for *satisfy* (should be สอดคล้องกับ, 3×), "ยกเลิกมันจากทั้งสองด้าน" for *cancel from both sides* (should be ตัดออก), "ไม่มีอะไรป้องกันเราจากการพิจารณา" — plus a dropped "unitary" in line 268 (recovered by the next clause) and a run-on at line 185 where "เป็น normal Spectral theorem บอกว่า" merges two sentences with no break.

examples.source: for a unique real number $\theta$ satisfying $0\leq\theta<1.$
examples.suggested: สำหรับจำนวนจริง $\theta$ เพียงค่าเดียวที่สอดคล้องกับ $0\leq\theta<1$
examples.translation: สำหรับจำนวนจริงเอกลักษณ์ $\theta$ ที่ตอบสนอง $0\leq\theta<1$
examples.why: เอกลักษณ์ means *identity / distinctive characteristic* in Thai; it does not carry the mathematical 'exactly one such θ exists' sense that the whole λ = e^{2πiθ} parametrisation rests on. ตอบสนอง (respond to) is also the standard MT calque for 'satisfy'; Thai math uses สอดคล้องกับ.

examples.source: Indeed, we could choose $\{\vert\psi_1\rangle,\vert\psi_2\rangle\}$ to be *any* orthonormal basis and the equation will be true.
examples.suggested: อันที่จริง เราจะเลือก $\{\vert\psi_1\rangle,\vert\psi_2\rangle\}$ เป็นฐานเชิงตั้งฉากปรกติ *ใดก็ได้* แล้วสมการก็ยังเป็นจริง
examples.translation: อันที่จริง เราสามารถเลือก $\{\vert\psi_1\rangle,\vert\psi_2\rangle\}$ เป็น *ทุก* basis orthonormal และสมการจะเป็นความจริง
examples.why: 'any' (free choice) is rendered as ทุก ('every'), which is ungrammatical as the object of เลือก and loses the italicised emphasis on the freedom of choice — the exact point the sentence is making. The truth value survives, so this is not misleading, but no Thai writer would phrase it this way.

examples.source: normal matrices / square matrix / Theorem statement / orthonormal basis
examples.suggested: เมทริกซ์แบบนอร์มัล / เมทริกซ์จัตุรัส / การกล่าวถึงทฤษฎีบท / ฐานเชิงตั้งฉากปรกติ
examples.translation: normal matrix / square matrix / การระบุ Theorem / basis orthonormal
examples.why: matrix and theorem have completely standard Thai renderings (เมทริกซ์, ทฤษฎีบท) taught in every Thai linear-algebra course; leaving them in Latin script — and inverting 'orthonormal basis' into 'basis orthonormal' — reads as an untranslated glossary leak rather than a deliberate keep-English convention like unitary/Hermitian/eigenvalue.

examples.source: so we can cancel it from both sides to obtain
examples.suggested: ดังนั้นเราจึงตัดมันออกจากทั้งสองข้างได้ แล้วจะได้ว่า
examples.translation: ดังนั้นเราสามารถยกเลิกมันจากทั้งสองด้านเพื่อได้
examples.why: ยกเลิก means to cancel an appointment or an order, not to cancel a common factor; Thai math says ตัดออกจากทั้งสองข้าง. 'เพื่อได้' is also a bare calque of 'to obtain' — a native writer would write ...ตัดออกจากทั้งสองข้างได้ แล้วจะได้ว่า.

examples.source: This is a unitary matrix, so it is normal. The spectral theorem implies that $H$ can be written in the form $(1),$
examples.suggested: นี่คือเมทริกซ์แบบยูนิแทรี ดังนั้นมันจึงเป็นนอร์มัล ทฤษฎีบทสเปกตรัมบ่งบอกว่า $H$ เขียนในรูปแบบ $(1)$ ได้
examples.translation: นี่คือ unitary matrix ดังนั้นมันเป็น normal Spectral theorem บอกว่า $H$ สามารถเขียนใน รูปแบบ $(1),$
examples.why: Two sentences are run together with no break ('...เป็น normal Spectral theorem บอกว่า...'), so the reader momentarily parses 'normal Spectral theorem' as one noun phrase. Also 'implies' is flattened to บอกว่า ('says'), losing the deductive force the surrounding proof-style prose carries.

editor_note: Physics is faithful throughout — the d→Z / c→X assignment, the A-control/B-target CNOT, the B→c and A→d measurement mapping, and all four cd cases match the English exactly, and the double negative in "hindi ito nangangahulugang ang superdense coding ay hindi kawili-wili" is preserved correctly. Nothing misleads, but several renderings are calques a native technical editor would rewrite: "In words, here is what Alice does" becomes the literal "Sa salita, narito ang ginagawa ni Alice" (should be "Sa madaling salita"); "the conventions in place for the lesson" becomes "ang mga kasunduan sa aralin", where *kasunduan* means an agreement/pact rather than a notational convention (*kumbensiyon* / *panuntunan*); and Holevo's theorem's consequence uses "imposibleng makipag-komunikasyon ng higit sa isang bit", where *makipag-komunikasyon* is the intransitive social verb and cannot take "more than one bit" as an object (*maiparating* / *maipadala*). Measurement is also rendered inconsistently: the verb is *sukatin/sinusukat* (correct) but the noun in "kapag nagsasagawa si Bob ng kanyang mga sukat" uses *mga sukat*, which reads as "dimensions/sizes" rather than measurement operations, and the same sentence shifts to future aspect ("Susunod ay susukatin niya") against the present-tense narration around it.

examples.source: In words, here is what Alice does:
examples.suggested: Sa madaling salita, ito ang ginagawa ni Alice:
examples.translation: Sa salita, narito ang ginagawa ni Alice:
examples.why: Word-for-word calque of "in words"; bare "sa salita" is not an idiomatic Tagalog discourse marker and reads as machine output.

examples.source: According to the conventions in place for the lesson
examples.suggested: Ayon sa mga kumbensiyon (o panuntunan) na ginagamit sa araling ito
examples.translation: Ayon sa mga kasunduan sa aralin
examples.why: "Kasunduan" means an agreement or pact between parties, not a notational/naming convention; the learner reads it as Alice and Bob having agreed on something.

examples.source: it is impossible to communicate more than one bit of classical information by sending a single qubit
examples.suggested: imposibleng maiparating ang higit sa isang bit ng classical information sa pamamagitan ng pagpapadala ng isang qubit
examples.translation: imposibleng makipag-komunikasyon ng higit sa isang bit ng classical information sa pamamagitan ng pagpapadala ng isang qubit
examples.why: "Makipag-komunikasyon" is the intransitive social verb (to communicate with someone) and cannot govern "more than one bit" as its object; the transitive sense needs maiparating/maipadala.

examples.source: So, when Bob performs his measurements, he is able to determine which Bell state Alice chose.
examples.suggested: Kaya, kapag isinasagawa ni Bob ang kanyang mga pagsukat, natutukoy niya kung aling Bell state ang pinili ni Alice.
examples.translation: Kaya, kapag nagsasagawa si Bob ng kanyang mga sukat, nagagawa niyang matukoy kung aling Bell state ang pinili ni Alice.
examples.why: The noun "mga sukat" means dimensions/sizes; the file elsewhere uses the verb sukatin/sinusukat, so the measurement concept is split between a correct verb and a wrong noun.

examples.source: He then measures B to obtain c and A to obtain d
examples.suggested: Pagkatapos ay sinusukat niya ang B para makuha ang c at ang A para makuha ang d
examples.translation: Susunod ay susukatin niya ang B para makuha ang c at ang A para makuha ang d
examples.why: Shifts to future aspect in the middle of a present-tense procedural narration (surrounding sentences use nagsasagawa/ipinapadala), breaking the steady step-by-step teaching voice of the English.

editor_note: Content is faithful throughout — no semantic inversions, quantities, or dropped caveats: even/odd parity is correctly "pantay"/"gansal", the [[2L^2,2,L]] argument, the minimal-generating-set removal argument, the two loop categories, and the closing 10% / break-even paragraphs all match the English exactly, and the informal register holds (no po/opo). What a native editor would change is translationese and a few grammar slips. Worst offenders: the comparison in the "geometric locality" bullet is structurally broken ("mas madaling ipatupad ang mga sukat na ito kaysa sa mga kinukuhang mga qubit na malayo sa isa't isa" compares measurements against qubits instead of against the counterfactual case); "Intuitively speaking" is calqued as "Intuitibong nagsasalita"; "along this path/along shortest paths" is rendered with the comitative "kasama ang landas na ito" (= "together with this path") in two places; "bend the cylinder around" becomes "baguhin ang silindro" (= "change the cylinder"), and "we could always infer" becomes "maipapaliwanag" (= "explain"). Also two aspect/inflection slips ("ilarawan ng figure na ito" for "inilalarawan"; "naayos" for "naaayos") and one within-file term split on weight ("mababang timbang" / "timbang na 4" vs. the untranslated "weight-4 na Pauli operation").

examples.source: In principle, this makes these measurements easier to implement than if they involved spatially distant qubits.
examples.suggested: Sa prinsipyo, mas madaling ipatupad ang mga pagsukat na ito kaysa kung sasangkot ang mga qubit na magkakalayo sa espasyo.
examples.translation: Sa prinsipyo, mas madaling ipatupad ang mga sukat na ito kaysa sa mga kinukuhang mga qubit na malayo sa isa't isa sa espasyo.
examples.why: The comparison is grammatically broken: it sets 'these measurements' against 'the qubits', not against the counterfactual case in the English. Double plural marker ('mga kinukuhang mga qubit') compounds it. The gist survives, so it does not mislead, but no native technical writer would write this.

examples.source: Intuitively speaking, a chain of X errors like this cannot be shrunk down to nothing...
examples.suggested: Sa madaling sabi, ang chain ng mga $X$ error na tulad nito ay hindi mababawasan hanggang sa mawala...
examples.translation: Intuitibong nagsasalita, ang isang chain ng mga $X$ error na tulad nito ay hindi maaaring bawasan sa wala...
examples.why: 'Intuitibong nagsasalita' is a word-for-word calque of the English absolute construction; in Tagalog it literally reads 'speaking intuitively [about someone]' and is not idiomatic. Classic translationese marker.

examples.source: X gates are applied as corrections to the qubits along this path / perform corrections along shortest paths
examples.suggested: ...sa mga qubit na nasa landas na ito / magsagawa ng mga correction sa mga pinakamaikling landas
examples.translation: ang mga $X$ gate ay inilalapat bilang mga correction sa mga qubit kasama ang landas na ito / magsagawa ng mga correction kasama ang mga pinakamaikling landas
examples.why: 'along' is rendered with the comitative 'kasama' (= 'together with'), so it reads 'corrections together with this path' rather than 'on the qubits lying on this path'. Recurs twice.

examples.source: ...and then bend the cylinder around so that the circles at the ends ... meet.
examples.suggested: ...pagkatapos ay iyukod/hubugin ang silindro upang magkita ang mga bilog sa mga dulo...
examples.translation: ...pagkatapos ay baguhin ang silindro upang ang mga bilog sa mga dulo ... ay magkita.
examples.why: 'bend' becomes 'baguhin' (= change/modify), losing the physical bending action that carries the torus intuition. The following clause rescues the meaning, so it is not misleading, but the geometric image is flattened.

examples.source: stabilizer generators have low weight ... they all have weight 4 / we obtain a weight-4 Pauli operation
examples.suggested: Pick one: either 'timbang na 4' throughout, or keep 'weight' in English throughout.
examples.translation: may *mababang timbang* ... lahat sila ay may timbang na 4 / nakakakuha tayo ng weight-4 na Pauli operation
examples.why: Within-file split on the core term 'weight': translated as 'timbang' in the opening bullets, then left as English 'weight-4' later. Both are recognizable so the concept stays identifiable, but the file should settle on one convention.

examples.source: ...keeping in mind that we could always infer the results of these removed generators ... from the results of all of the other stabilizer generator observables of the same type.
examples.suggested: ...lagi nating mahihinuha ang mga resulta ng mga naalis na generator na ito mula sa...
examples.translation: ...habang isinaalang-alang na lagi nating maipapaliwanag ang mga resulta ng mga naalis na generator na ito ... mula sa mga resulta ng lahat ng iba pang stabilizer generator observable ng parehong uri.
examples.why: 'infer' (deduce the value) is weakened to 'maipapaliwanag' (explain). The pedagogical point is that the removed generators' outcomes are recoverable, not merely explainable; 'mahihinuha' is the right verb.

examples.source: this figure depicts an L×L lattice for L=9 / (Z errors are corrected in a symmetric way.)
examples.suggested: inilalarawan ng figure na ito... / (Ang mga $Z$ error ay naaayos sa simetrikong paraan.)
examples.translation: ilarawan ng figure na ito ang isang $L\times L$ lattice para sa $L=9.$ / (Ang mga $Z$ error ay naayos sa isang simetrikal na paraan.)
examples.why: Two aspect/inflection slips: 'ilarawan' is the infinitive/imperative where the imperfective 'inilalarawan' is required, and 'naayos' (completed) should be 'naaayos' (habitual/general truth). Both read as unedited output rather than authored prose.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout and nothing teaches a false concept, but a native technical editor would still change several things. The max-cut definition renders "maximized" as "mapakinabangan" ("to benefit from") twice in one paragraph — "upang mapakinabangan ang bilang ng mga gilid sa pagitan ng dalawang hanay" — while the rest of the file correctly uses "i-maximize"/"pag-maximize"/"maxima", so the file splits its rendering of the single most load-bearing verb in that section. "Mathematical rigor" becomes "Matematikal na katatagan" (katatagan = stability/steadfastness), and the same word is later used correctly for "resilience_level" ("dami ng katatagan"), so one word carries two unrelated senses. "Efficient" is likewise split between "epektibo" (Sampler/Estimator efficiency, lines 46 and 90 — which actually says "effective", not "efficient") and "mahusay" (lines 90, 92), with the coined hybrid "*mahusay na masolvable*" for "efficiently solvable". Residual translationese: the "Given a quantum state |ψ⟩, this primitive…" construction is calqued as "Binibigyan ng isang quantum na estado na $|\psi\rangle$, kinukuha ng primitive na ito…" (lines 31, 32, 36), "building blocks" as "mga bloke ng gusali", "at the expense of" as "sa gastos ng", "one can see" as "makikita ng isa"; plus a straight typo "mas tumpay" for "mas tumpak" (line 363) and the odd idiom "hindi na makakatawid sa classical simulation" (line 409). Informal register holds cleanly — no po/opo — though line 353 slips to exclusive "Ang aming layunin" where the file otherwise uses "ating".

examples.source: dividing the vertices of a graph into two disjoint sets such that the number of edges between the two sets is maximized … asks to partition the vertices into two disjoint subsets, S and T, such that the number of edges with one endpoint in S and the other in T is maximized
examples.suggested: …upang ma-maximize (mapakarami) ang bilang ng mga gilid…
examples.translation: paghati ng mga vertex ng isang graph sa dalawang disjoint na hanay upang mapakinabangan ang bilang ng mga gilid sa pagitan ng dalawang hanay … upang mapakinabangan ang bilang ng mga gilid na may isang endpoint sa $S$ at ang isa pa sa $T$
examples.why: 'mapakinabangan' means 'to derive benefit from', not 'to maximize'. It softens the defining objective of max-cut into something vague, and it contradicts the file's own later renderings ('pag-maximize ng sumusunod na cost function', 'i-maximize ang $C(\vec{z})$', 'maxima').

examples.source: ### Mathematical rigor (optional)
examples.suggested: ### Mahigpit na patunay sa matematika (opsyonal) / Matematikal na kahigpitan (opsyonal)
examples.translation: ### Matematikal na katatagan (opsyonal)
examples.why: 'katatagan' is stability/steadfastness, not rigor. Worse, the same word is used correctly for 'resilience' later ('Ang opsyong `resilience_level` … ay tumutukoy sa dami ng katatagan'), so one term now covers two unrelated concepts in the same file.

examples.source: `Sampler`: Given a quantum state |ψ⟩, this primitive obtains the probability of each possible computational basis state.
examples.suggested: `Sampler`: Sa isang ibinigay na quantum state na $|\psi\rangle$, kinukuha ng primitive na ito…
examples.translation: `Sampler`: Binibigyan ng isang quantum na estado na $|\psi\rangle$, kinukuha ng primitive na ito ang posibilidad ng bawat posibleng computational basis state.
examples.why: 'Binibigyan ng…' is a word-for-word calque of the English absolute 'Given …'; in Tagalog it parses as 'is being given by', which is not what the sentence means. The same calque recurs in the Sampler section ('binibigyan ng quantum circuit na naghahanda ng estado'). Grammatical-looking but no Tagalog technical writer would phrase it this way.

examples.source: `Sampler` is only efficient for sparse probability distributions … for this computation to be efficiently solvable … sampling also needs to be efficient
examples.suggested: Pick one rendering of 'efficient' (e.g. 'mahusay'/'episyente') and use it throughout; replace '*mahusay na masolvable*' with 'mahusay na malulutas'.
examples.translation: ang `Sampler` ay epektibo lamang para sa mga *maluwag* na probability distribution … para sa komputing na ito ay *mahusay na masolvable* … kailangan ding maging mahusay
examples.why: 'efficient' is rendered three ways within two paragraphs, and 'epektibo' actually means 'effective' (a different claim about Sampler/Estimator). '*masolvable*' is a coined English-Tagalog hybrid that is not a Filipino word.

examples.source: We can easily measure Pauli observables because we know V_k ahead of time, which is not the case generally for other observables.
examples.suggested: …na sa pangkalahatan ay hindi ganoon para sa ibang mga observable.
examples.translation: …dahil alam natin ang $V_k$ nang maaga, na hindi palaging ganoon para sa ibang mga observable.
examples.why: 'hindi palaging ganoon' = 'not always so', which weakens the English 'not the case generally' (generally it is NOT known). The learner comes away thinking V is usually known for other observables too, which undercuts the whole reason the Estimator decomposes into Paulis.

examples.source: …other ansatzes that might be able to represent our search space more accurately. / Increasingly, problems of interest are no longer classically simulable without state-of-the-art supercomputing facilities.
examples.suggested: …mas tumpak na kumakatawan… / Lalong hindi na kayang gayahin nang klasikal ang mga mahahalagang problema kung walang…
examples.translation: …ibang mga ansatz na maaaring mas tumpay na kumakatawan sa ating search space. / Lalong hindi na makakatawid sa classical simulation ang mga problemang may interes nang walang pinakabagong supercomputing facilities.
examples.why: 'tumpay' is a plain typo for 'tumpak'. 'makakatawid sa classical simulation' ('cross over to classical simulation') is a wrong idiom for 'simulable', and 'mga problemang may interes' is a literal calque of 'problems of interest'.

editor_note: Register (informal "ти") and the NYC tourist analogy are handled well, but several core terms are rendered so wrongly that a learner would form false beliefs. "Today's quantum computers … are noisy" becomes "є галасливими" — the acoustic sense (loud/rowdy); the physics term is "шумні/зашумлені", which the rest of the uk corpus uses in 16 other files, so the section that introduces quantum noise teaches the wrong concept. "Going beyond single chip processors" becomes "Вихід за межі однопроцесорних процесорів" ("single-processor processors"), which is meaningless and destroys the single-chip → multi-chip contrast the very next sentence about Crossbill ("перший одиночний процесор, виготовлений з кількох чіпів") depends on. "Near-term" is consistently rendered "короткостроковий" — "короткострокової квантової переваги" says the advantage is short-lived rather than arriving in the near future. Two further terminology collapses: "circuit knitting toolbox"/"Circuit knitting" are both flattened into "розрізання схем", erasing the cutting-vs-knitting distinction the paragraph is built on, and "middleware" is "середнє програмне забезпечення" ("average software") instead of "проміжне програмне забезпечення". Minor on top: "grand challenge" left untranslated ("це grand challenge квантових обчислень"), the heading "Квантові суперкомп'ютери" drops "-centric" while the body says "квантово-орієнтований суперкомп'ютинг", Quantum Volume is kept in English everywhere except one "квантовим обсягом", "Фактором, що обмежує цю дослідженість" uses a wrong noun, and a UI sentence absent from the English ("Прочитай питання нижче… натисни трикутник") is injected before the check-in question.

examples.source: Today's quantum computers, and those expected for the foreseeable future, are noisy.
examples.suggested: …є шумними (зашумленими).
examples.translation: Сьогоднішні квантові комп'ютери і ті, що очікуються в найближчому майбутньому, є галасливими.
examples.why: "Галасливий" means loud/rowdy in the acoustic-social sense and is never used for physical noise. The uk corpus uses "шумний" in 16 other learning files; here the term that names the whole section's subject teaches the learner a false idea of what quantum noise is.

examples.source: Going beyond single chip processors is the key to solving problems at scale. In 2024, we introduced Crossbill, the first single processor made from multiple chips.
examples.suggested: Вихід за межі однокристальних процесорів (процесорів на одному чипі) є ключем…
examples.translation: Вихід за межі однопроцесорних процесорів є ключем до вирішення задач у масштабі. У 2024 році ми представили Crossbill — перший одиночний процесор, виготовлений з кількох чіпів.
examples.why: "Однопроцесорних процесорів" is self-contradictory and loses "chip" entirely, so the single-chip → multi-chip contrast that the Crossbill sentence and the whole modular-scaling point rest on no longer holds together.

examples.source: …plans to achieve near-term quantum advantage by 2026.
examples.suggested: …квантової переваги у найближчій перспективі (найближчого майбутнього) до 2026 року.
examples.translation: …плани щодо досягнення короткострокової квантової переваги до 2026 року.
examples.why: "Короткострокова перевага" states the advantage itself is short-lived; the English says it is expected soon. The same calque recurs for "near-term quantum computers" → "короткострокових квантових комп'ютерів" (UK 110, 112).

examples.source: This middleware includes the circuit knitting toolbox … The circuit cutting Qiskit addon … Circuit knitting uses classical computation to take on some of the computational burden…
examples.suggested: проміжне програмне забезпечення; набір інструментів для зшивання схем (circuit knitting); Зшивання схем використовує класичні обчислення…
examples.translation: Це середнє програмне забезпечення включає набір інструментів для розрізання схем … Додаток Qiskit для розрізання схем … Розрізання схем використовує класичне обчислення…
examples.why: Two errors in one passage: "middleware" as "середнє ПЗ" reads as "average software", and "circuit knitting" and "circuit cutting" are merged into a single term, so the learner cannot tell that knitting is the cut-then-stitch-back method the following sentence about "зшивати кінцеві результати" describes.

examples.source: The fleet of IBM quantum computers, all with at least 127 qubits, is the largest in the world.
examples.suggested: Парк квантових комп'ютерів IBM®, кожен із яких має принаймні 127 кубітів, — найбільший у світі.
examples.translation: Флот IBM® квантових комп'ютерів, кожен із яких має принаймні 127 кубітів, є найбільшим у світі.
examples.why: "Флот" is a naval calque and "IBM квантових комп'ютерів" keeps English adjective-before-noun order; a Ukrainian writer would say "парк квантових комп'ютерів IBM". The same calqued order recurs in the heading "IBM надпровідні квантові комп'ютери" and in "IBM-квантових комп'ютерів".

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout and the informal "ти" register holds consistently (Отримай, Створи, тобі також знадобляться, Твої результати); no inversions, swapped quantities or dropped caveats that would mislead. The residual problems are editorial: "ansatz" is transliterated as "ансац" ("в цьому ансаці", "Схеми ансацу") rather than the conventional Ukrainian "анзац"; the hedge in "Dynamical decoupling *often* works best" is dropped ("Динамічне розв'язування найкраще працює"), turning a tendency into a flat claim; and the transpiler is named three ways in one file — the verb "транспілюй"/"транспільована", the noun "транспіляція", but then bare undeclined English "Transpiler" ("дозволяє Transpiler розкладати схеми", "Порівняння налаштувань Transpiler"), which no native technical writer would leave uninflected. Two Russified active participles ("простоюючих кубітів", "рефокусуючі імпульси") read as translationese where "кубітів, що простоюють" / "імпульси рефокусування" are the Ukrainian forms. Finally, the head term "dynamical decoupling" → "динамічне розв'язування" is recognizable but unfortunate: "розв'язування" is overwhelmingly read as "solving" (розв'язування задач); "динамічна розв'язка" or "динамічне розчеплення" carries the decoupling sense unambiguously.

examples.source: the two-qubit `ecr` gates are applied sequentially in this ansatz. / Ansatz circuits such as `efficient_su2` are parameterized
examples.suggested: …послідовно в цьому анзаці. / Анзац-схеми, такі як `efficient_su2`, є параметризованими
examples.translation: двокубітні гейти `ecr` застосовуються послідовно в цьому ансаці. / Схеми ансацу, такі як `efficient_su2`, є параметризованими
examples.why: Ukrainian renders German Ansatz as "анзац" (анзаца, анзаці); "ансац" is a non-standard transliteration, and "Схеми ансацу" is a stiff genitive chain where the attributive "анзац-схеми" is the natural technical form.

examples.source: Dynamical decoupling often works best when there is a lot of idle time in the quantum circuits
examples.suggested: Динамічне розв'язування часто працює найкраще, коли в квантових схемах багато часу простою
examples.translation: Динамічне розв'язування найкраще працює, коли в квантових схемах є багато часу простою
examples.why: "often" is dropped, so a deliberately hedged rule of thumb becomes an unqualified statement about when the technique is optimal.

examples.source: allows the transpiler to decompose circuits into basis gates / Compare transpiler settings
examples.suggested: дозволяє транспілятору розкладати схеми на базисні гейти / Порівняння налаштувань транспілятора
examples.translation: дозволяє Transpiler розкладати схеми на базисні гейти / Порівняння налаштувань Transpiler
examples.why: The same concept appears as the Ukrainian verb/noun elsewhere in the file ("транспілюй схему", "транспільована схема", "Параметри транспіляції") but as bare undeclined English "Transpiler" here — an inconsistent split, and an uninflected Latin noun in a Ukrainian dative slot reads as untranslated residue.

examples.source: adding pulse sequences … to idle qubits to flip them around the Bloch sphere … similar to refocusing pulses used in nuclear magnetic resonance
examples.suggested: …до кубітів, що простоюють (or: до неактивних кубітів) … схожі на імпульси рефокусування
examples.translation: додавання послідовностей імпульсів … до простоюючих кубітів … Такі імпульсні послідовності схожі на рефокусуючі імпульси
examples.why: Active -юч-/-уч- participles (простоюючий, рефокусуючий) are calqued forms Ukrainian style guides reject; native technical prose uses a relative clause or a deverbal noun.

examples.source: dynamical decoupling
examples.suggested: динамічна розв'язка / динамічне розчеплення
examples.translation: динамічне розв'язування
examples.why: Consistent throughout, so the concept stays identifiable, but "розв'язування" is the everyday word for "solving" (розв'язування задач); the decoupling sense needs "розв'язка" or "розчеплення" to avoid a first-reading of "dynamic problem-solving".

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inverted conditions, swapped quantities or dropped caveats; terminology is consistent (circuit→"коло", qubit→"кубіт", shots/runtime/backend kept in English, "часові проміжки виконання" for execution spans), and the informal "ти" register holds ("перевір", "дивись", "Витягни та перевір") with no Ви-slips. What a native editor would change is phrasing: the conversion sentence "конвертувати з байтового формату в `BitArray` до бітових рядків" reads as "from byte format INTO BitArray, to bitstrings" and momentarily inverts the direction (EN: away from the bytes format held in the BitArray, to bitstrings); "відображає бітові рядки до кількості" is a direct calque of "maps … to" (Ukrainian takes "у кількість"); and "пропонують кращу продуктивність" / "Клас `BitArray` пропонує ряд методів" calque English "offer" where "забезпечують" / "має" is what a Ukrainian technical writer would use. Also "візуальний нарис структури даних" ("sketch/essay") is an odd rendering of "visual outline" (better: "схема"/"огляд"), and "Ліва вісь … права" drops the superlative of "left-most/right-most".

examples.source: It can sometimes be convenient to convert away from the bytes format in the `BitArray` to bitstrings.
examples.suggested: Іноді зручно перейти від байтового формату, у якому `BitArray` зберігає дані, до бітових рядків.
examples.translation: Іноді зручно конвертувати з байтового формату в `BitArray` до бітових рядків.
examples.why: The pair «з … в `BitArray`» is the standard 'from X to Y' frame, so the sentence first reads as converting INTO a BitArray, and only the trailing «до бітових рядків» corrects it. Direction of the conversion is momentarily inverted; recoverable from the code cell, but a native editor would rewrite it.

examples.source: returns a dictionary mapping bitstrings to the number of times that they occurred
examples.suggested: повертає словник, який зіставляє бітові рядки з кількістю їхніх появ
examples.translation: повертає словник, що відображає бітові рядки до кількості їхніх входжень
examples.why: «відображає … до» is a word-for-word calque of English 'maps … to'; Ukrainian mathematical usage is «відображає X у Y» or «зіставляє X з Y». Grammatical but unmistakably translated.

examples.source: Since arrays generally offer better performance … The `BitArray` class offers a range of methods
examples.suggested: Оскільки масиви зазвичай працюють швидше за словники … Клас `BitArray` має низку методів
examples.translation: Оскільки масиви зазвичай пропонують кращу продуктивність … Клас `BitArray` пропонує ряд методів
examples.why: «пропонувати» renders commercial 'to offer'; an inanimate class or data structure does not 'offer' anything in Ukrainian technical prose. Repeated twice in one paragraph, which makes the calque stand out.

examples.source: The following is a visual outline of the `PrimitiveResult` data structure:
examples.suggested: Нижче наведено схему структури даних `PrimitiveResult`:
examples.translation: Нижче наведено візуальний нарис структури даних `PrimitiveResult`:
examples.why: «нарис» means a sketch or a literary essay; for a diagram of a data structure a Ukrainian technical writer writes «схема» (or «загальний вигляд»).

examples.source: review the metadata of the result returned by `SamplerV2`, which comes in the form of an `ExecutionSpans` object
examples.suggested: перевір метадані результату, повернутого `SamplerV2`, — вони мають вигляд об'єкта `ExecutionSpans`
examples.translation: перевір метадані результату, повернутого `SamplerV2`, у вигляді об'єкта `ExecutionSpans`
examples.why: The relative clause is flattened into an adverbial, so «у вигляді об'єкта» attaches to the act of checking rather than describing what the metadata IS. The teaching point (the metadata field is itself an ExecutionSpans container) is blurred.

editor_note: The file is accurate, informal ("ти", no Ви/Вам) and terminologically solid overall — "вентилі", "кубіти", "транспілятор/транспілювати", "базисні вентилі", "багатокристальний/міжкристальний" for multi-chip/inter-chip are correct and consistent — but a native editor would still change several things. The English "transpile **against** a backend" is rendered as the calque "транспілювати ... проти нього / проти власних Backend-ів" throughout, and the frontmatter title compresses it to "Створення та транспіляція власних Backend-ів", which literally reads "transpilation *of* custom backends" (backends are not transpiled) and no longer matches the body heading "Транспіляція проти власних Backend-ів". In line 281 "будує схему, що створює великий стан GHZ, і транспілює **його**" the masculine pronoun agrees with "стан", not with feminine "схему", so the sentence says the GHZ *state* is transpiled instead of the circuit. Smaller items: "instantiate" is rendered "ініціалізувати" (initialize) in line 52, and within one sentence (line 277) "default" appears twice as two different words — "типовий напрямок" and then "за замовчуванням".

examples.source: Create and transpile against custom backends
examples.suggested: Створення власних Backend-ів і транспіляція схем під них
examples.translation: Створення та транспіляція власних Backend-ів
examples.why: Dropping the "against" relation turns the title into "transpilation of custom backends" — backends are not the object of transpilation; it also diverges from the body heading "Транспіляція проти власних Backend-ів".

examples.source: The next example builds a circuit that creates a large GHZ state and transpiles it against the backend constructed above.
examples.suggested: ...будує схему, що створює великий стан GHZ, і транспілює цю схему під побудований вище Backend.
examples.translation: Наступний приклад будує схему, що створює великий стан GHZ, і транспілює його проти побудованого вище Backend.
examples.why: "його" grammatically refers to masculine "стан", not to feminine "схему", so the Ukrainian says the GHZ state is transpiled rather than the circuit.

examples.source: Once instantiated, the provider object will then provide a list of backends as well as the ability to acquire/instantiate backends.
examples.suggested: Після створення екземпляра об'єкт провайдера надасть список Backend-ів, а також можливість отримувати/створювати їх екземпляри.
examples.translation: Після ініціалізації об'єкт провайдера надасть список Backend-ів, а також можливість отримувати/ініціалізувати їх.
examples.why: "instantiate" is rendered as "ініціалізувати" (initialize), a different operation; the conventional Ukrainian rendering is "створити екземпляр".

examples.source: The direction of the arrow indicates the default direction in which these gates are executed; they specify which qubits are control/targets by default...
examples.suggested: ...вказує на напрямок виконання цих вентилів за замовчуванням; він визначає, які кубіти є керуючими/цільовими за замовчуванням...
examples.translation: Напрямок стрілки вказує на типовий напрямок виконання цих вентилів; він визначає, які кубіти є контрольними/цільовими за замовчуванням...
examples.why: The same word "default" is rendered two different ways inside one sentence ("типовий" = typical, then "за замовчуванням"); "керуючий кубіт" is also the more standard term than the calque "контрольний".

examples.source: transpile quantum circuits against them / Transpile against custom backends
examples.suggested: транспілювати квантові схеми під цей Backend / Транспіляція під власні Backend-и
examples.translation: транспілювати квантові схеми проти нього / Транспіляція проти власних Backend-ів
examples.why: "проти" is a literal calque of English "against" and reads as "opposed to" in Ukrainian; a native technical writer would use "під" or "для" (targeting the backend).
